title: Middle English dictionary
edition: A. L. Mayhew & Walter W. Skeat · A Concise Dictionary of Middle English, 1888
notes: A later scholarly dictionary of this historical language, not a dictionary compiled during that language period. Entry wording, alternative forms, senses, examples, and abbreviations are kept together; HTML whitespace is normalized. Cross-references and cited material may need consultation of the original.

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (1), adding intensity to the notion of the verb.—AS. á for ar- , OHG. ar- , Goth. us- . For the quantity of the á see Sievers, 121. Cf. Or .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (2), standing for A , prep. , and for Icel. á ; see On- (1) .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (3), standing for Of , prep. ; see Of .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (4), standing for AS. and- , against, in return, toward.—AS. and- , ond- , on- (proclitic). Cf. On- (2.)

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (5), standing for At , prep. , and Icel. at , used with the infin. See At- (1) .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (6), standing for AS. ge- ; see Ȝe- .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (7), standing for OF. a- and Lat. ad- .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (8), standing for OF. a- and Lat. ab- .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (9), standing for AF. a , OF. e- , es- from Lat. ex- , e- .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (10), standing for AF. an- , OF. en- from Lat. in- . See In- .

records.label: A-
records.text: A- , prefix (11), standing for Gr. α- privative.

records.label: A
records.text: A , interj. O! Ah! expressing surprise, pain, S, MD.

records.label: A
records.text: A , prep. on, in, PP, S, S2, C2; see On .

records.label: A
records.text: A , prep. of, S2, S3, PP; see Of .

records.label: A
records.text: A , adv. ever, S; aa , S; a buten , ever without, S; see O .

records.label: A-bac
records.text: A-bac , adv. backwards, S, W2; abec , S; abak , C2, W; obak , S2.—AS. on-bæc . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Abasshen
records.text: Abasshen , v. to abash, S3; abasshed , pp. abashed, ashamed, alarmed, C3, PP; abashed , S2; abasshid , S3; abasched , PP; abaisshed , PP; abaischid , W; abaischt , S2; abaissed , PP; abaist , S3; abayste , S2, C2.—OF. esbahiss- stem of pr. p. of esbahir , to astonish; Lat. ex + * badire for badare , to open the mouth. ( A- 9 .)

records.label: Abate
records.text: Abate , v. to beat down, bring down, calm down, P, NED.—AF. abatre (pr. p. abatant ); Late Lat. * adbatere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Abaue
records.text: Abaue , v. to put to confusion, to be confounded, NED, HD, JD; abawed , pp. HD; abaued , HD.—OF. * abavir : esbahir (with v in place of lost h , see Brachet, s.v. glaive ). ( A- 9 ). See Abasshen .

records.label: Abaye
records.text: Abaye , sb. barking; phr. at þe abaie, at abaye , at bay, S2.—OF. abai , barking, from abaier ; cp. F. aboi in phr.: être aux abois .

records.label: Abbay
records.text: Abbay , sb. abbey, C2; abbeis , pl., S2.—AF. abbeie ( abeie ); Church Lat. abbādia , abbātia , from abbātem . See Abbod .

records.label: Abbesse
records.text: Abbesse , sb. abbess, PP.—OF. abbesse ; Church Lat. abbatissa .

records.label: Abbod
records.text: Abbod , sb. abbot, MD, S2; abbot , S, PP; abbodes , pl. S2.—Church Lat. abbātem (pronounced abbādem ), nom. abbas ; Gr. ἀββάς ; Syriac, abba , father.

records.label: Abbodesse
records.text: Abbodesse , sb. abbess, PP.

records.label: Abbot-rice
records.text: Abbot-rice , sb. abbacy, S.—AS. abbod-ríce , the rule of an abbot.

records.label: A-B-C
records.text: A-B-C , the alphabet, P; abcy , Cath.; abce , Cath. ( n. ), PP; abcee , Cotg.; abece , Cath. ( n. ); apece , Prompt.—Cp. OF. abece , the crosse rowe (Cotg.).

records.label: A-bernen
records.text: A-bernen , v. to burn; abernð , pr. s. S.—AS. á-beornan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Abhominacioun
records.text: Abhominacioun , sb. abomination, NED, C2.

records.label: Abhomynable
records.text: Abhomynable , adj. abominable, S3, C3.—AF. abhominable ; Lat. abominabilem .

records.label: A-biden
records.text: A-biden , v. to abide, remain, await, endure, S, S2, W2; habide , S2; abyde , C2; abid , imp. , S, S2; abid , pr. s. , S; abit , S, S2, C3; abod , pt. s. , S; abood , W2; abide , pt. pl. , S2; abididen , W2; abide , pp. , G.—AS. á-bídan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-biding
records.text: A-biding , sb. expectation, W2.

records.label: Abil
records.text: Abil , adj. able, CM; able , C; hable , S3, MD.—OF. able , hable (mod. F. habile ); Lat. habilem .

records.label: Abilite
records.text: Abilite , sb. ability, NED; habilitie , S3.—OF. habilité .

records.label: Abilȝeit
records.text: Abilȝeit , pp. apparelled, S3.—OF. habiller .

records.label: Abilȝement
records.text: Abilȝement , sb. clothing, S3.—OF. habillement .

records.label: Abit
records.text: Abit , sb. dress, a monk’s clothing, habit, PP, CM, HD; abite , W.—AF. abit ( habit ); Lat. habitum (acc.).

records.label: A-biten
records.text: A-biten , v. to bite, S.—AS. á-bítan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Abject
records.text: Abject , pp. and adj. cast out, NED.

records.label: Abjecte
records.text: Abjecte , v. to cast aside, S3.

records.label: A-blawen
records.text: A-blawen , v. to blow, MD; ableow , pt. s. , S.—AS. á-bláwan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-blenden
records.text: A-blenden , v. to blind, MD; ablent , pr. s. , S; pl. , S; ablende , pt. s. , MD; ablend , pp. MD.—AS. á-blendan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-bouten
records.text: A-bouten , adv. and prep. about, C2, P, MD; abuten , S; abuuten , S; abuton , S; abute , S; aboute , S, G; oboute , MD; obout , S2.—AS. on-bútan (= on-be-útan ). ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-bouen
records.text: A-bouen , adv. and prep. above, C2, PP, MD; aboue , PP; abufen , S; abuuen , MD; abowen , MD; abone , S3, JD; oboven , MD; obowen , MD; oboune , MD. Phr. : at here aboue , S2.—AS. on + bufan (= be + ufan ). ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Abregge
records.text: Abregge , v. to abridge, shorten, C; abreggide , pp. , W; breggid , W.—OF. abreger , abregier : Prov. abrevjar ; Lat. abbreviare . ( A- 8 .)

records.label: A-breiden
records.text: A-breiden , v. to start up, to draw (sword), to thrust out, to blame, S; abreyden , NED; abraid , pt. s. , S; abreyde , C2; abrayde , C; abroden , pp. , S; abruden , S.—AS. á + bregdan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-brode
records.text: A-brode , adv. abroad, PP; abrood , C2; abrod , widely apart, PP. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Abusioun
records.text: Abusioun , sb. deceit, S2, C3.—OF. abusion (Cotg.).

records.label: A-buȝen
records.text: A-buȝen , v. to bow, MD; abuen , MD; abouwen , MD; abowe , NED; abeah , pt. s. , MD; abeh , S.—AS. á-bugan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-byen, Abye
records.text: A-byen, Abye , v. to buy, to pay for, S3, C2, C3, PP; abygge , PP; abiggen , PP; abuggen , S, PP; abeggen , MD, G; abeien , S; abie , PP; abuiþ , pr. s. , S; abugeð , pr. pl. , S; abouhte , pt. s. , S; aboughte , G; abought , pp. C3.—AS. ábycgan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Abyme
records.text: Abyme , sb. abyss, S2, HD.—OF. abime , abisme ; Low Lat. * abyssimum , superl. of Lat. abyssus ; Gr. ἄβυσσος , bottomless. ( A- 11 .)

records.label: Ac
records.text: Ac , conj. but, S, S2, P; acc , S; ah , S, S2; ak , S2, PP; hac , S; ach , MD; auh , MD, S; auch , MD; oc , S; occ , S.—AS. ac .

records.label: Accident
records.text: Accident , sb. accident (a term of the schoolmen), C3.—Lat. accidentem .

records.label: Accidie
records.text: Accidie , sb. sloth, indolence, S, CM, PP.—AF. accidie (NED); Low Lat. accidia , acedia ; Gr. ἀκηδία , heedlessness, torpor. ( A- 11 .)

records.label: Accompt
records.text: Accompt , sb. account, S3; see Acounte .

records.label: Accompted
records.text: Accompted , pp. accounted, S3; see Acounte .

records.label: Ace
records.text: Ace , sb. a jot, S3; see As .

records.label: A-cennen
records.text: A-cennen , v. to bring forth, to beget, MD; acenned , pp. MD; accenned , S; akenned , MD; akennet , S; acende (for acend ), S.—AS. á-cennan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-cennende
records.text: A-cennende , sb. begetting, birth, S.

records.label: A-cenneng
records.text: A-cenneng , sb. birth, S.

records.label: A-chape
records.text: A-chape , v. to escape, NED; achaped , pt. s. , S2.—OF. achaper ; cf. AF. ascaper . ( A- 9 .) Cf. Eschapen , Ascapie .

records.label: Achate
records.text: Achate , v. to purchase, NED.—OF. achater (F. acheter , acater ; Late Lat., accaptare .

records.label: Achate
records.text: Achate , sb. purchase, provisions purchased, NED, C; achat , HD; acate , NED; acates , pl. , HD.—OF. achat , AF. acate . See above.

records.label: Achatour
records.text: Achatour , sb. a purchaser of provisions, purveyor, C, NED, HD; acatour , NED.—AF. achatour , acatour ; Late Lat. accaptatorem .

records.label: Ache
records.text: Ache , sb. pain, Prompt.; eche , MD; hache , HD.—AS. æce ( ece ). See Aken .

records.label: Ache
records.text: Ache , sb. wild celery, parsley, NED, Voc.—OF. ache ; Lat. apium ; Gr. ἄπιον .

records.label: Achesoun
records.text: Achesoun , sb. occasion, motive, HD, MD, NED.—OF. achoison , ocoison ; Lat. occasionem . Cf. Anchesoun , Enchesoun , Chesoun .

records.label: Achtande
records.text: Achtande , ord. eighth, S2, NED.—Icel. áttandi ; cp. OHG. ahtande . Cf. Eighte ( ord. ) .

records.label: A-colien
records.text: A-colien , v. to wax cold; acolede , pt. s. , S; acoled , pp. , S.—AS. á-cólian . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Acombren
records.text: Acombren , v. to encumber, PP; acumbrid , pp. , S2.—OF. encombrer . ( A- 10 .)

records.label: Acomplesshen
records.text: Acomplesshen , v. to accomplish, NED; accomplice , C; accompliced , pp. NED.—AF. acomplir ( acomplice , pr. s. subj.); Late Lat. accomplere ; see Brachet. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Acord
records.text: Acord , sb. accord, agreement, MD; accord , S2; acorde , S.—AF. acord .

records.label: Acordaunce
records.text: Acordaunce , sb. agreement, PP.

records.label: Acorden
records.text: Acorden , v. to reconcile, to agree, MD, S2, P; accordyng , pr. p. , S3; accorded , pp. , S2; pt. s. , S3.—OF. acorder ; Late Lat. accordare , from Lat. ad + cord- , stem of cor , heart. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Acounte
records.text: Acounte , v. to count, to calculate, NED, C2, PP; acompte , NED, PP; accompted , pp. , S3.—AF. acounter , OF. acunter , aconter ; Late Lat. accomptare ; Lat. ad + computare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Acounte
records.text: Acounte , sb. account, reckoning, PP; acompte , PP; accompt , S3; accomptes , pl. , S3.—AF. acounte , acunte .

records.label: Acoupen
records.text: Acoupen , v. to accuse, NED, HD; acoupede , pt. s. , NED, PP; acopede , NED; acoulped , NED; acouped , pp. , S2.—OF. acouper , acolper , for encouper , encolper ; Lat. inculpare . ( A- 10 .)

records.label: Acoyen
records.text: Acoyen , v. to quiet, coax, tame, NED, Palsg.; acoyed , pt. s. , S2.—OF. acoyer , to calm; Lat. ad + quietare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-cursien
records.text: A-cursien , v. to curse, NED; acursi , S, NED; acorse , PP; acorsed , pp. MD. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Acustumaunce
records.text: Acustumaunce , sb. customary use, NED, C2.—OF. acostumance . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Adamant
records.text: Adamant , sb. adamant, very hard metal, a fabulous rock or mineral, the diamond, the loadstone or magnet, NED; precious stone, Prompt.; ademaunt , C; adamounde , Prompt. ( n. ); admont , NED; athamant , NED; athamaunte , C; attemant , NED; aymont , NED.—AF. adamant ( aimant ); Lat. adamantem ; Gr. ἀδάμας ( -αντα ), lit. invincible, untamable, from ἀ- + δαμάω , I tame. ( A- 11 .)

records.label: Adaunten
records.text: Adaunten , v. to subdue, NED; adauntede , pt. s. , S2.—OF. adanter , adonter ; Lat. ad + domitare , to tame. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-dawe
records.text: A-dawe , out of life, NED, HD.—AS. of dagum , from days. ( A- 3 .)

records.label: A-dawen
records.text: A-dawen , v. to rise from sleep, also, to arouse, NED; adawed , pp. S3.—Cp. MHG. er-tagen , to dawn. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-day
records.text: A-day , adv. at morn, by day, S2, P; adai , S. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Addledd
records.text: Addledd , pp. earned, S; see Adlen .

records.label: A-diliȝen
records.text: A-diliȝen , v. to be lost, to perish, S; adiliȝede , pt. s. , S; adiligde , S.—AS. á-diligan , to destroy. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-diȝten
records.text: A-diȝten , v. to appoint, order, prepare, compose, clothe, treat, MD, S; adyȝt , pp. , MD; adight , G; adyght , MD, HD. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Adlen
records.text: Adlen , v. to earn, MD; addle , Manip., MED; addledd , pp. , S.—Icel. öðla , refl. öðla-sk , to acquire for oneself property, from óðal , property, patrimony, from * aþal , race, see Fick, 7. 14; cp. OHG. uodil , ‘praedium’ (Tatian). See Athel .

records.label: Admirald
records.text: Admirald , sb. a Saracen commander, S; see Amirail .

records.label: Admod
records.text: Admod , adj. humble, gentle, S; ædmod , MD; edmod , MD.—AS. éadmód , éaðmód . See Eth .

records.label: Admoded
records.text: Admoded , pp. as adj. lowly; see Eadmodien .

records.label: Admodie
records.text: Admodie , adj. pl. humble, MD; edmodi , MD.

records.label: Admodliche
records.text: Admodliche , adv. humbly, gently, MD; ædmodliȝ , S.—AS. éadmódlice .

records.label: Admodnesse
records.text: Admodnesse , sb. humility, gentleness, MD, S; edmodnesse , S; æddmodnesse , S.—AS. éadmódnes .

records.label: A-do
records.text: A-do , sb. fuss, trouble, difficulty, S3, Prompt., WW; = to do, PP, WW; adoe , ND, ( A- 5 .)

records.label: A-doun
records.text: A-doun , adv. down, S, S2, C2, C3, G; adun , S; adune , S.—AS. of dúne , off the hill. ( A- 3 .)

records.label: A-drad
records.text: A-drad , pp. frightened, put in dread, NED, S2, G, C, PP; adred , S; adrede , NED.—AS. of-drad ( A- 3 ). Cf. Of-dreden .

records.label: A-drawen
records.text: A-drawen , v. to draw out, S2; adroh , pt. s. , NED; adrou , NED; adraȝe , pp. NED. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-dreden
records.text: A-dreden , v. to fear greatly, S, NED; adrade , reflex. , S.—OMerc. and-drǽdan (Rushw.); see NED. ( A- 4 .)

records.label: A-drenchen
records.text: A-drenchen , v. to drown, to be drowned, MD, S, PP; adreynten , pt. pl. , PP; adreynt , pp. drenched, PP; adreint , MD; adrent , S, PP; adreynched , PP.—AS. á-drencan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Adressen
records.text: Adressen , v. to make straight, to direct, NED, H.—OF. adressier , adrecier Late Lat. addrictiare , from Lat. directum , straight. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-drinken
records.text: A-drinken , v. to be drowned, MD, S; adronc , pt. s. , MD; adronken , pl. , MD; adrunken , pp. , MD.—AS. á-drincan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-drye
records.text: A-drye , v. to endure, bear, HD; adriȝen , S (19. 1047), MD.—AS. á-dréogan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-dun
records.text: A-dun , adv. down, S; see Adoun .

records.label: A-dunien
records.text: A-dunien , v. to din; adunest , 2 pr. s. , adenyd , pp. MD. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Adun-ward
records.text: Adun-ward , adv. downward, NED; adonward , S2.

records.label: Adversarie
records.text: Adversarie , sb. adversary, C3.—OF. adversarie ; Lat. aduersarius .

records.label: Advertence
records.text: Advertence , sb. mental attention, C3.—Late Lat. advertentia .

records.label: Advocat
records.text: Advocat , sb. advocate, intercessor, C3; vokate , PP; vokyte , causidicus , Voc.; vokettus , pl. PP.—OF. advocat ; Lat. aduocatum (acc.).

records.label: Æ
records.text: Æ , sb. law, MD.—AS. ǽw ( ǽ ), law, divine law, the Mosaic law, marriage; Goth. aiws , an age, eternity; cp. OHG. éwa , the law of God, eternity (Otfrid). Cf. Æ-uez , Eu-bruche , Eche .

records.label: Ædmod
records.text: Ædmod , adj. humble, gentle, MD; see Admod .

records.label: Ædmodliȝ
records.text: Ædmodliȝ , adv. humbly, S; see Admodliche .

records.label: Ædmodnisse
records.text: Ædmodnisse , sb. humility, MD; æddmodnesse , S; see Admodnesse .

records.label: Æhte
records.text: Æhte , num. eight, MD; see Eighte .

records.label: Æhtene
records.text: Æhtene , num. eighteen, S; see Eightene .

records.label: Æn
records.text: Æn , num. and indef. art. one, S; ænne , S; see Oon .

records.label: Æness
records.text: Æness , adv. once, S; see Oones .

records.label: Æoure
records.text: Æoure , pron. your, S; see Ȝoure .

records.label: Ærd
records.text: Ærd , sb. native land, home, S; see Erd .

records.label: Ærfeð-telle
records.text: Ærfeð-telle , adj. difficult to count, S. See Arfeð .

records.label: Ærnde
records.text: Ærnde , sb. errand, MD; see Erende .

records.label: Ærnd-race
records.text: Ærnd-race , sb. messenger, S; Ærnd-raches , pl. , S.—AS. ǽrend-raca .

records.label: Ærnen
records.text: Ærnen , v. to run, S; see Rennen .

records.label: Æ-uez
records.text: Æ-uez , adj. pious, fast in the law, S.—AS. ǽ-fest . See Æ .

records.label: Afaiten
records.text: Afaiten , v. to affect, to prepare, array, dress, to train, tame, subdue, NED, PP; affaiten , P; fayten , S2, PP; faiten , PP.—OF. afaiter , afeiter ; Lat. affectare , freq. of afficere ; ad + facere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-fallen
records.text: A-fallen , v. to fall, MD; auallen , MD; afeol , pt. s. , MD; afallen , pp. , MD.—AS. á-feallan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-fallen
records.text: A-fallen , v. to fell, NED; afal , imp. , S; aual , S.

records.label: A-felde
records.text: A-felde , adv. a-field, to the field, PP. ( A- 2 ).

records.label: A-fellen
records.text: A-fellen , v. to fell, NED; auellen , MD.—AS. á-fellan , á-fyllan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-fer
records.text: A-fer , adv. afar, W, W2; afeer , NED; of feor , S (s.v. feor ). ( A- 3 .) Cf. A-ferre .

records.label: Afere
records.text: Afere , sb. , affair, bustle, appearance, demeanour, S2, NED; effere , S2; effeir , S2, S3; effer , S2; afferes , pl. , PP.—OF. afere = a + fere ; Lat. facere , to do. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-feren
records.text: A-feren , v. to frighten, terrify, S, PP; afferen , MD; affeare , 2 pr. s. subj. , S; afered , pp. afraid, S, C, P; aferd , S, C, P, W2; afeerd , W; afert , PP; aferde , S3, P, W; afferde , S3.—AS. á-fǽran . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-ferre
records.text: A-ferre , adv. afar, Prompt.; oferrum , S2; onferrum , S2; onferre , NED; onferr , NED. ( A- 2 ). Cf. Afer .

records.label: Affamysit
records.text: Affamysit , pp. famished, S3, NED. Cp. OF. afamer ; Late Lat. affamare .

records.label: Affectuosly
records.text: Affectuosly , adv. passionately, HD, NED.

records.label: Affectuouse
records.text: Affectuouse , adj. hearty, affectionate, NED, H; affectuse , NED.—Lat. affectuosus .

records.label: Affray
records.text: Affray , sb. terror, S3, C2, C3. Cf. Effray .

records.label: Affrayen
records.text: Affrayen , v. to frighten, C2; affrayed , pp. S2, C, C3, W; see Afrayen .

records.label: Afile
records.text: Afile , v. to file down, NED; affyle , C.—OF. afiler .

records.label: Afingret
records.text: Afingret , pp. an-hungered, NED, HD; see Of-hungred .

records.label: A-flemen
records.text: A-flemen , v. to drive away, MD; aulem , imp. s. , S.—AS. á-fléman ( á-flýman ). ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Afolen

records.text: Al solne day , All Souls’ Day, NED; alle soule day , S2.—AS. ealra sawlena dæg .

records.label: Als-tite
records.text: Als-tite , adv. as quick, immediately, MED, S2.

records.label: Al-suic
records.text: Al-suic , adj. all such, S.

records.label: Al-swithe
records.text: Al-swithe , adv. as fast, immediately, MED; alswythe , PP; als-suith , S2; aswithe , S2; asswythe , S2.

records.label: Alther-
records.text: Alther- , gen. pl. of all, C, G, W2, PP; see Alre- .

records.label: Alther-best
records.text: Alther-best , adj. best of all, S, C; see Alrebest .

records.label: Alther-feblest
records.text: Alther-feblest , adj. feeblest of all, S2, HD.

records.label: Alther-first
records.text: Alther-first , adj. first of all, HD; see Alrefyrst .

records.label: Alther-moost
records.text: Alther-moost , adj. most of all, HD; see Alremest .

records.label: Al-to
records.text: Al-to , adv. entirely, S, NED (s.v. all , see C, sect. 15), W, W2, H; all-to , H.

records.label: Al-togidere
records.text: Al-togidere , adv. altogether, G; altegædere , S.

records.label: Al-wat
records.text: Al-wat , conj. , adv. all the while, till, S, MD (s.v. al , p. 57); alwet , MD; alhuet , NED (s.v. all what ). See What .

records.label: Al-weldand
records.text: Al-weldand , adj. all-wielding, S2; alwealdent , S.—AS. al-wealdend .

records.label: Al-weye
records.text: Al-weye , adv. all along, at all times, perpetually, at any rate, NED; alne-way , S2; alwey , C2, C3, PP; alwais , S2; alleweyes , NED.—AS. ealne weg .

records.label: Alynen
records.text: Alynen , v. to besmear; alyned , pp. , S2.—Lat. allinere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-lyue
records.text: A-lyue , adv. , adj. as pred. alive, C2, S2, PP; onlyue , C2, G; onliue , S.—AS. on life . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Am
records.text: Am , 1 pr. s. am, S, C3; æm , S, MD; ham , S; eam , MD; eom , MD.— ONorth. am , OMerc. eam (VP), AS. eom .

records.label: A-mad
records.text: A-mad , pp. as adj. distracted, mad, MD, S; amed , MD; amadde , pl. MD.—AS. ge-mǽd , pp. of ge-mǽdan , to madden; cp. OHG. ga-meit , foolish. ( A- 6 .)

records.label: Amaistrien
records.text: Amaistrien , v. to master, teach, PP; amaistrye , P, HD.—OF. amaistr ( i ) er ; Lat. ad + magistrare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Amalgame
records.text: Amalgame , sb. a soft mass, mixture of metal with mercury, NED; malgam NED.—OF. amalgame ; Low Lat. amalgama .

records.label: Amalgaming
records.text: Amalgaming , sb. the formation of an amalgam, C3.

records.label: A-mansien
records.text: A-mansien , v. to curse, to excommunicate, MD; amansi , MD; amansy , MD; amonsi , HD; amawns , HD; amansed , pp. , S.—Contracted from AS. á-mánsumian , to put out of intimacy, from mánsum , familiar, intimate; pp. á-mánsumod , also ámánsod ; see Schmid. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-masen
records.text: A-masen , v. to amaze, stupefy, NED; amased , pp. , C3. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Ambassade
records.text: Ambassade , sb. the function of ambassador, an ambassador and suite, NED; embassades , pl. , S3.—OF. ambassade , ambaxade ; OSp. ambaxada , from Low Lat. ambaxia , ambactia , office, employment, from ambactus , vassal, retainer, a Celtic word found in Caesar.

records.label: Ambassadrie
records.text: Ambassadrie , sb. ambassadorship, NED; embassadrie , S2, C3.—F. ambassaderie .

records.label: Ambassage
records.text: Ambassage , sb. embassy, NED; ambassages , pl. , S3.

records.label: Amblen
records.text: Amblen , v. to move at an easy pace, NED.—OF. ambler ; Lat. ambulare , to walk.

records.label: Amblere
records.text: Amblere , sb. an ambling horse or mule, C, NED.

records.label: Amellen
records.text: Amellen , v. to enamel, MD; ammell , Palsg.; amelled , pp. , Palsg.; amelyd , HD; amiled , HD; ameled , NED.—AF. aymeler , OF. esmailler ; OHG. smalzjan , to smelt, liquefy; cp. It. smaltare , to enamel (Florio). Cf. En-amelen , Mute .

records.label: Amenden
records.text: Amenden , v. to amend, mend, MD, S, S2, C2, W; amended , pp. S2; amendid , W2.—OF. amender ; Lat. * ē-mendare , from ex + mendum , fault. ( A- 9 .)

records.label: Amene
records.text: Amene , adj. pleasant, S3, NED; ameyn , S3.—OF. amene ; Lat. amoenum .

records.label: Amerant
records.text: Amerant , sb. amaranth, a fadeless flower, S3.—OF. amarante ; Lat. amarantum (acc.); Gr. ἀμάραντος ( A- 11 .)

records.label: Amercy
records.text: Amercy , v. to amerce, fine, P, NED.—AF. amercier ; from OF. estre a merci came estre amercie , then amercier .

records.label: Amete
records.text: Amete , sb. ant, emmet, NED; amte , W2; emete , Voc.; emote , NED; ematte , Voc.; amtis , pl. , W2; amptis , NED.—AS. ǽmete , émete . Cp. OHG. ámeiza ; from OHG. á , off + meizan , to cut, as if ‘the cutter or biter off.’

records.label: Ametist
records.text: Ametist , sb. amethyst, NED; ametistus , W (Rev. 21. 20); amatyste , HD; amaste , HD; amaffised , MD.—OF. ametiste ; Lat. amethystum (acc.); Gr. ἀμέθυστος ( A- 11 .)

records.label: Ameuen
records.text: Ameuen , v. to be moved, NED; ameued , pt. s. , C2.—OF. esmeuv- , accented stem of esmover ; Lat. exmouēre . ( A- 9 .)

records.label: A-midde
records.text: A-midde , adv. and prep. amid, S2, C2, PP; amidden , S; amydde , PP.—AS. on middan , on middum . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Amirail
records.text: Amirail , sb. a Saracen ruler or commander, an emir, an admiral, MD; amerel , Prompt.; amyralle , MD; amrayl , HD; admirald , S.—OF. amirail , amiral ; cp. Arab. amīr-al-bahr , commander of the sea, amīr-al-mūminīm , commander of the faithful.

records.label: A-mis
records.text: A-mis , adv. amiss, C2; amys , G; onmys , NED. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Amome
records.text: Amome , sb. an odoriferous plant, amomum, NED; amonye , W, HD.—OF. amome (Cotg.); Lat. amomum ; Gr. ἄμωμον , a name applied to several spice plants.

records.label: Amoneste
records.text: Amoneste , v. to admonish, warn, HD.—OF. amonester ; Late Lat. * admonitare , from Lat. admonitus , pp. of admonere , see Constans. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Amonestement
records.text: Amonestement , sb. admonishment, S, HD.—OF. amonestement .

records.label: Amonestyng
records.text: Amonestyng , sb. admonishing, CM.

records.label: A-monge
records.text: A-monge , prep. and adv. among, in, at intervals, PP; amange , NED; omang , MD; amang , S, S2; among , S, PP. Phr. : eure among , ever among, every now and then, S; ever and among , NED.—AS. on-mang , on-gemang . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-monges
records.text: A-monges , prep. among, S2, S3, C2, C3 G, PP.

records.label: A-morewe
records.text: A-morewe , on the morrow, S2, W; amor we , HD, PP, S2; amoreȝe , S; amorȝe , S (16. 432).—AS. on morgen . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Amountance
records.text: Amountance , sb. amount, NED; mountouns , S2, HD.

records.label: Amounten
records.text: Amounten , v. to ascend, rise, amount, mean, S2, C2, PP; amunten , S.—AF. amunter , from Lat. ad + montem . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Ampole
records.text: Ampole , sb. a vessel for holding consecrated oil, or for other sacred uses, NED; ampulles , pl. , P; ampolles , S2, PP; hanypeles , PP.—OF. ampole ; Lat. ampulla .

records.label: Ampre
records.text: Ampre , sb. a tumour, flaw, blemish; amper , HD; ampres , pl. , S.—AS. ampre , ‘varix’ (Voc.).

records.label: A-murðrin
records.text: A-murðrin , v. to murder, S; amorthered , pp. , MD.—AS. á-myrðrian (Schmid). ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Amyable
records.text: Amyable , adj. friendly, lovely, NED; amyabill , S3; amiable , WW.—OF. amiable ; Lat. amicabilem .

records.label: An
records.text: An , 1 pr. s. I grant, allow, S; on, pr. s. , S. See Unnen .

records.label: An
records.text: An , num. and indef. art. one, an, S, S2, PP; see Oon .

records.label: An
records.text: An , prep. on, upon, in, PP, S, S2; see On .

records.label: An
records.text: An , conj. and, if, PP, S, S2; see And .

records.label: Anaunter
records.text: Anaunter , for an aunter , a chance, S2; see Auenture .

records.label: Anchesoun
records.text: Anchesoun , sb. occasion, MD; ancheisun , MD; anchaisun , HD.—AF. anchesoun . See Achesoun .

records.label: Ancre
records.text: Ancre , sb. an anchorite, recluse, hermit, a monk, a nun, NED, S, S2; auncre , S2; anker , S2; ancres , pl. , P.—AS. ancra , m. (* ancre , f.); Church Lat. anachoreta ; Gr. ἀναχωρητής .

records.label: And
records.text: And , conj. and, also, if, G, S, S2, S3, C2 ant , S, S2; an , S, S2; a , MD.— Phr. : and if , MD.

records.label: Ande
records.text: Ande , sb. breath, H; see Onde .

records.label: Anefeld
records.text: Anefeld , sb. anvil, W2; anefelt , NED.—AS. onfilti (Voc.).

records.label: An-ent
records.text: An-ent , prep. and adv. on a level with, among, opposite, towards, in respect of, NED; anont , MD; onont , S; onond , S; anende , MD; anonde , MD; ononde , MD; anendes , MD; anentes , NED; anentis , W, W2; anemptis , MD; anempst , NED; anence , H; anens , H; ynentes , H.—AS. on efen , on efn , on emn , on even ground with.

records.label: Aner-ly
records.text: Aner-ly , adv. only, alone, S2, NED, JD.

records.label: Anete
records.text: Anete , sb. the herb dill, Voc., W, NED.—OF. anet ; Lat. anethum (Vulg.); Gr. ἄνηθον , dial, form of ἄνισον . See Anise .

records.label: A-netheren
records.text: A-netheren , v. to lower, humiliate, NED; anethered , pp. , HD. ( A- 1 .) See Aniðerien .

records.label: Anew
records.text: Anew , sb. ring, wreath; anewis , pl. , S3; aneus , links of a chain, NED.—OF. aniaus , pl. of anel , ring; Lat. anellus , dim. of ānulus , dim. of annus , a circuit, year.

records.label: Anew
records.text: Anew , enough, S3. ( A- 6.) See Ynow .

records.label: A-newe
records.text: A-newe , adv. anew, NED. ( A- 3 .) See Of-newe .

records.label: Anfald
records.text: Anfald , adj. single, simple, S, HD; see Oone-fold .

records.label: Angel
records.text: Angel , sb. angel; ongel , S; angles , pl. , S; ængles , S; anglene , gen. S.—Lat. angelus . See Engel .

records.label: An-gin
records.text: An-gin , sb. beginning, MD; angun , S, NED.

records.label: An-ginnen
records.text: An-ginnen , v. to begin; on gon , pt. s. , S.—AS. an- ( on- ) ginnan .

records.label: Angle
records.text: Angle , sb. a name given to the four astrological ‘houses,’ NED, S2.—OF. angle ; Latin angulum (acc.).

records.label: Angles
records.text: Angles , sb. pl. the English, the people of ‘Angul,’ a district of Holstein, S, NED; Englis , S.—AS. Angle , pl.

records.label: Angre
records.text: Angre , sb. affliction, sorrow, wrath, pain, inflammation, NED, S2, PP; angers , S2.—Icel. angr .

records.label: Angren
records.text: Angren , v. to annoy, injure, make angry, NED; angre , PP.—Icel. angra .

records.label: Angwisch
records.text: Angwisch , sb. anguish, W2; anguyssh , PP; angoise , S, MD; anguise , MD; anguisse , MD.—OF. angoisse , AF. anguisse ; Lat. angustia , tightness, from angere , to squeeze.

records.label: Anhed
records.text: Anhed , sb. unity, H; see Oonhed .

records.label: An-heiȝ
records.text: An-heiȝ , adv. on high, S2, PP; an hei , S2; an hey , S2; an hiȝ , W.

records.label: An-heten
records.text: An-heten , v. to heat, to become hot; anhet , pr. s. S; anhéét , pp. S.—AS. onhætan .

records.label: An-heȝen
records.text: An-heȝen , v. to exalt, NED; anheȝed , pp. , S2.

records.label: An-hitten
records.text: An-hitten , v. to hit against, S, MD.

records.label: An-hon
records.text: An-hon , v. to hang ( tr. ), MD; anhoð , pr. pl. , S; anhonge , pp. , MD.—AS. on-hón .

records.label: An-hongen
records.text: An-hongen , v. tr. and intr. to hang, S, MD; anhonged , pp. , MD; anhanged , C2.

records.label: Aniente
records.text: Aniente , v. to bring to nought, NED; anyente , PP.—OF. anienter , from a , to + nient ; Late Lat. * necentem = nec + entem . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Anientise
records.text: Anientise , v. to bring to nought, to destroy, NED; anientice , PP; anentisen , CM; anentesch , PP; anyntische , W2; neentishe , NED; annentissched , pp. CM; anyntischid , W2; enentyscht , H; enentist , H.—OF. anientir (variant of anienter ), pr. p. anientissant . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Anise
records.text: Anise , sb. anise, also dill, NED; anys , NED; aneyse , Voc.—OF. anis ; Lat. anisum ; Gr. ἄνισον . Cf. Anete .

records.label: A-niðerien
records.text: A-niðerien , v. to lower, humiliate, MD; aneðered , pp. MD, HD.—AS. á + niðerian . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Anker
records.text: Anker , sb. anchor, S.—AS. ancor ; Lat. ancora ; Gr. ἄγκυρα .

records.label: Anlas
records.text: Anlas , sb. a kind of dagger, anlace, MD, C; anelace , HD; anelas , MD, NED.—Cp. Low Lat. anelacius (Ducange), OWelsh anglas .

records.label: An-leth
records.text: An-leth , sb. face, countenance, MD, HD, NED; onndlæt , MD; onlete , MD.—Icel. andlit (Swed. anlete ): AS. and-wlíta .

records.label: Annamyllit
records.text: Annamyllit , pp. enamelled, S3; see Enamelen .

records.label: Annuel
records.text: Annuel , adj. yearly; sb. a mass said either daily for a year after, or yearly on the anniversary of a person’s death, NED; anuell , S3.—AF. annuel ; Late Lat. annualem , for Lat. annālem , from annus , year.

records.label: Annueler
records.text: Annueler , sb. a priest who sang an annual, PP, C3, HD.

records.label: An-on
records.text: An-on , adv. at once, instantly, soon, in a short time, S, S2, C3, PP; anan , S, NED; onan , S2; onon , S, S3; anoon , S3, C2, G, W.—AS. on án , into one; on áne , in one (moment).

records.label: Anon-ryght
records.text: Anon-ryght , adv. immediately, C3, G; anonrihtes , S; ananriht , S.

records.label: An-ouen
records.text: An-ouen , adv. above, S, NED; onuuen , NED.—AS. on ufan .

records.label: A-nough
records.text: A-nough , adj. (as pred. ) enough, CM; anew , S3. ( A- 6 .) See Ynow .

records.label: Anoy
records.text: Anoy , sb. discomfort, vexation, trouble, MD, S2, PP; anoye , W2; anui , MD; enuye , S.—OF. anoi : OSp. enoyo : OIt. inodio , from the Lat. phrase est mihi in odio ; see Diez. Cf. Noye .

records.label: Anoyen
records.text: Anoyen , v. to annoy, PP, W2, S2, C2, C3; anoiede , pt. s. , W; noyede , W; anoyed , pp. W; anuyed , PP; anuid , MD; anud , S; anuyȝed , S2; ennuyed , P.—AF. ennuyer . Cf. Noyen .

records.label: Answere
records.text: Answere , sb. answer, MD; ondswere , S; answare , S; onswere , S; andsware , S.—AS. and-swaru .

records.label: Answeren
records.text: Answeren , v. to give an answer, S, PP; ondswerien , S; andswarede , pt. s. S; andswerede , S; ontswerede , S; onswerede , S; onswerde , S; answarede , S; answerede , S.—AS. and-swarian .

records.label: Ant
records.text: Ant , conj. and, also, if, S, S2. See And .

records.label: Antem
records.text: Antem , sb. anthem, C2; antefne , MD.—AS. antefne ; Church Lat. antífona (cp. Prov. antífena , It. antífona ); for older antiphōna ; Gr. ἀντίφωνα lit. things sounding in response. Cf. Antiphone .

records.label: Anticrist
records.text: Anticrist , sb. Antichrist, MD; antecrist , W (1 John 4. 3); ancrist , MD; ancryst , Voc.—Church Lat. antichristus (Vulg.); Gr. ἀντίχριστος .

records.label: Antiphone
records.text: Antiphone , sb. antiphon, NED; Church Lat. antiphōna ; see Antem .

records.label: Antiphonere
records.text: Antiphonere , sb. anthem-book, C2; antyphonere , Voc.; anfenare , Voc.; amfanere , Voc.—Church Lat. antiphonarius .

records.label: Anum
records.text: Anum , adv. at once, S.—AS. ánum , dat. of án , one. [The MS. has anú , put for anū (= anu m )]. See Oon .

records.label: An-under
records.text: An-under , prep. under, S; anonder , S.

records.label: An-uppe
records.text: An-uppe , prep. and adv. upon, MD; onuppe , S.

records.label: An-uppon
records.text: An-uppon , prep. upon, S, MD; anuppen , S.

records.label: Anwalde
records.text: Anwalde , sb. dat. power, S; anwolde , S; see On-wald .

records.label: A-nyghte
records.text: A-nyghte , adv. by night, C2; aniȝt , S; onigt , S. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-nyghtes
records.text: A-nyghtes , adv. at night, nightly, Sȝ.

records.label: Apalled
records.text: Apalled , pp. made pale, NED; appalled , C, C2.—OF. apalir , apallir ; Lat. ad + pallire for pallere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aparail
records.text: Aparail , sb. apparel, PP; apparaille , C2, PP.

records.label: Aparailen
records.text: Aparailen , v. to make ready, to fit up, furnish, to dress, attire, PP; apparayleden , pt. pl. S2; aparailed , pp. S; apparailled , P.—OF. apareiller ; Late Lat. * adpariculare , to make equal or fit, from Lat. par , equal. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aparaunce
records.text: Aparaunce , sb. appearance, NED; apparence , C2.—AF. apparence . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Apart
records.text: Apart , adv. apart, aside, C2; aparte , separately, PP, NED.—OF. a part . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Apart
records.text: Apart , v. to set aside, separate, NED; aparte , S3 (24. 14).

records.label: Apartie
records.text: Apartie , adv. in part, partly, PP, NED. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Apayen
records.text: Apayen , v. to satisfy, please, to requite, HD, PP; apayd , pp. S3, C2, C3; apayed , C2, W; apaied , W, PP.—OF. apaier ( apayer ): Prov. apagar ; Lat. ad + pacare , from pacem , peace. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Ape
records.text: Ape , sb. ape, MD, C2, C3, P; fool, HD. Phr. : þe olde ape , i.e. the devil, MD; wyn of ape (= OF. vin de singe ), wine which makes the drinker pleasant, wanton, or boyish, Cotg., MD, HD.—AS. apa .

records.label: Apece
records.text: Apece , sb. the alphabet, Prompt.; see A-B-C .

records.label: Apenden
records.text: Apenden , v. to belong, S2, PP; appenden , S2, PP.—OF. ap ( p ) endre ; Lat. ad + pendere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aperceyue
records.text: Aperceyue , v. to perceive, C2, PP; aperseyue , PP.—OF. aperçoiv- , accented stem of aperceveir ; Late Lat. appercipēre ; Lat. ad + percipere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aperceyuinges
records.text: Aperceyuinges , sb. pl. observations, C2.

records.label: Aperen
records.text: Aperen , v. to appear, S, PP; apeeren , PP; aper , S2; appiere , P; apperand , pr. p. S3.—AF. aper- , stem of apert , pr. s. of aparoir ; Lat. apparere ( ad + parere ). ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Apert
records.text: Apert , adj. clever, expert, NED; aspert , S3.—OF. aspert , espert ; Lat. expertus . ( A- 9 .) See Expert .

records.label: Apert
records.text: Apert , adj. open, NED, H, HD; adv. C2. Phr. : in to apert (= Lat. in palam ), S2.—OF. apert ; Lat. apertus , pp. of aperire , a verb with ā = ab , prefix. ( A- 8 .)

records.label: Aperteliche
records.text: Aperteliche , adv. openly, S2; apertly , P, H; appertly , P.

records.label: Apertenaunt
records.text: Apertenaunt , pr. p. appertaining, C2.—OF. apertenant .

records.label: Apertene
records.text: Apertene , v. to appertain, NED, C3.—OF. apertenir ; Lat. ad + pertinere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Apertinent
records.text: Apertinent , pr. p. appertaining, C2.—Late Lat. adpertinentem .

records.label: Apesen
records.text: Apesen , v. to appease, NED, S3 (3b. 1352), C2, C3; appease , S3 (19a. 295).—OF. apeser , from a + pes ; Lat. pacem , peace. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Apeyren
records.text: Apeyren , v. to harm, diminish, impair, PP, W; apeyre , P, W; appayre , S2, P; apeyred , pp. S2.—OF. ampeirer , empeirer ; Lat. in + peiorare , to make worse, from peior , worse. ( A- 10 .)

records.label: Apeyryng
records.text: Apeyryng , sb. injuring, S2, W; appairing , S3.

records.label: A-piken
records.text: A-piken , v. to trim, adorn, MD; apiked , pp. , C. See OF. piquer (Cotg.).

records.label: Aplien
records.text: Aplien , v. to apply, devote one’s energies to, NED; apply , S3.—OF. aplier ; Lat. applicare .

records.label: Apointen
records.text: Apointen , v. to come or bring matters to a point, to agree, arrange, to prepare, equip, NED.—OF. apointer , from a point .

records.label: Apointment
records.text: Apointment , sb. agreement, NED; poyntemente , S3.—OF. apointement .

records.label: Aposen
records.text: Aposen , v. to question, S2, PP, Prompt.; apposen , C3, PP. Cp. Opposen .

records.label: Apostel
records.text: Apostel , sb. apostle, S; appostel , NED; appostil , NED; apostle , W; postlis , pl. NED.—AS. apostol ; Church Lat. apostolus (Vulg.); Gr. ἀπόστολος , one sent forth, messenger; cp. AF. apostle (OF. apostre ).

records.label: Apostil-hed
records.text: Apostil-hed , sb. office of apostle, W.

records.label: Apotecarie
records.text: Apotecarie , sb. apothecary, C; potekary , NED.—OF. apotecaire ; Late Lat. apothecarium (acc.), from apotheca ; Gr. ἀποθήκη , storehouse.

records.label: Apoyson
records.text: Apoyson , v. to poison, PP; apoysoned , pp. , PP.—OF. apoisoner , for empoisoner . ( A- 10 .)

records.label: Appairen
records.text: Appairen , v. to injure; appayre , S2, P; see Apeyren .

records.label: Appairing
records.text: Appairing , sb. injuring, S3.

records.label: Appel
records.text: Appel , sb. apple, PP; eppel , MD; applis , pl. W2.—AS. æppel .

records.label: Apple-garnade
records.text: Apple-garnade , sb. pomegranate, S2 ( garnade ). Cf. Garnet-appille .

records.label: Aprentis
records.text: Aprentis , sb. apprentice, NED; prentis , S2, PP; aprentys , pl. PP.—OF. aprentis (AF. aprentiz ), nom. of aprentif , from aprendre , to learn; Lat. apprehendere = ad + prehendere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-quenchen
records.text: A-quenchen , v. to quench, PP; acwenchen , S; aqueynte , pt. s. S2; aqueynt , PP.—AS. á-cwencan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Aquerne
records.text: Aquerne , sb. squirrel, S, NED; acquerne , S.—AS. ácwern (Voc.); cp. Icel. íkorni , G. eichhorn , MDu. éncoren .

records.label: Aqueyntaunce
records.text: Aqueyntaunce , sb. acquaintance, S2, CM, MD.—OF. acointance , AF. aqueyntance . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aqueynten
records.text: Aqueynten , v. to become known, MD; aquointe , pp. acquainted, NED; aquente , NED; aquynt , S2.—OF. acointer ( acuinter ); Late Lat. adcognitare , from Lat. ad + cognitum , pp. of cognoscere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Ar
records.text: Ar , prep. , conj. and adv. before, S, S2, G, H, P; see Er .

records.label: Ar
records.text: Ar , pr. pl. are, S2, PP; see Aren .

records.label: Arace
records.text: Arace , v. to pull up by the roots, C2, CM; arache , NED.—AF. aracer , OF. esrachier ; Lat. e ( x ) radicare . ( A- 9 .)

records.label: Aranye
records.text: Aranye , sb. spider, Prompt.; arain , HD; aranee , HD; eranye , Prompt.; erayne , Prompt.; erayn , H; arane , H; erane , Voc.; yreyne , W2; aran , H; irain , NED; arrans , pl. , HD; yreyns , W2.—OF. araigne ( iraigne ); Lat. aranea .

records.label: Arate
records.text: Arate , v. to correct, blame, rate, PP. Probably a variant of Aretten . Cf. OF. aratter = aretter (Godefroy).

records.label: Aray
records.text: Aray , sb. array, PP; array , S2 (19. 393), C2, C.—OF. arei ( arroi ).

records.label: Arayen
records.text: Arayen , v. to array, NED, PP; arayed , pp. W; arrayed , C2, C3.—AF. arayer ; OF. areier , areer : It. arredare (Florio); from Lat. ad + Low Lat. * rēdo (OF. rei ), preparation, of Teutonic origin. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Arblaste
records.text: Arblaste , sb. a military engine for throwing missiles, MD, S2; alblast , S2.—OF. arbaleste ; Late Lat. arcuballista .

records.label: Arblaster
records.text: Arblaster , sb. an arblast-man, S2.

records.label: Arch
records.text: Arch , sb. arch, Prompt.; arches , pl. court of Arches, P.—OF. arche (Cotg.).

records.label: Arch-
records.text: Arch- , prefix , chief; erche- , Church Lat. archi- ; Gr. ἀρχι-, ἀρχ- .

records.label: Arch-angel
records.text: Arch-angel , sb. archangel, S, PP; archangles , pl. S.—Church Lat. archangelus ; Gr. ἀρχάγγελος .

records.label: Arche-biscop
records.text: Arche-biscop , sb. archbishop, S; erchebissop , S2.—AS. ærce-biscop (S); Lat. archi- + AS. biscop .

records.label: Archer
records.text: Archer , sb. archer, S2; archeer , C2; harchere . Voc.—AF. archer . See Ark .

records.label: Archi-deken
records.text: Archi-deken , sb. archdeacon, PP; erchedekene , S2.

records.label: Archi-flamyn
records.text: Archi-flamyn , sb. high-priest, S2.—Church Lat. archiflamen , archbishop (Ducange), from Lat. flamen .

records.label: Archi-triclin
records.text: Archi-triclin , sb. the ruler of the feast, S; architriclyn , W.—Church Lat. architriclinus (Vulg.); Gr. ἀρχιτρίκλινος .

records.label: Arch-wyfe
records.text: Arch-wyfe , sb. a wife who rules; arche-wyues , pl. C2, CM.

records.label: Are
records.text: Are , sb. honour, reverence, also, grace, clemency, MD, NED, S; ore , S, S2, G, HD; happy augury, MD, S.—AS. áre ( ár ); cp. OHG. éra , honour (Otfrid).

records.label: Are
records.text: Are , sb. oar, MD; see Ore .

records.label: A-recchen
records.text: A-recchen , v. to explain, expound, to speak, NED.—AS. á-reccan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-rechen
records.text: A-rechen , v. to reach, to strike, to reach in thought, to imagine, to be sufficient, NED, S, S (ii. 47), S2, W, PP.—AS. á-rǽcan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-reden
records.text: A-reden , v. to declare, to interpret, NED, W; areede , W.—AS. á-rédan ; cp. G. errathen . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-redy
records.text: A-redy , adj. ready, P, HD, NED; ȝe-redi , MD. ( A- 6 .)

records.label: Are-full
records.text: Are-full , adj. compassionate, MD, S.—AS. ár-full .

records.label: Are-les
records.text: Are-les , adj. merciless, MD; oreleas , S; oreles , S.—AS. ár-léas .

records.label: Aren
records.text: Aren , v. to show mercy to, S, MD.— AS. árian .

records.label: Aren
records.text: Aren , pr. pl. are, S, PP; arn , MD, C2, PP; are , MD; ar , MD, S2, PP; ere , MD, S2; er , H.—ONorth. aron .

records.label: Arende
records.text: Arende , sb. errand; HD, PP; see Erende .

records.label: Arerage
records.text: Arerage , sb. the state of being in arrear, indebtedness, NED, PP; arrerage , C, PP.—OF. arerage , AF. arrerage .

records.label: Arere
records.text: Arere , adv. to the rear, in the rear, PP; Arrere , PP.—AF. arere ; Late Lat. ad retro , backward. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-reren
records.text: A-reren , v. to raise, build, to arise, to rear, S2, PP; arearen , S; areride , pt. s. , W; arerde , S; arerd , S; arerdon , pl. , S; arered , pp. , S2, W, W2; arerd , S2.—AS. á-rǽran : Goth. ur-raisjan . Causal of Arisen . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-rest
records.text: A-rest , at rest, PP. ( A- 2.)

records.label: Arest
records.text: Arest , sb. stop, S2; arreest , custody, C. Phr. : spere in arest , in rest, C.—OF. areste , stoppage, AF. arest , act of arresting. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aresten
records.text: Aresten , v. int. and tr. to stop, cause to stop, NED, C.—AF. arester ; Lat. ad + restare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aretten
records.text: Aretten , v. to reckon, count, accuse, NED, W, W2; aretted , pp. C; arettid , W, W2; rettid , W.—AF. aretter , OF. areter ; a + reter : OSp. reptar , to challenge (Minsheu); Lat. reputare , to count; cp. Late Lat. reptare (Ducange). ( A- 7 .) Cf. Retten .

records.label: A-reysen
records.text: A-reysen , v. to raise, to arouse, NED; areysed , pt. s. , S3; areisid , pp. , W. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Areȝth
records.text: Areȝth , sb. cowardice; areȝthe , dat. , S. See Arwe .

records.label: Arfeð
records.text: Arfeð , adj. difficult, MD; arefeð , S; earfeð , MD; arueð , NED; erfeð , MD.—AS. earfeðe ; cp. earfeðe , earfoþ , labour, toil: Goth. arbaiths .

records.label: Argoile
records.text: Argoile , sb. the tartar deposited from wines, C3, NED; arguyll , NED; argall , Cotg. (s.v. tartre ), ND.—AF. argoil .

records.label: Arguen
records.text: Arguen , v. to prove, to reason, PP.—OF. arguer ; Late Lat. argutare , from Lat. arguere .

records.label: Arguere
records.text: Arguere , sb. reasoner, PP.

records.label: Argument
records.text: Argument , sb. proof, clear proof, proof presumptive, NED; argumens , pl. , PP.—AF. argument ; Lat. argumentum .

records.label: Argumenten
records.text: Argumenten , v. to argue, C3, S2.

records.label: A-risen
records.text: A-risen , v. to arise, MD; aryse , PP; aris , imp. s. S; arys , PP; arist , pr. s. , S, S2, C3; aros , pt. s. , S, PP; aroos , PP; arisen , pp. , MD; arise , S2.—AS. á-rísan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-rist
records.text: A-rist , sb. rising, resurrection, NED; aristes , gen. , S; ariste , dat. , S.—AS. ǽ-ríst . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Ariue
records.text: Ariue , v. to arrive, to come to shore, S; aroue , pt. s. , NED; ariuede , pl. S2; aryue , pp. , S; aryven , NED.—AF. ariver ; Late Lat. arribare , arripare , adripare , from Lat. ad + ripa , shore. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Ariue
records.text: Ariue , sb. landing, arrival, C, NED.

records.label: A-rixlien
records.text: A-rixlien , v. to rule; arixlye , S. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-riȝt
records.text: A-riȝt , adv. in a right way, straightway, S2; aryght , C2; ariȝte , S; origt , S. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Ark
records.text: Ark , sb. an ark, chest, MD; arrke , S; arc , S2.—Lat. arca ; cp. OF. arche .

records.label: Ark
records.text: Ark , sb. segment of a circle, C2, MD.—OF. arc ; Lat. arcum (acc.), a bow.

records.label: Arles
records.text: Arles , sb. an earnest, NED, JD, HD.—Probably a plural in form from an OF. * erle , * arle ; Lat. * arrhula , dim. of arrha , for arrhabo ; Gr. ἀρραβών ; Heb. ‘érábón . Cp. OF. erres , arres : Sp. arras (Minsheu); Lat. arrhas , pl. acc. of arrha . See Ernes .

records.label: Arly
records.text: Arly , adj. and adv. early, S2, H; see Erly .

records.label: Arm
records.text: Arm , sb. arm, MD; earmes , pl. , S, MD; armes , interj. arms! an oath, by God’s arms, S3, NED. Phr. : Gog’s arms , S3.—AS. earm : Icel. armr : Goth. arms .

records.label: Arm
records.text: Arm , adj. poor, wretched, MD; ærm , MD; erme , dat. S; arme , pl. S; earme , MD.—AS. earm : Icel. armr : Goth. arms .

records.label: Armen
records.text: Armen , v. to arm, C3, PP; i-armed , pp. , S.—AF. armer ; Lat. armare .

records.label: Armes
records.text: Armes , sb. pl. weapons, coat-armour, MD, P.—AF. armes .

records.label: Arm-heorted
records.text: Arm-heorted , adj. tender-hearted, S.—Cp. AS. earm-heort .

records.label: Arm-hertnesse
records.text: Arm-hertnesse , sb. compassion, S.

records.label: Arminge
records.text: Arminge , sb. the act of arming, putting on of armour, C2.

records.label: Armipotent
records.text: Armipotent , adj. mighty in arms, C.—Lat. armipotentem .

records.label: Armony
records.text: Armony , sb. harmony, S3.—F. harmonie ; Lat. harmonia ; Gr. ἁρμονία .

records.label: Armure
records.text: Armure , sb. armour, weapons, P, C2, C3, G; armoure , C2; armuris , pl. , W, W2.—AF. armure ( armoure ), armeure ; Lat. armatura .

records.label: Arn
records.text: Arn , sb. eagle, HD; aryn , H; see Ern .

records.label: Arnde
records.text: Arnde , pt. s. ran, S; see Rennen .

records.label: A-rode
records.text: A-rode , on the rood (the cross), NED, S, S2. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-rowe
records.text: A-rowe , adv. in a row, one after another, S; areawe , S; arewe , NED. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Arr
records.text: Arr , sb. scar, wound, NED, JD; ar , HD; see Erre .

records.label: Arred
records.text: Arred , pp. scarred, JD.

records.label: Arsenik
records.text: Arsenik , sb. arsenic, C3.—OF. arsenic ; Lat. arsenicum ; Gr. ἀρσενικόν , yellow orpiment, orig. the masculine, male, from ἄρσην , a male.

records.label: Arskes
records.text: Arskes , pl. newts, S2; see Ask .

records.label: Arsmetike
records.text: Arsmetike , sb. arithmetic, NED; arsmetrike , C.—OF. arismetique : Prov. arismetica ; Lat. arithmetica ; Gr. ἀριθμητική (τέχνη) , the art of counting.

records.label: Arst
records.text: Arst , adj. and adv. superl. first, G, P; see Erst .

records.label: Art
records.text: Art , sb. a quarter of the heaven, point of the compass, NED, S3; airt , NED, JD; airth , NED; airtis , pl. , S3.—Gael. ard ; OIr. aird , top, height, point.

records.label: Artou
records.text: Artou , art thou, S2; artow , S2, C2, C3. See Ert .

records.label: Arwe
records.text: Arwe , sb. arrow, NED; arewe , S2; arwes , pl. S2, C2, P; arewis , W2; arowis , W2.—AS. arwe for * arhwe ; cp. Goth. arhwazna , arrow, the thing belonging to the bow, from * arhw = Lat. arcus .

records.label: Arwe
records.text: Arwe , adj. cowardly, timid, lazy, sluggish, vile, base, Prompt.; areȝ , S; arh , MD; arȝ , NED; erewe , S; arewe , sb. betrayer, enemy, S, MD.—AS. earg ( earh ); Icel. argr ; cp. OHG. arg (Otfrid).

records.label: Arwed
records.text: Arwed , pp. made cowardly, PP.

records.label: Arȝen
records.text: Arȝen , v. to be timid, to frighten, NED.

records.label: As
records.text: As , sb. unit, a single bit, a jot, ace, NED, C2; ace , S3; ase , PP. Phr. : ambes as , double aces, C2.—OF. as ; Lat. as .

records.label: Asailen
records.text: Asailen , v. to leap upon, assail, PP; assaile , PP, S; assaille , C2, PP; asailid , pp. , PP; assalȝeit , S2.—AF. assailir , OF. asalir ; Late Lat. adsalire . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-saken
records.text: A-saken , v. to deny, renounce; asoke , pt. s. , S.—AS. of-sacan (Schmid). ( A- 3 .) Cf. Of-saken .

records.label: Asaut
records.text: Asaut , sb. assault, S2; assaut , C, PP.—OF. asaut . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Ascapie
records.text: Ascapie , v. to escape, PP; askapie , PP; ascapen , PP.—OF. escaper (Picard). Cf. Achape .

records.label: Ascaunce
records.text: Ascaunce , conj. as though, C3, NED.

records.label: Asche
records.text: Asche , sb. ash, cinis ; aische , W, W2; aske , H; asken , pl. , S; axen , S; asshen , C2; asskess , S; asshes , C3; aschis , W2; askes , S2, P; askis , H; askez , S2.—AS. asce ( axe ): Icel. aska : Goth. azgo .

records.label: Ascrien
records.text: Ascrien , v. to cry out, NED; escrien , MD.—OF. escrier ; Late Lat. ex + quiritare , see Diez.

records.label: Ascrive
records.text: Ascrive , v. to ascribe, H.—OF. ascriv- stem of pr. p. of ascrire : It. ascrivere ; Lat. adscribere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Ascry
records.text: Ascry , sb. outcry, S2.

records.label: Asegen
records.text: Asegen , v. to besiege, C.—OF. asegier : It. assediare (Florio). ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aselen
records.text: Aselen , v. to seal up, to set one’s seal to, NED; aseele , W2; asselen , PP, S2.—OF. anseler , enseler ; Late Lat. insigillare , from sigillum , seal. ( A- 10 .) Cf. Ensele .

records.label: A-senchen
records.text: A-senchen , v. to cause to sink, S; aseynt , pp. , MD. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Asent
records.text: Asent , sb. assent, S2, PP; assent , C3, PP.—OF. as ( s ) ent . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aseth
records.text: Aseth , sb. satisfaction, PP, HD; aseeth , W; asethe , Cath., HD; assyth , JD; assetz , PP; asseth , NED, HD.—OF. aset , asset ; from Late Lat. ad satis . For the final -t in OF. = þ in English, cp. OF. feit with ME. feiþ , faith. Hence our assets . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-setnesse
records.text: A-setnesse , sb. appointed order, S.—AS. á-setnis , institute (Schmid).

records.label: A-setten
records.text: A-setten , v. to set up, appoint, NED.—AS. á-settan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Asise
records.text: Asise , sb. decree, edict, judgment, S2; assise , C, G; assises , pl. assizes, PP.—OF. as ( s ) ise , a sitting down, settlement of imposts, from as ( s ) is , pp. of as ( s ) eeir , to sit at, to settle; Lat. assidere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Asisour
records.text: Asisour , sb. juror, PP; acisoure , PP; sisour , PP; sysour , PP.

records.label: Ask
records.text: Ask , sb. a newt or eft, a lizard, NED, HD, JD; aske , NED; asker , HD, JD, DG; askis , pl. , NED; arskes , S2.—AS. áðexe : OS. egithassa ; cp. OHG. egidehsa (G. eidechse ).

records.label: Aske
records.text: Aske , sb. ash, H; askes , pl. , S2, P; askis , H; see Asche .

records.label: Aske-baðie
records.text: Aske-baðie , sb. one who sits among the ashes, S; askebathe , NED.

records.label: Aske-fise
records.text: Aske-fise , sb. one who blows the ashes, Prompt.; askfist , NED. Cp. Sw. askefis and G. aschenfister (Grimm).

records.label: Asken
records.text: Asken , v. to ask, S, S2; eskien , MD; aschen , MD; eschen , MD; esse , MD, S2; ocsien , MD; acsien , MD, S2; axien , MD, S2; axen , S, S2, S3, C2, C3, W, W2; escade , pt. s. , S; easkede , S; haxede , S; esste , S2.—AS. áscian : OHG. eiscón (Otfrid); cp. G. heischen .

records.label: A-slaken
records.text: A-slaken , v. to diminish, to become slack, C, NED. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-slawe
records.text: A-slawe , pp. slain, S2; aslaȝe , S; aslaȝen S.—AS. á-slagen , pp. of á-sléan , see Sievers, 378. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-slepe
records.text: A-slepe , adv. asleep, S, PP.—AS. on slǽpe . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-slepid
records.text: A-slepid , pp. gone to sleep, W2.

records.label: A-sonder
records.text: A-sonder , adv. asunder, C, C3.—AS. on sundran . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-soylen
records.text: A-soylen , v. to absolve, to answer (a question), PP, S2; assoile , S3, C3, P, G; asoyly , NED; asoilede , pt. s. , S2; asoylede , S2; assoylid , pp. , W.—OF. asoiler , assoiler ; Late Lat. absoluere (= Lat. absolovere ). ( A- 8 .)

records.label: Aspaltoun
records.text: Aspaltoun , sb. asphalt, S2.—OF. * aspaltoun ; from Late Lat. asphalton ; Gr. ἄσφαλτον .

records.label: Aspect
records.text: Aspect , sb. a term in astrology; the relative positions of the heavenly bodies as they appear at a given time, NED, SkD, Sh.; aspectis , pl. , S3.—Lat. aspectus . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Aspert
records.text: Aspert , adj. expert, clever, S3; see Apert .

records.label: Aspie
records.text: Aspie , sb. spy, W, W2; aspye , C3; aspy , S3.—OF. espie .

records.label: Aspien
records.text: Aspien , v. to look after, to watch, S2, S3, W, W2.—OF. espier . See Espye .

records.label: Aspiere
records.text: Aspiere , sb. spy, W.

records.label: A-spillen
records.text: A-spillen , v. to destroy, kill, S. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Aspiyng
records.text: Aspiyng , sb. ambush, W.

records.label: Aspre
records.text: Aspre , adj. rough, cruel, fierce, NED.—OF. aspre ; Lat. asprum , rough, harsh.

records.label: Asprely
records.text: Asprely , adv. roughly, fiercely, S3; asperliche , NED.

records.label: A-squint
records.text: A-squint , adv. obliquely, out at the corner of the eyes, S.

records.label: Assay
records.text: Assay , sb. trial, experiment, an attempt, attack, tested quality, NED, S2, S3, C2, C3; asaie , W.—AF. assai ( asai ): It. assaggio ; Lat. exagium , a weighing, from ex-agere ( exigere ), to weigh, prove, to drive out the tongue of the balance.

records.label: Assayen
records.text: Assayen , v. to examine, to attack, S2, S3, C2, P; asaien , W2; asayen , S3; assaied , pp. , W.—AF. assayer ( asayer ): It. assaggiare .

records.label: Assemble
records.text: Assemble , sb. assembly, P.—OF. asemblee .

records.label: Assemblen
records.text: Assemblen , v. to bring together, to come together, NED; assembled , pp. , C3.—OF. asembler ; Lat. assimulare .

records.label: Assiduel
records.text: Assiduel , adj. continual, H; asseduel , H.—OF. assiduel .

records.label: Assiduelly
records.text: Assiduelly , adv. continually, H.

records.label: Assoilen
records.text: Assoilen , v. to loosen, absolve, explain, PP, S3, C3; see Asoylen .

records.label: Assoillyng
records.text: Assoillyng , sb. absolution, acquittal, C.

records.label: Astate
records.text: Astate , sb. state, estate, S3; see Estat .

records.label: A-sterten
records.text: A-sterten , v. to start up, to happen, to escape, NED, S2, S3, C3, C; astart , S3; asterted , pt. s. , S2, C3. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-stiȝen
records.text: A-stiȝen , v. to proceed, ascend, descend, MD; astighð , pr. s. , S; astah , pt. s. , S.—AS. á-stígan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Astonen
records.text: Astonen , v. to stupefy, amaze, NED; astony , NED, C2; astonyed , pp. , W, PP; astoynde , S3.—OF. estoner ; Late Lat. * extonare , to stupefy as with a thunderbolt. ( A- 9 .)

records.label: Astore
records.text: Astore , v. to repair, to provide, store, NED; astorede , pt. s. , S2; astored , pp. , C; astorid , W2.—AF. estōrer , OF. estaurer ; Lat. instaurare . ( A- 10 .) Cf. Enstore .

records.label: A-strangeled
records.text: A-strangeled , pp. suffocated, S2, ( A- 6 .) See Strangelyn .

records.label: Astronomye
records.text: Astronomye , sb. astronomy, PP.—OF. astronomie ; Lat. astronomia ; Gr. ἀστρονομία .

records.label: Astronomyen
records.text: Astronomyen , sb. astronomer, astrologer, PP; astromyenes , pl. (= Lat. magi), W; astrymyanes , PP.—OF. astronomien .

records.label: Asure
records.text: Asure , sb. azure, NED, C2, C.—OF. asur , azur ; Low Lat. lazur ( lazulus ); Pers. lajward .

records.label: Aswagen
records.text: Aswagen , v. to assuage, C2, PP.—AF. as ( s ) uager : Prov. assuaviar ; from Lat. suauis . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-swelten
records.text: A-swelten , v. to die, S, NED. ( A- 1 .)

records.label: Aswithe
records.text: Aswithe , adv. as quickly as possible, S2, PP; asswythe , S2; see Alswithe .

records.label: A-swowne
records.text: A-swowne , pp. as adv. aswoon, C2; assowe , HD.—AS. ge-swógen , see NED (s.v. aswoon ) and SkD (s.v. swoon ). ( A- 6 .)

records.label: A-syde
records.text: A-syde , adv. aside, C2. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: At-
records.text: At- , prefix (1), at; et- ; a- .—AS. æt- .

records.label: At-
records.text: At- , prefix (2), from, away; et- .—AS. æt- for oð- proclitic form of * úð- , away: Goth. unþa- ; cp. Du. ont- , OHG. int- (G. ent- ).

records.label: At
records.text: At , pron. rel. and conj. that, S2, S3, H, NED; see Þat .

records.label: At
records.text: At , prep. at, in, with, from, of, amongst, PP, S, S2, C2; et , S; æt , S; ed , S; at , used with the infin. mood , S2, NED (vi), H. Comb. :— atte , at the, PP, S, S2, C2; ate , S, S2; ette , S; eter , S; atten , S2, PP; at-after , after, C2; att-alle , in every way, S2; at-foren , before, MD; et-foren , S; at-uore , S2; at-om , at home, S2, PP; at-on , at one, in accord, NED, S; at oon , G (s.v. oon ), C2; at-ones , at once, together, PP, C2, C3; attonis , S3; attonys , S3; attones , S3.

records.label: Atache
records.text: Atache , v. to arrest, indict, S2, PP; attache , PP; atteche , S3, NED; atachet , pp. , S2, PP.—AF. attacher ; cp. It. attaccare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: A-take
records.text: A-take , v. to overtake, catch, C3, HD, NED. Phr. : wel atake , well caught, NED. ( A 1.)

records.label: Atamen
records.text: Atamen , v. to cut into, broach, open (a vessel), NED, PP, HD; attamen , HD, Prompt., C2.—OF. atamer : Prov. ( en ) -tamenar ; Lat. attaminare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Atazir
records.text: Atazir , sb. influence (astrological term), S2, S3. Cp. Sp. atazir ; Arab. at-tâthîr , ’al + tâthîr , influence, see Steingass, Arab. Dict. , p. 157, and Dozy’s Glossary , s.v. atacir .

records.label: At-beren
records.text: At-beren , v. to bear away, NED; atbar , pt. s. , HD.—AS. æt-beran . ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-breken
records.text: At-breken , v. to break away, escape, NED. ( At- 2.)

records.label: Ate
records.text: Ate , sb. eating, S. See Eten .

records.label: Atel
records.text: Atel , adj. terrible; atell , NED.—AS. atol ; cp. Icel. atall .

records.label: Atelich
records.text: Atelich , adj. horrible, S; eatelich , S.—AS. atelic .

records.label: Ateliche
records.text: Ateliche , adv. horribly, S.—AS. atelice .

records.label: Atempre
records.text: Atempre , pp. as adj. temperate, H; attempre , C, HD.—OF. atempré ; Lat. attemperatus . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Atemprely
records.text: Atemprely , adv. temperately, H, HD.

records.label: A-tenden
records.text: A-tenden , v. to set on fire, kindle, MD; atend , pr. s. , S. ( A- 2 .) Cf. Ontenden .

records.label: At-ewen
records.text: At-ewen , v. to show, to appear; atewede , pt. s. , NED; atywede , S; atawed , pp. , MD.—AS. æt-éawan ( æt-ýwan ): Goth. at-augjan , from augo , the eye; cp. OHG. ougen , to show (Otfrid). Cf. Awnen . ( At- 1.)

records.label: Ateynt
records.text: Ateynt , pp. convicted, affected with sorrow, PP; atteynt , S3; attaynt , S3.—OF. ateint , pp. of ateindre , to attain; Lat. attingere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: At-fallen
records.text: At-fallen , v. to fall away, NED.—AS. æt-feallan . ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-fleon
records.text: At-fleon , v. to flee away, NED; atfliþ , pr. s. , S.—AS. æt-fléon . ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-fore
records.text: At-fore , prep. before, NED; atuore , S2; etforen , S; afore , NED.—AS. æt-foran . ( At- 1.) Cf. Afore .

records.label: At-gangen
records.text: At-gangen , v. to go away, MD; atgo , MD, NED. ( At- 2.)

records.label: Ath
records.text: Ath , sb. oath, S; see Oth .

records.label: Athamaunte
records.text: Athamaunte , sb. adamant, C; see Adamant .

records.label: Athel
records.text: Athel , adj. and sb. of good birth, noble, a lord, NED, S, S2; hathel , NED, S2; hathill , NED; hatell , NED.—AS. æðele , eðele : OS. eðili : OTeut. * aþalis , of good family, from * aþal , race, family; cp. OHG. adal (Otfrid).

records.label: Aþeling
records.text: Aþeling , sb. a member of a noble family, a noble, a prince of the blood royal, NED; eþelyng , S.

records.label: A-þestrien
records.text: A-þestrien , v. to darken, S.—AS. á-þéostrian . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-þet
records.text: A-þet , conj. until that, S. See Oth .

records.label: At-holden
records.text: At-holden , v. to withhold, retain, S; athælde , S; ethalden , S; athalde , S; etholden , S; ethalt , pr. s. , S; atheold , pt. s. , S; atholde , pp. , S.—AS. óð-healdan . ( At- 2.)

records.label: Atiffen
records.text: Atiffen , v. to adorn, deck the person, S.—OF. atiffer , cp. atifer (Cotg.) ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Atisen
records.text: Atisen , v. to stir up, urge, entice, NED attyse , HD; attice , NED.—OF. atiser , to kindle (Bartsch); Late Lat. attitiare , from ad + titium (for titio ) a brand (Voc.), see Ducange, s.v. atticinari . For the change of ti into soft s as well as into ç see Brachet, s.v. agencer . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Atlien
records.text: Atlien , v. to think, suppose, intend, to direct one’s way, to go, MD; attle , MD; attele , S2; etlien , MD; etteleden , pt. pl. , S2.—Icel. ætla ( etla ); related to OHG. ahtón , to consider.

records.label: Atlinge
records.text: Atlinge , sb. purpose, conjecture, MD; etlunge , S.

records.label: At-reden
records.text: At-reden , v. to outdo in counsel, C, NED. ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-rennen
records.text: At-rennen , v. to run away, to surpass in running, C, MD; att-rann , pt. s. , S; at-ornde , NED. ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-rinen
records.text: At-rinen , v. to touch, to befall, NED; att-ryne , MD.—AS. æt-hrínan . ( At- 1.)

records.label: At-routen
records.text: At-routen , v. to rush away, escape, S2; at-ruten , NED. From AS. hrútan . ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-scheoten
records.text: At-scheoten , v. to shoot away, MD; atschet , pt. s. , S; atschote , pp. NED. ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-stonden
records.text: At-stonden , v. to withstand, S; edstonden , S, NED. ( At- 2.)

records.label: At-stonden
records.text: At-stonden , v. to remain, to stop, NED, S2; etstonden , NED; atstonde , pp. , S.—AS. æt-standan . ( At- 1.)

records.label: Attame
records.text: Attame , v. to broach, to cut into, HD, C2; see Atamen .

records.label: Atteir
records.text: Atteir , sb. attire, S3; see Atyre .

records.label: Atter
records.text: Atter , sb. poison, venom, esp. of reptiles, NED, S; hatter , NED.—AS. attor , for * átor , átr , (Voc.); cp. OHG. eitar , eittar (Otfrid).

records.label: Atter-coppe
records.text: Atter-coppe , sb. spider, NED, S; attercop , HD.—AS. attor-coppa .

records.label: Atter-lich
records.text: Atter-lich , adj. venomous, bitter; atterluche , NED.

records.label: Atter-liche
records.text: Atter-liche , adv. bitterly, NED.

records.label: Atter-lothe
records.text: Atter-lothe , sb. an antidote to poison, applied spec. to various plants, NED, Voc., HD.—AS. attor-láðe .

records.label: Attern
records.text: Attern , adj. venomous, cruel, HD, NED; hatterne , NED.—AS. ættern , ættren . See Atter .

records.label: Attice
records.text: Attice , v. to stir up, NED; see Atisen .

records.label: Attour
records.text: Attour , sb. array, dress, head-dress, HD; atour , NED; aturn , S.—OF. atour , aturn , from aturner , atorner ; Lat. ad + tornare , to round off.

records.label: Attri
records.text: Attri , adj. venomous, S, HD; attriȝ , NED; wattri , S2.—AS. ættrig . See Atter .

records.label: A-tweyne
records.text: A-tweyne , in twain, PP. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: At-witen
records.text: At-witen , v. to reproach, twit, S.—AS. æt-wítan . ( At- 1.)

records.label: At-witen
records.text: At-witen , v. to depart, NED; atwot , pt. s. , MD. ( At- 2.)

records.label: A-two
records.text: A-two , in two, S2, C2, C3, PP; ato , S2. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-twynne
records.text: A-twynne , in two, apart, W, G, PP; atwinne , C3; atwynny , W; otwinne , S; otwyn , H. ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Atyre
records.text: Atyre , sb. equipment, dress, head-dress, PP, Cath.; atir , S2; atteir , S3; atyr , HD.

records.label: Atyren
records.text: Atyren , v. to attire, NED; atyred , pp. , PP; atired , PP; tyred , S2.—OF. atirer . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Auchtene
records.text: Auchtene , num. eighteen, S3; see Eightene .

records.label: Aucte
records.text: Aucte , sb. property, S; see Auhte .

records.label: Auctoritee
records.text: Auctoritee , sb. authority, C2, C3; autorite , S3; auctorite , C.—AF. autorite , auctorite ; Lat. auctoritatem .

records.label: Auctour
records.text: Auctour , sb. author, C, C2, HD; auctor , S3; autour , S3, NED.—AF. autour ; Lat. auctorem , from augere , to make to grow, to originate.

records.label: Augrim
records.text: Augrim , sb. arithmetic, S; see Algorisme .

records.label: Auh
records.text: Auh , conj. but, S; see Ac .

records.label: Auht
records.text: Auht , adj. worthy, valiant, doughty, NED (s.v. aught ); aȝt , S2, MD; oht , S; aht , NED; æht , MD.—AS. áwiht ( áht ). Cf. Ought .

records.label: Auhte
records.text: Auhte , sb. possessions, NED; auht , S2; ahte , S2; eahte , MD; ahhte , S; agte , S, S (15. 2090); eihte , MD, S; echte , S; ehte , S; eyhte , S; aihte , S; ayhte , S; aucte , S; aght , S2.—AS. ǽht : Goth. aihts . See Owen .

records.label: Auhte
records.text: Auhte , pt. s. ought, S; aucte , owned, S; see Owen .

records.label: Aul
records.text: Aul , sb. an awl; aule , NED; owel , S; aules , pl. , S.—AS. awel (Voc.); cp. OHG. ala (G. ahle ).

records.label: Aulf
records.text: Aulf , sb. elf, SkD; auph , SkD; awf , HD; ouphe , Sh.; oaf , SkD.—Icel. álfr . Cf. Elf .

records.label: Aumener
records.text: Aumener , sb. an alms-purse, a purse, NED, HD.—OF. aumoniere ; Low Lat. * almosinaria ( bursa ).

records.label: Aumoner
records.text: Aumoner , sb. almoner, alms-giver, NED; aumonere , S2, NED; aumenere , HD; amner , HD.—OF. aumoner ; Church Lat. * almosinarius , from * alimosina . See Almesse .

records.label: Auncel
records.text: Auncel , sb. a kind of balance and weight, NED, S2, PP; auncer , PP; auncere , P, HD.—AF. auncelle for * launcelle ; Late Lat. lancella (cp. It. lancella ), ‘a kind of measure,’ (Florio); dim. of Lat. lanx ( lancem ), a plate, a scale of a balance.

records.label: Auncessour
records.text: Auncessour , sb. ancestor, NED; ancessour , NED, HD.—AF. ancessur ; Lat. antecessorem .

records.label: Aunceter
records.text: Aunceter , sb. predecessor, ancestor, NED, S2, CM; ancestre , NED; auncestre , NED; aunsetters , pl. , NED, HD; aunceteres , HD.—AF. auncestre , ancestre ; Lat. ante-cessor .

records.label: Auncien
records.text: Auncien , adj. old, whilom, ex-; sb. an old man, an elder (title of dignity), a senior member of an Inn of Court, NED; auncient , S3 (25. 136), HD.—AF. auncien , OF. ancien ; Late Lat. antianum (cp. It. anziano ), for ante-anum , from Lat. ante , before.

records.label: Auncre
records.text: Auncre , sb. anchoress, nun, S2; see Ancre .

records.label: Aunder
records.text: Aunder , sb. afternoon, HD; see Undern .

records.label: Aunders-meat
records.text: Aunders-meat , sb. afternoon’s collation, Cotg. (s.v. reciné ), HD. Cp. Goth. undaurni-mats .

records.label: Aungel
records.text: Aungel , sb. angel, messenger, W; aunge , HD; aungeles , pl. , S2, C3; aungels , W2 (Ps. 90. 11).—AF. angele . Cf. Angel , Engel .

records.label: Auntour
records.text: Auntour , sb. chance, adventure, S2; aunter , S3. Comb. : anaunter , for an aunter , in case, S2; see Auenture .

records.label: Auntren
records.text: Auntren , v. to adventure, S3, G, PP.—OF. aventurer .

records.label: Auntrous
records.text: Auntrous , adj. adventurous, C2, PP.

records.label: Auote
records.text: Auote , adv. on foot, S2; see A-fote .

records.label: Auter
records.text: Auter , sb. altar, S, S2, C, C2, C3, P, W, W2; awter , S3, HD.—OF. auter , alter ; Lat. altare .

records.label: Autorite
records.text: Autorite , sb. authority, C; see Auctoritee .

records.label: Autour
records.text: Autour , sb. author, S3; see Auctour .

records.label: Auailen
records.text: Auailen , v. to avail, PP; auailȝe , B; auaille , C2, PP, S2; auayle , PP, Prompt.; awayled , pt. s. , S2.—Cp. OF. vail ( l ) e , from valoir ; Lat. ualere .

records.label: Aual
records.text: Aual , imp. s. fell, cause to fall, S; see A-fallen .

records.label: Aualen
records.text: Aualen , v. to descend, to lower, MD, S2, S3, B; availl , B; availed , pp. , S3.—OF. avaler , from phr. à val ; Lat. ad uallem , to the valley. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Auaunce
records.text: Auaunce , v. to advance, NED, S3, C, C3, P; awance , S3; avaunset , pp. , S2; auanced , S2.—OF. avancer .

records.label: Auauncement
records.text: Auauncement , sb. advancement, G; auancement , S2.

records.label: Auaunt
records.text: Auaunt , adv. , and interj. forward, away, NED.—AF. avaunt , OF. avant ; Late Lat. ab-ante .

records.label: Avaunt
records.text: Avaunt , sb. boast, vaunt, C, NED. See Auaunten .

records.label: Auauntage
records.text: Auauntage , sb. superiority, advantage, NED, S3, C; auantage , S2, C3.—AF. avantage , from avant , before.

records.label: Avaunten
records.text: Avaunten , v. to speak proudly of, to commend, to boast, NED, W2.—OF. avanter ; Lat. ad + Late Lat. vanitare , to boast. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Avauntour
records.text: Avauntour , sb. boaster, C; auaunter , NED.—OF. avanteur . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Auentaille
records.text: Auentaille , sb. the moveable front of a helmet, C2, HD.—AF. aventaille , OF. esventail ; Late Lat. * exventaculum , airhole. ( A- 9 .)

records.label: Auente
records.text: Auente , v. to get air by opening the aventaille, HD, NED.

records.label: Auenture
records.text: Auenture , sb. chance, a chance occurrence, jeopardy, S, S3, C, C3, G, PP; auentur , S2; auntour , S2; aunter , S3, PP; antur , MD; eventour , HD. Comb. : an auenture , lest perchance, PP; on auenture , in case, PP; anaunter , for an aunter , S2; in auenture , PP.—AF. aventure ; Lat. aduentura , a thing about to happen. ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Auer
records.text: Auer , sb. property, a beast of burden, HD.—AF. aver (pl. avers ); OF. aveir ( avoir ); Lat. habere , to have.

records.label: Auerous
records.text: Auerous , adj. greedy, H, HD, CM; auerouse , W, W2, PP; auarous , S2, PP, NED.—OF. averus . See Auer .

records.label: Auerylle
records.text: Auerylle , sb. April, NED; aueril , S2; auerel , PP.—OF. avril ; Lat. aprilis , from aperire . See Apert .

records.label: A-ulem
records.text: A-ulem , imp. s. drive away, S; see Aflemen .

records.label: Auoide
records.text: Auoide , v. to empty, to make of no effect, to make void, to remove, to move away, retire, to avoid, NED, W; auoyde , W; auoyd , WW, Sh.; auoided , pp. , W, W2.—AF. avolder ; OF., esvuidier ; es , out + vuidier , to empty. ( A- 9 .)

records.label: Avouter
records.text: Avouter , sb. adulterer, W2; avowtere , Prompt.—OF. avoutre , aöutre ; Lat. adulterum . For intercalated v see Brachet (s.v. corvée ).

records.label: Avoutrer
records.text: Avoutrer , sb. adulterer, HD; auoutreris , pl. , W; avowtreris , W2.

records.label: Avoutresse
records.text: Avoutresse , sb. adulteress, W.—OF. avoutresse .

records.label: Avoutrie
records.text: Avoutrie , sb. adultery, PP, CM, W, HD; avoutry , Cath.; avowtrie , NED, W; avowtery , NED; auowtries , pl. , W.—OF. avoutrie , aöuterie , aülterie ; Lat. adulterium .

records.label: Auowe
records.text: Auowe , sb. vow, S3, PP, Prompt.; auow , S2, C, C3, G; auou , PP; auowis , pl. , W, W2.

records.label: Avowen
records.text: Avowen , v. to bind with a vow, NED, W ( Acts. 23. 14), P.—OF. avoer ; Late Lat. advotare , from Lat. uotum ; from uouere . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Avowen
records.text: Avowen , v. to call upon or own as defender, patron, or client, to avow, acknowledge, NED, S3, C3, PP.—AF. avower , OF. avouer , avoer ; Lat. ad-vocare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Avowry
records.text: Avowry , sb. patronage, a patron saint, NED; vorie , NED.—AF. avouerie , from OF. avoeor ; Lat. aduocatorem .

records.label: Avoy
records.text: Avoy , interj. exclamation of surprise, fear, remonstrance, NED, C, HD.—OF. avoi .

records.label: Auys
records.text: Auys , sb. opinion, advice, C3; avise , PP.—OF. avis .

records.label: Auyse
records.text: Auyse , v. to observe, consider, give advice, S2, C2, C3, H, PP; auisen , PP, S2.—AF. aviser ; Late Lat. advisare . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Auysely
records.text: Auysely , adv. advisedly, H; auisili , W.

records.label: Auysement
records.text: Auysement , sb. consideration, C2; auisement , S2.

records.label: Auysyon
records.text: Auysyon , sb. vision, S3; auision , C, S2.—OF. avision (Bartsch).

records.label: A-wakenen
records.text: A-wakenen , v. intrans. to awake, S; awakenin , S; awakened , pp. , S.—AS. on-wæcnan . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-wakien
records.text: A-wakien , v. intrans. to awake, S; awalk ( for awakk ?), imp. , S3; awoik , pt. s. , S3; awoilk ( for awoikk ?), S3.—AS. awacian (for on-wacian ). ( A- 2 .)

records.label: A-way
records.text: A-way , adv. on way, onward, along, away (from a place), NED; awai , PP; awezz , S; awei , S; ewei , S2; owai , S2; aweye , C3, PP; away , interj. away, S2, NED.—AS. aweg , on weg . ( A- 2 .)

records.label: Awayte
records.text: Awayte , v. to await, watch, S2, S3, PP; awaite , PP; awaitie , NED.—AF. awaitier ; OF. aguaitier . ( A- 7 .)

records.label: Awayte
records.text: Awayte , sb. a lying in wait, watching, NED, C.—AF. await ; OF. aguait .

records.label: Away-ward
records.text: Away-ward , adv. , adj. turned away, wayward, NED, PP awaywarde passing away, H.

records.label: Awe
records.text: Awe , sb. awe, C, C2; aȝe , NED.—Icel. agi ( OTeut. * agon ). Cf. Eȝe .

records.label: A-wecchen
records.text: A-wecchen , v. to arouse out of sleep, NED, HD; aweihte , pt. s. , NED; aweightte , HD; aweht , pp. , NED.—AS. á-weccan ; cp. OHG. ar-wekkan (Tatian): Goth. uswakjan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-weden
records.text: A-weden , v. to become mad, S2, NED.—AS. á-wédan . ( A- 1 .)

records.label: A-wei
