records.label: Cal-stocke
records.text: Cal-stocke , sb. , cabbage-stalk, S3; calstok , Voc.; calstoke , Palsg.; castock , JD; custoc , JD. See Cole .

records.label: Camamelle
records.text: Camamelle , sb. camomile, Voc.; camemille , Voc.; camamyle , Prompt.; cammamyll , Palsg.; camomylle , MD; cammamyld , S3; camamy , Voc.—Late Lat. camamilla ; Gr. χαμαίμηλον .

records.label: Camel
records.text: Camel , sb. camel, MD; camelle , Prompt.; camaille , C2; chamelle , Prompt.; chamayle , MD.—OF. camel ; Lat. camelum (acc.); Gr. κάμηλος ; Heb. gāmāl .

records.label: Cameline
records.text: Cameline , sb. camlet, MD.—OF. cameline ; Low Lat. camelinum .

records.label: Camelot
records.text: Camelot , sb. camlet, SkD; chamelot , S3; chamlet , Cotg.—OF. camelot (Cotg.); cp. Low Lat. camelotum .

records.label: Cammamyld
records.text: Cammamyld , sb. camomile, S3; see Camamelle .

records.label: Camp
records.text: Camp , sb. contest, MD; comp , S; kemp , JD; kampe , dat. , MD.—AS. camp ( comp ); cp. Icel. kapp .

records.label: Campe
records.text: Campe , adj. See Kempe .

records.label: Campen
records.text: Campen , v. to contend, contest, esp. at foot-ball, MD, Prompt.—AS. campian .

records.label: Campynge
records.text: Campynge , sb. pedipiludium , game of foot-ball, Prompt.

records.label: Can
records.text: Can , pr. s. can, knows, S, S2. Phr. : can þanc , S; see Kunnen .

records.label: Canceler
records.text: Canceler , sb. chancellor, S; see Chaunceler .

records.label: Candel
records.text: Candel , sb. candle, MD; kandel , S; candlen , pl. S2.—AS. candel ( condel ); Lat. candela ; cp. Icel. kyndill , candle, torch.

records.label: Candel-messe
records.text: Candel-messe , sb. Candlemass, MD; candel-masse , dat. , S, S2.—Cp. Icel. kyndill-messa , in Church Lat. candelaria , the feast of the Purification.

records.label: Canelle
records.text: Canelle , sb. cinnamon, S2, Voc., Cath. ( n ); canylle , Cath.; canel , W, W2.—AF. canelle ; Late Lat. canella , cinnamon, also, a reed (Ducange), from Lat. canna . See Canne .

records.label: Canevas
records.text: Canevas , sb. canvas, C3; canvas , Voc.; canwas , Voc.—AF. canevas , canevace ; Late Lat. canabacius , hempen cloth; from OF. canve (F. chanvre ), hemp; Late Lat. cannabum , Lat. cannabis ; Gr. κᾶνναβις .

records.label: Cang
records.text: Cang , adj. foolish, lustful, MD; canges , sb. gen. , fool’s, S; kanges , pl. , MD. See PP; Notes, (p. 241).

records.label: Cangen
records.text: Cangen , v. to befool, MD.

records.label: Cang-liche
records.text: Cang-liche , adv. foolishly, MD.

records.label: Cang-schipe
records.text: Cang-schipe , sb. foolishness, MD.

records.label: Canker
records.text: Canker , sb. cancer, a disease, MD, W; cankyr , Voc.; cankere , Voc.—Lat. cancer , crab, an eating tumour, also, in pl. cancri , lattice-work.

records.label: Cankerd
records.text: Cankerd , pp. corrupted, S3.

records.label: Canne
records.text: Canne , sb. cane, reed, MD; cane , Voc.—Lat. canna ; Gr. κάννα, κάννη , cane, reed; Heb. qāneh .

records.label: Canne
records.text: Canne , sb. can, MD, W; cane , Voc. Cp. Late Lat. canna , a measure for liquids; see Weigand (s.v. Kanne ).

records.label: Canon
records.text: Canon , sb. a rule, MD, PP; canoun , MD; canon-law, PP.—Lat. canon ; Gr. κανών , a rule, standard, from κάνη, κάννη , a cane, reed. See Canne .

records.label: Canonisen
records.text: Canonisen , v. to admit into the canon of the Mass, to canonize, MD; to consecrate, admit to the dignity of the papacy, MD.—Late Lat. canonizare .

records.label: Canonistres
records.text: Canonistres , sb. pl. men skilled in canon-law or ecclesiastical law, PP.—OF. canoniste ; Late Lat. canonista .

records.label: Canoun
records.text: Canoun , sb. a canon of a chapter, MD; kanun , S; chanoun , S, Voc., C3, G; chanon , C3.—OF. canone , canoine ( chanoine ); Church Lat. canonicum (acc.) one on the church-roll or list ( canon ).

records.label: Cant
records.text: Cant , adj. lively, brave, cheerful, MD, S2, JD.

records.label: Cant
records.text: Cant , sb. a portion, S3; corner, SkD, ND.—OF. cant ; cp. It. canto , corner (Florio).

records.label: Cantel
records.text: Cantel , sb. edge, piece, bit, MD, C, Prompt., Palsg.; kantel , MD; cantle , Sh., ND.—OF. cantel (F. chanteau ).

records.label: Caper-cailye
records.text: Caper-cailye , sb. capercailyie, JD.—Ir. capull-coille , lit., the horse of the forest. See Capul .

records.label: Capitain
records.text: Capitain , sb. captain, C2; capitayne , S3.—OF. capitain ; Late Lat. capitaneum (acc.) captain, from Lat. caput .—Cf. Cheuetayn .

records.label: Capitle
records.text: Capitle , sb. the sum, the chief point, W; see Chapitre .

records.label: Cappe
records.text: Cappe , sb. cap, MD; keppen , pl. , S.

records.label: Capret
records.text: Capret , sb. a wild goat, W2; capretis , pl. , W2.—Late Lat. capretus ; cp. F. chevrette .

records.label: Capul
records.text: Capul , sb. horse, nag, MD, Prompt., PP, HD; capil , MD; capel , C3; caple , MD, PP, HD.—Icel. kapall ; Lat. caballus ; cp. Ir. capull , Wel. ceffyl .

records.label: Caracter
records.text: Caracter , sb. a mark, sign, character, W; carecter , W; carracte , Palsg.; carecte , PP; carect , W; caractes , pl. , HD; carectes , PP.—Lat. character ; Gr. χαρακτήρ , an engraved mark; cp. Prov. caracta .

records.label: Carayne
records.text: Carayne , sb. carrion, S2; see Caroigne .

records.label: Carboncle
records.text: Carboncle , sb. a precious stone, MD; carbokyl , Voc.; charboncle , MD; charbucle , MD; charbocle , C2.—OF. carboncle ( carboucle , charboucle ); Lat. carbunculum (acc.).

records.label: Carde
records.text: Carde , sb. teasel, Prompt.;—OF. carde ; Late Lat. cardum (acc.), from Lat. carduus , thistle.

records.label: Carden
records.text: Carden , v. to card wool, MD, Prompt., S3.—OF. carder , It. cardare (Florio).

records.label: Cardiacle
records.text: Cardiacle , sb. pain about the heart, PP, Cath. ( n. ), C3; cardyacle , Prompt.; cardiakylle , Cath., Voc.; cardiake , Cath.—OF. cardiaque , a malady of the heart (Cotg.); Late Lat. cardiaca , ‘cordis passio’; Gr. καρδιακός , from καρδία , the heart. For the intrusion of l see Cronique .

records.label: Care
records.text: Care , sb. grief, S, C3, G; cayr , S3; kare , S2.—AS. cearu : OS. kara ; cp. OHG. chara .

records.label: Care-full
records.text: Care-full , adj. full of grief, S3, C; karful , S2; carefullich , adv. anxiously, P; carfuli , S2.

records.label: Caren
records.text: Caren , v. to be anxious, MD; karien , S; cared , pt. s. , G; pl. , P.—AS. cearian .

records.label: Carf
records.text: Carf , pt. s. cut, C2; see Keruen .

records.label: Carited
records.text: Carited , sb. charity, S; see Charitee .

records.label: Carl
records.text: Carl , sb. a man, rusticus , colonus , maritus , MD, C3.—Icel. karl ; cp. OHG. karl (Otfrid).

records.label: Carl-man
records.text: Carl-man , sb. a man; carman , MD; caremane , MD; carlmen , pl. , S.—Icel. karlmaðr ( karmaðr ), a man, male.

records.label: Carme
records.text: Carme , sb. a Carmelite friar; karmes , pl. , S3.—OF. Carme (Bartsch); from Church Lat. Carmelus ; Heb. Carmel , ‘cultivated land.’

records.label: Caroigne
records.text: Caroigne , sb. carrion, MD, PP, C; caroyne , MD, PP; caroin , S2; careyne , MD, PP; careyn , W2; carayne , MD, S2; caraing , MD; karyun , H; carion , MD; caren , MD; karyn , MD; careyns , pl. W.—OF. caroigne (F. charogne ); cp. It. carogna ; from Lat. caro , flesh. See Crone .

records.label: Carole
records.text: Carole , sb. a round dance, singing, MD; karole , a chain, MD; caroles , pl. , C; carolles , MD.—OF. carole ( carolle ); It. caróla , a dance, song (Florio); Low Lat. carola , karola , a dancing, also, a chain (of pearls), see Ducange; Lat. corolla , a wreath; dimin. of corona .—ALM. For another account of this word see SkD.

records.label: Carolen
records.text: Carolen , v. to dance in a ring, to sing, MD, PP.

records.label: Carolinge
records.text: Carolinge , sb. carolling, C3.

records.label: Carpen
records.text: Carpen , v. to talk, to speak, to say, MD, C, S3; to rebuke, S3; carpede , pt. s. , S2; carped , S2, P.—Icel. karpa , to boast.

records.label: Carpyng
records.text: Carpyng , sb. talking, P.

records.label: Carre
records.text: Carre , sb. car, cart, Prompt.; charre , MD; chare , Voc., S3, W; schare , carpentum , Voc.; char , S2, S3, C, C2; chaar , MD; charis , pl. , W, W2, H.—OF. carre , also car ( char ); Lat. carrum (acc.). A Celtic word, cp. OIr. carr (Windisch).

records.label: Carry
records.text: Carry , v. carro vehere , to carry, MD; carien , C2; to drive, ride, travel, S2; y-caried , C2.—AF. carier (OF. charier , charroier ); Late Lat. carricare ( carrigare ), see Duncange. See Chargen .

records.label: Carte
records.text: Carte , sb. chariot, cart, MD; kart , H (Ps. 67. 18).

records.label: Cary
records.text: Cary , sb. a rough material, S3; see Cauri-mawry .

records.label: Casse
records.text: Casse , sb. box, chest, cover, Prompt.; kace , Prompt.; caas , C.—OF. casse (AF. chasse ); Lat. capsa ; cp. Gr. κάψα .

records.label: Cast
records.text: Cast , sb. a throw, plan, intention, plot, MD, C, G; caste , P; kastis , pl. , H.—Icel. kast .

records.label: Castel
records.text: Castel , sb. village, small town (= castellum ), W; castels , pl. , camp (= castra ), W2; kastels , H (Ps. 77. 32).—Late Lat. castellum , village (Vulg.), Lat. castellum , fortress.

records.label: Castel
records.text: Castel , sb. castle, S.—OF. castel ( chastel ). See above.

records.label: Castel-weorces
records.text: Castel-weorces , sb. pl. fortifications, S, MD.

records.label: Casten
records.text: Casten , v. to cast, throw, to consider, imagine, purpose, design, S, S2, S3, C; kasten , MD, H; kesten , MD, S2; caste , pt. s. , MD, S2, S3, C2, C3, G; kast , S2; kest , S3; casten , pl. , P, W; kesten , S2, W; castiden , W; casten , pp. , MD, C2; i-cast , S; y-cast , C3; ikest , S2; kest , S2; cast , C3. Phr. : caste tornes , tried tricks, G.—Icel. kasta .

records.label: Castyng
records.text: Castyng , sb. a vomiting, W.

records.label: Cat
records.text: Cat , sb. cat, Voc., MD; catt , Voc.; kat , S.

records.label: Catapuce
records.text: Catapuce , sb. name of a purgative plant, euphorbia, C; catapus , CM.—OF. catapuce ( petite ), garden spurge (Cotg.); Low Lat. catapotium , ‘medicamentum quod non diluitur, pillula’ (Ducange); Gr. καταπότιον , that can be gulped down, a pill, from πότος , drink. Cp. Low Lat. cathapucia , ‘semen spurgie,’ SB.

records.label: Cat-cluke
records.text: Cat-cluke , sb. trefoil, S3, JD; catluke , JD; ketelokes , pl. , H (Ps. 36. 2).

records.label: Catel
records.text: Catel , sb. capital, property, wealth, CM, MD, S2, C2, C3, W; kateyl , S2; catelle , S2; catele , S2; chatel , MD; chetel , MD.—OF. catel , chatel ; Late Lat. captale , capitale , property, principal; from Lat. capitalis , from caput , the head.

records.label: Catour
records.text: Catour , sb. a buyer of provisions, caterer, Palsg., G; cater , S3.—OF. acateur , buyer, from acater (F. acheter ), achapter ; Late Lat. accaptare .

records.label: Caucion
records.text: Caucion , sb. security, surety, account, MD; caucioun , W.—Lat. cautionem , security, bond, warranty, from cautus , pp. of cauere , to be on one’s guard.

records.label: Caudron
records.text: Caudron , sb. cauldron, W2.—AF. caudron , OF. chaudron . See Chaud .

records.label: Cauri-maury
records.text: Cauri-maury , sb. the name of a coarse rough material, PP; caurimauri , S2; kaurymaury , PP; cawrymawry , PP ( n. ). Cf. Cary .

records.label: Cautele
records.text: Cautele , sb. caution, deceit, MD, Prompt.; cawtele , S3; cautel , ND, Sh.—OF. cautele ( cautelle ); Lat. cautela .

records.label: Cautelous
records.text: Cautelous , adj. sly, deceitful, MD, ND, Sh.; cautelouse , W2.—OF. cautelos ; Late Lat. cautelosum (Ducange).

records.label: Cavell
records.text: Cavell , v. to divide by lot, JD; see Keuel .

records.label: Cawmyt
records.text: Cawmyt , pp. calmed, S3; see Calmen .

records.label: Cedre
records.text: Cedre , sb. cedar, MD, W2 (Job 40. 12); cedres , pl. , S2.—AF. cedre ; Lat. cedrum (acc.); Gr. κέδρος .

records.label: Cedyr-tre
records.text: Cedyr-tre , sb. cedar-tree, Voc.; sydyre-tre , Voc.

records.label: Ceelen
records.text: Ceelen , v. to line the walls or roof of a room, Prompt., MD; selyn , Prompt.; seeled , pp. , WW (s.v. cieled ).

records.label: Ceinte
records.text: Ceinte , sb. girdle, MD; seynt , C.—OF. ceinte ; Lat. cincta , pp. f. of cingere .

records.label: Celer
records.text: Celer , sb. cellar, promptuarium , Prompt., W (Lu. 12. 24), MD; celler , MD; seller , G; selleer , G; celere , dat. S, H; celeris , pl. , W2; selers , W2.—AF. celer , OF. celier ; Lat. cellarium .

records.label: Celerer
records.text: Celerer , sb. cellarer, C2.

records.label: Celicall
records.text: Celicall , adj. heavenly, S3.

records.label: Celle
records.text: Celle , sb. cell, a religious house, C, C2; selle , C; selles , pl. , P.—OF. celle ; Lat. cella .

records.label: Celure
records.text: Celure , sb. canopy, ceiling; see Selure .

records.label: Cementing
records.text: Cementing , sb. hermetically sealing, C3. See Syment .

records.label: Cendal
records.text: Cendal , sb. a fine stuff (linen or silk), S, MD; sendal , PP, ND, C; cendel , MD, HD, Prompt.; sendel , PP, H; = Lat. sindon , W, Voc.; cendell , Palsg.; sendalle , Cath.; sendylle , sandalium , sindo , Cath.—OF. and AF. cendal (cp. Low Lat. cendalum , sendalum ); perhaps an adaptation of Gr. σινδών , orig. Indian muslin, from Skt. Sindhu , India.

records.label: Centaure
records.text: Centaure , sb. centaury, name of a plant, C; centorye , Alph.—OF. centaure ; Lat. centaurea , centaureum ; Gr. κενταύρειον , from κένταυρος , a centaur.

records.label: Ceptre
records.text: Ceptre , sb. sceptre, C2, MD, Palsg.; ceptyr , Prompt.; ceptire , H (Ps, 44. 8).—AF. ceptre ; Lat. sceptrum ; Gr. σκῆπτρον , staff.

records.label: Cerchen
records.text: Cerchen , v. to search, MD; cergyn , Prompt.; serchen , MD; sherch , S3; seirsand , pr. p. , S3; sherched , pt. pl. , S3.—OF. cercher ( sercher ); Lat. circare , to go round, from circus , a circle.

records.label: Cercle
records.text: Cercle , sb. circle, MD, C; sercle , Prompt., W2.—OF. cercle ; Lat. circulum (acc.), dimin. of circus .

records.label: Cerclen
records.text: Cerclen , v. to circle, MD; sirculit , pp. , S3.—OF. cercler ; Lat. circulare .

records.label: Circulat
records.text: Circulat , adj. revolving, S3.

records.label: Cere
records.text: Cere , v. to cover with wax, SkD, C3; cered , pp. shrouded in waxed cloth, SkD.—Lat. cerare , to wax, from cera , wax.

records.label: Cere-cloth
records.text: Cere-cloth , sb. waxed linen (for dead bodies), Sh.; searcloth , SkD.

records.label: Cerements
records.text: Cerements , sb. pl. (see above), Sh.

records.label: Cerge
records.text: Cerge , sb. wax taper, MD; serge , MD, JD, Cath.; cerges , pl. , S.—OF. cerge , cierge ; Late Lat. ceria , fem. from Lat. cereus , from cera , wax.

records.label: Cerial
records.text: Cerial , adj. sacred to Ceres, C.—Lat. Cerialis , Cerealis .

records.label: Ceriously
records.text: Ceriously , adv. minutely, with full details, S2, C3; see Seryowsly .

records.label: Certes
records.text: Certes , adv. certainly, S, C2, C3; sertes , S2, PP; certis , S3, P.—OF. certes , (Constans): OSp. certas ; Lat. certas , pl. f. of certus , certain.

records.label: Ceruse
records.text: Ceruse , sb. ceruse, white lead, with which women painted their faces, MD; ceruce , C.—OF. ceruse (Cotg.); Lat. cerussa ; cp. Gr. κηρωτόν , a cerate or salve used as a cosmetic, from κηρός , bees-wax.

records.label: Cessen
records.text: Cessen , v. to cease, C2, C3; cesen , MD.—AF. cesser ; Lat. cessare .

records.label: Cetewale
records.text: Cetewale , sb. zedoary, a root resembling ginger, MD, C2, Prompt., SB; setewale , MD, HD; setwale , Prompt.; setuale , Prompt.; sedewale , MD; sedwale , MD; zedewale , Alph.—AF. cetewale , OF. citoual , citouart ; Low Lat. zedoarium ; Arab. jadwár (from the Persian).

records.label: Ceðen
records.text: Ceðen , sb. pl. countries, S; see Cuððe .

records.label: Chaf
records.text: Chaf , sb. chaff, straw, MD; chaff , MD; chaffe , W, Prompt.; chef , MD; caf , H; cafe , H.—AS. ceaf .

records.label: Chaffare
records.text: Chaffare , sb. business, selling, merchandise, S2, C2, C3; chaffar , C3; chafare , S; cheffare , S; chapfare , MD; cheapfare , MD.—AS. céap + faru , a journey, business; cp. Icel. kaupför .

records.label: Chaffaren
records.text: Chaffaren , v. to chaffer, S2, C3, P, W.

records.label: Chaflet
records.text: Chaflet , sb. a small stage or platform, S3, HD.—A dimin. of OF. chafaut , chaffaut , see Ducange (s.v. chaaffallum ). See Skaffaut .

records.label: Chaine
records.text: Chaine , sb. chain; chayne , MD; cheyne , Prompt., C2; chyne , MD.—AF. chaine ( cheine ); OF. chaäine , cadene ; Lat. catena .

records.label: Chaire
records.text: Chaire , seat, chair, MD; chayere , MD; chaier , W2; chaere , S, MD.—AF. chaiëre , chayëre , seat, throne; Lat. cathedra ; Gr. καθέδρα .

records.label: Chald
records.text: Chald , adj. cold, S; see Cold .

records.label: Chalenge
records.text: Chalenge , sb. false claim, accusation, claim, MD, W2; calenge , MD; chalaunge , MD.—AF. chalenge , chalange , OF. calenge ; Lat. calumnia .

records.label: Chalengen
records.text: Chalengen , v. to accuse, charge, claim, MD, W, S2, P; chalange , H; calengynge , pr. p. , W2; chalangede , pt. s. , S2; chalanged , pp. accused, P.—AF. chalenger , chalanger , ‘calumniate.’

records.label: Chalengere
records.text: Chalengere , sb. accuser, W2.

records.label: Chamber
records.text: Chamber , sb. chamber, MD; chambur , MD; schambyr , Voc.; chambre , C2, C3, PP; chombre , MD; chaumbre , MD, PP; chawmere , MD; chamer , Voc.; chalmer , S3.—AF. chambre ; Lat. camera .

records.label: Chamberere
records.text: Chamberere , sb. handmaid, MD, S2, C2; chambrere , MD; chomberier , MD.—OF. chamberiere .

records.label: Chamberling
records.text: Chamberling , sb. chamberlain; chaumberling , MD; chamberlein , MD; schamberleyne , Voc.; chamberlayn , MD; chamerlane , Voc.—OF. chambrelenc (cp. It. camerlengo in Florio); OHG. chamarlinc ; Lat. camera + OHG. -linc . On the suffix see SkD.

records.label: Chamelot
records.text: Chamelot , sb. camlet, S3; see Camelot .

records.label: Champaine
records.text: Champaine , adj. and sb. level, level country, CM, S3.—AF. champaigne .

records.label: Champartie
records.text: Champartie , sb. share in land, partnership in power, C; chanpartye , S3.—OF. champart , field-rent, see Cotg.; Lat. campi partem .

records.label: Champion
records.text: Champion , sb. a fighter in the duel, a champion, MD; champioun , C, G.—AF. champion ; Late Lat. campionem .

records.label: Chape
records.text: Chape , sb. the locket of a scabbard, Cotg., Cath.; schape , Cath. ( n. ).—OF. chappe (Cotg.).

records.label: Chapele
records.text: Chapele , sb. chapel, S, MD; chapelle , MD; schapelle , Voc.—AF. chapele , OF. capele ; Church Lat. capella .

records.label: Chapelein
records.text: Chapelein , sb. chaplain, MD; chapeleyne , MD, C; chapeleyns , pl. , S2.—AF. chapelein ; Church Lat. capellanus .

records.label: Chapiter
records.text: Chapiter , sb. the capital of a column, SkD.—OF. chapitel ; Lat. capitellum , dimin. of caput .

records.label: Chapitre
records.text: Chapitre , sb. a chapter, division of a book, a meeting of clergy, MD, PP; chapiter , S3; chapitere , PP; chapitle , PP; chapitele , PP; capitle , summary, W.—OF. chapitre , chapitle ; Lat. capitulum , dimin. of caput .

records.label: Chapitre-hous
records.text: Chapitre-hous , sb. chapter-house, PP; chapitel-hous , PP.

records.label: Chapman
records.text: Chapman , sb. merchant, C, PP; chapmon , S2, PP; chepmon , S; chapmen , pl. , S, S2, C3, PP.—AS. céapman .

records.label: Chapmanhode
records.text: Chapmanhode , sb. trade, S2, C3.

records.label: Chapolory
records.text: Chapolory , sb. a kind of scarf, S3; see Scaplorye .

records.label: Char, Chare
records.text: Char, Chare , sb. car, S3; see Carre .

records.label: Charbocle
records.text: Charbocle , sb. carbuncle (stone), C2; see Carboncle .

records.label: Charen
records.text: Charen , v. to turn, S; see Cherren .

records.label: Charge
records.text: Charge , sb. a load, injunction, responsibility, MD, S2, C3, C, W; charche , MD; carke , S3; karke , MD; cark , MD, G.—AF. charge , also kark .

records.label: Chargen
records.text: Chargen , v. to put a load on, to enjoin, MD, S2; to care for, W, W2; charchyng , pr. p. , S3; y-charged , pp. , S2; charged , S2.—AF. charger ; OF. cargier ; Late Lat. carricare . See Carry .

records.label: Chargeouse
records.text: Chargeouse , adj. burdensome, W; chariouse , W2.

records.label: Charitee
records.text: Charitee , sb. charity, C2; charyte , S2; charite , MD, S2, G; carited , S; kariteþ , MD.—AF. charite , OF. caritet , Prov. caritat ; Lat. caritatem . Cf. Cherte .

records.label: Chariȝ

records.text: Middel-erd , sb. the middle abode, the world, S; middeleard , S; myddelerd , S, PP; midelerd , S; mydlerd , S2, PP; mydelerd , PP; medlert , JD.—Cp. OS. middilgard , OHG. mittila gart (Tatian). Cf. Middeneard .

records.label: Midden-eard
records.text: Midden-eard , sb. the middle abode, the abode of men, S; middenærd , S; middenard , S; midenarde , dat. , S.—AS. middan-eard for middan-geard , ‘middle enclosure’ (OET), the earth situated between heaven and hell, see Sweet, and Sievers, 214, n. 5; cp. records.label: Middes
records.text: Middes , only in phr. : in middes , in the midst, PP; in þe myddes , PP, S2; in (fro) þe myddis , PP, S3, W, W2; in the mydis , W2.—From mid , adj. The -es gives the phrase an adverbial force . The older forms (in Layamon) are a midde , a midden ; AS. on middan .

records.label: Midwif

records.text: Mightand , pr. p. , as adj. having might, S2.

records.label: Mihte
records.text: Mihte , pt. s. might, S; micte , S; michte , S; migte , S; see Mahte .

records.text: Milce , sb. mercy, S, S2, HD; mylce , S; milche , S.—AS. milts , from milde , mild, gentle; see Sievers, 198, 4.

records.text: Milde , adj. mild, S, S2; myld , S. Comb. : mild-heorte , merciful in heart, SD; mild-heorted , S; milde-herted , S2; mild-herrtleȝȝc , mildheartedness, compassion, S; mild-heortnesse , clemency, S; mildhertnesse , S.—AS. milde .

records.text: Miles , sb. pl. , animals, S2.—Cf. W. mil , an animal, beast; miled , a wild animal (W. W. S.).

records.label: Mines

records.label: Minion

records.label: Minion
records.text: Minion , adj. small, pretty; mynyon , ND; mynionly , adv. delicately, ND.

records.text: Mint , pt. s. purposed, S; see Munten .

records.label: -mint

records.text: Minute , sb. a mite, moment of time, HD; mynute , Prompt.; mynutis , pl. , small pieces of money, W. Comb. : mynutwhile , PP; myntwhile , PP; myntewhile , PP.—Lat. minutum (Vulg.). Cf. Mite .

records.text: Minyshe , v. to minish, S3; see Menusen .

records.label: Misliche
records.text: Misliche , adv. badly, miserably, S; missely , wrongly, S2.

records.text: Misse , sb. want, lack, fault, S; mysse , S, PP.

records.text: Missen , v. to miss, SD; mis , S2; mysseþ , pr. s. , is without, PP.

records.label: Mistiloker
records.text: Mistiloker , adj. comp. more mystic, PP; mystiloker , PP.

records.label: Moillier
records.text: Moillier , sb. woman, wife, PP; muliere , PP; moylere , P.—OF. moillier , muiller ; Lat. mulierem ; cp. AF. mulier , muller .

records.label: Mok
records.text: Mok , sb. muck, filthy lucre, PP; muk , PP; mukke , Prompt.

records.text: Moky , adj. misty, HD. Cf. Moich .

records.text: Mole , sb. the moldwarp, talpa , Sh.; mowle , S3; molle , Prompt.—This word is short for molde-warp . See above.

records.label: Molte
records.text: Molte ( for molt ), pt. s. melted, S3; see Melten .

records.text: Momelen , v. to mumble, PP; mamely , P.

records.text: Mon , 1 pr. s. I must, B; pr. s. , B; 2 pr. s. , S3; mone , mayest, S2; pr. s. , shall, S2; man , 1 pr. s. , SD; 2 pr. pl. , S2, B; mun , pr. s. , S2, H.—Icel. munu , ‘debere’, pr. s. man (pl. munu ).

records.label: Mon
records.text: Mon , sb. man, S; see Man .

records.label: Monchen
records.text: Monchen , v. to munch, Cath. ( n ), Palsg., SkD; mounch , Sh. ; munche , CM (4. 145); maunche , Palsg. (s.v. briffault ); manche , Palsg.; mounchynge , pr. p. , S3. ( n ).—Probably a variety of ME. maungen ; OF. manger . For che = ge cp. ME. charche ; OF. charche = charge (see MD), also F. revancher = OF. revenger (SkD).

records.text: Moneye , sb. money, C3, PP; monè , S2, PP.—AF. moneie , moneye , monee ; Lat. moneta .

records.text: Monkrye , sb. monkery, the race of monks, S3.

records.text: Monsede , pp. cursed, PP; see Mansed .

records.text: Mood , sb. anger, pride, mind, C; mod , S, S2; mode , dat. , S, S2.—AS. mód ; cp. OHG. muot (Tatian).

records.text: Moode , sb. mud , S3; see Mud .

records.text: More , sb. moor, Prompt., H, PP; mor , S2; mwr , B; mwre , S2, B.—AS. mór .

records.label: More
records.text: More , adj. and adv. comp. more, greater, elder, S, S2, W, W2, PP, WW; mor , S, PP; moare , S; mayr , S3, B; mair , B; mære , S; mare , S, S2; mar , S, B; marere , H.—AS. mára . See Mo .

records.text: More , sb. root, S2, PP, HD; moore , CM.—AS. mora (Voc. 135. 28, 29, 32); cp. MHG. morâ , more , see Weigand (s.v. möhre ).

records.text: Moreyne , sb. murrain, PP; moreyn , S2, Prompt.; morrein , WW; moryn , H; murrins , pl. , WW.—AF. morine ; cp. Low Lat. morina , a pestilence among animals (Ducange).

records.text: Morkin , sb. a beast that dies by disease or accident, RD, HD, ND.—Cp. Late Lat. morticinium (Ducange), whence Ir. muirtchenn , Wel. burgyn .

records.label: Morknen
records.text: Morknen , v. to rot, SD; mourkne , S2.—Icel. morkna .

records.text: Mormal , sb. cancer or gangrene, CM, C, Prompt., RD, SD, ND, HD; mormall , Palsg.; mortmal , ND; morimal , RD; marmole , RD.—Cp. Late Lat. malum mortuum , a disease of the feet and shins (Ducange).

records.text: Morris , adj. Moorish, sb. morris-dance, Sh. , ND; morisco , SkD; a morris-dancer, SkD. records.label: Morsel
records.text: Morsel , sb. morsel, PP, B; mossel , SkD; mussel , W, W2, PP; musselle , Voc.— AF. morsel ; Lat. morsellum , a little bit; dimin. of morsus . Cf. Mosel .

records.label: Morther
records.text: Morther , sb. murder; morthir , PP; morthre , C; morder , PP; mordre , C.—AS. morðor ; cp. Low Lat. murdrum .

records.label: Morther
records.text: Morther , v. to murder, PP, S2; morthre , C; mordre , C, C2; murther , C.

records.label: Mortherer
records.text: Mortherer , sb. murderer, PP; mordrer , C, C2.

records.label: Mortifie
records.text: Mortifie , v. to mortify, to produce change by chemical action, C3.—OF. mortifier ; Lat. mortificare .

records.label: Mortreux
records.text: Mortreux , sb. messes of pounded meat, C; mortrewes , CM, PP; mortrwys , Prompt.; mortrws , Cath.; mortesse , Palsg.; mortrels , PP; mortreuus , (mortrews), PP, Prompt. ( n ) Voc.; mortrus , Voc.—OF. mortreux , see Ducange (s.v. mortea ), connected with Lat. mortarium , a morter.

records.text: Morwen , sb. morn, morrow, S, PP; morȝen , SD. Phr. : to morwen , S.—AS. morgen , Goth. maurgins .

records.label: Morwenynge
records.text: Morwenynge , sb. morning, PP, C2; morwnynge , S2; moreȝening , S.

records.text: Mose , sb. titmouse, S.—AS. máse , see SkD. (s.v. titmouse ).

records.text: Mosel , sb. muzzle, nose of an animal, C, CM.—OF. musel (now museau ): Prov. mursel : OF. * morsel . See Morsel , and cf. Musen .

records.label: Mosell
records.text: Mosell , v. to muzzle, SkD; moosel , Manip.

records.label: Moskles
records.text: Moskles , sb. pl. mussels (shell fish), S2; see Muskylle .

records.text: Mote , sb. moat, agger , fossa , P; a pond, Manip.; castle, palace, WA; moote , Prompt.; mot , PP.—OF. mote , embankment, also motte (Cotg.).

records.text: Mote , v. to summon before a mot (court), to plead, dispute, discuss a law case, PP, S2; mootyn , Prompt.; motien , S.—AS. mótian (Leo). See Moot .

records.text: Mote , sb. note on the huntsman’s horn, CM; moot , HD; mot , S3 (7. 16).—OF. mot , ‘the note winded by an huntsman on his horn’ (Cotg.).

records.label: Motlè
records.text: Motlè , sb. motley, a dress of many colours, Prompt.; motley , Sh., ND; motteleye , C; mottelay , Cath.—OF. mattele , clotted, curdled (Cotg.).

records.text: Motoun , sb. a gold coin called a ‘mutton’ or sheep, P; mutoun , S2, PP; moton , PP.—OF. mouton ; Late Lat. multonem (Ducange).

records.text: Motyf , sb. motive, incitement, S2, C3; motif , motion, argument, question, subject, PP.—OF. motif (Cotg.); Late Lat. motivum (Ducange).

records.text: Mounten , v. to mount, PP.—OF. monter ; Late Lat. montare .

records.text: Mountenaunce , sb. amount; mowntenawnce , Prompt.; mountenance , S3, ND. See Mountance .

records.text: Mour , sb. mulberry-tree, H; see More .

records.text: Muchel , adj. and adv. great, much, numerous, S, C2, PP; mochel , S2, C2, C3, PP; mochele , S; michel , S; micel , S; mikel , S, S2; mycel , S; mykel , S2, P; mukel , S, S2; mucele , S; mikle , S2; mekill , S3. records.text: Musen , v. to ponder, wonder, PP, C3, WA, ND.—OF. muser , to muse, study, linger about a matter, to sniff as a hound, from * muse , a muzzle, nose of an animal (whence F. museau ); Lat. morsus . For F. -u- from an orig. Lat. -or- cp. OF. jus from Late Lat. jūsum , Lat. deorsum , and F. sus from Lat. sūsum , seorsum , see Apfelstedt, § 43, and Constans (glossary). Cf. Mosel .

records.text: Muskylle , sb. mussel, a shell-fish, Cath.; muscles , pl. , PP; moskles , S2.—AF. muskeles , pl., OF. muscle ; Lat. musculum (acc.), dimin. of mus , mouse; cp. AS. musclan scel (Voc.).

records.text: Mute , v. to dung (used of birds), SkD, WW, ND; meuted , pp. , WW.—OF. mutir (Cotg.), esmeutir (Cotg.), esmeltir , (Littré); of Teutonic origin, cp. ODu. smelten , to smelt, liquefy; cp. It. smaltare , to mute as a hawk (Florio). Cf. Amellen .

records.text: Narde , sb. nard, an unguent, W.—Lat. nardus (Vulg.); Gr. ναρδός (Persian word).

records.text: Narwe , adj. narrow, C; narewe , S; nareu , S; narwȝ , W; nearowe , S; neruwe , S; narwe , adv. , closely, PP.—AS. nearu , adv. nearwe .

records.text: Natiuite , sb. nativity, S2, C2.—OF. nativité (Cotg.); Lat. natiuitatem .

records.label: Oȝein
records.text: Oȝein , prep. against, MD; see Aȝein .

records.label: Oȝeines
records.text: Oȝeines , prep. in comparison with, S; see Aȝeines .

records.label: Oȝen
records.text: Oȝen , v. to owe, S; see Owen , v.

records.label: Oȝen
records.text: Oȝen , adj. own, S; see Owen , adj.

records.label: Oȝt
records.text: Oȝt , sb. aught, S; see Ought .

records.label: Pace
records.text: Pace , sb. ; see Pas .

records.label: Pace
records.text: Pace , v. ; see Passen .

records.label: Padde
records.text: Padde , sb. toad, SkD; pades , pl. , S; paddis , SkD. Comb. : pad-stoole , toad-stool, Manip.—Icel. padda .

records.label: Paddok
records.text: Paddok , sb. toad, Prompt.; frog, W2; paddoke , rana , Voc. ( n ); padockes , pl. , grenouilles , Palsg. Comb. : paddok-stole , fungus , toad-stool, Cath.

records.label: Paene
records.text: Paene , adj. pagan, S; see Payen .

records.label: Pagent
records.text: Pagent , sb. a pageant, pagina , Prompt.; pageant , scena , theatrum , Manip.

records.label: Pagent
records.text: Pagent , sb. a page, writing; see below.

records.label: Pagyne
records.text: Pagyne , sb. page, writing, HD; pagine , SkD; pagent , SkD (s.v. page ). Phr. : perfeccioun of dyuyne pagyne , H (p. 4).—Lat. pagina , a written page, that which is written, a paragraph or book.

records.label: Pais
records.text: Pais , sb. peace, S; see Pees .

records.label: Pak
records.text: Pak , sb. a small bundle, PP; pakke , sarcina , Prompt.

records.label: Pakken
records.text: Pakken , v. to pack, PP, Prompt.

records.label: Pak-nelde
records.text: Pak-nelde , sb. packing-needle, PP; pakneelde , S2; paknedle , PP.

records.label: Pakok
records.text: Pakok , sb. a peacock, PP; see Pecok .

records.label: Palesye
records.text: Palesye , sb. paralysis, palsy, PP, S2; perlesy , HD; palesye , PP, S2; palesie , S2; palasie , S2; palacye , PP; palesy , W; palsye , P, Prompt.; parlesy , Cath., SkD.—OF. paralysie ; Lat. paralysin ; from Gr. παράλυσις .

records.label: Paleys
records.text: Paleys , sb. palace, C, C2, PP; paleis , PP; palais , S; palys , PP; paleyses , pl. , PP; paleis , PP.—AF. paleis , OF. palais ; Lat. palatium .

records.label: Palfrey
records.text: Palfrey , sb. palfrey, saddle-horse, S2, C, PP; palfray , PP; palefrei , S.—AF. palefrei , OF. palefreid (Roland); Low Lat. paraveredum .

records.label: Palle
records.text: Palle , sb. the archbishop’s pallium, funeral pall, a costly kind of texture, a canopy, Prompt., HD, Voc.; pall , HD, WA; pal , S; pelle , Prompt., S; pell , S2; pelles , pl. , S. Comb. : pallen webis , fabrics of pall or fine cloth, WA.—Late Lat. pallium and palla , see Ducange; cp. OF. pale , a kind of cloth (Ducange), and AS. pæll , a rich texture (Voc.).

records.label: Pallen
records.text: Pallen , v. to pall, to become vapid, Prompt., Palsg., SkD; palled , pp. enfeebled, C3.—OF. pallir , to grow pale; see Constans.

records.label: Palme
records.text: Palme , sb. palm (tree), palm of victory, WA; palm , palm-branch, C3.—AF. palme ; Lat. palma .

records.label: Palmere
records.text: Palmere , sb. palmer, S, PP; palmers , pl. S2.—AF. palmer ; Church Lat. palmarium (acc.). See above.

records.label: Palmestrye
records.text: Palmestrye , sb. palmistry, S3. See Paume .

records.label: Paltok
records.text: Paltok , sb. jacket, PP, Prompt.; paltocke , HD, Palsg.; paltoke , Voc.—OF. paletocque (Prompt., n ). For cognates, see SkD (s.v. paltry ).

records.label: Pament
records.text: Pament , sb. pavement, S3; see Pauement .

records.label: Pane
records.text: Pane , sb. a part or division of a thing, a skirt, Prompt., HD, SkD.—OF. pan , a piece (Bartsch); Lat. pannum (acc.). Cf. Peny .

records.label: Panel
records.text: Panel , sb. a division, compartment, jurylist, piece of cloth on horse’s back, Cath. ( n ) PP, Sh.; panell , PP; panelle , subsellium . Cath.; pannell , HD, Palsg.—AF. panel . See above.

records.label: Paneter
records.text: Paneter , sb. butler, PP; pantere , Voc.; panter , PP.—AF. panneter ; Late Lat. panetarium (acc.). See Payn .

records.label: Panne
records.text: Panne , sb. pan, brain-pan, skull, PP, C3, Voc., Prompt.; ponne , PP; pan , C.—AS. panne (Voc.); cp. Low Lat. panna (Ducange), and G. pfanne .

records.label: Pans
records.text: Pans , sb. pl. pence, W; see Peny .

records.label: Panter
records.text: Panter , sb. painter, pictor , Voc. See Peynten .

records.label: Panter
records.text: Panter , sb. a net, snare, CM, HD, Voc.; pantere , Prompt.; panther , Palsg., HD.—OF. pantiere ; Late Lat. panthēra ; Gr. πανθήρα ; see Ducange.

records.label: Pantere
records.text: Pantere , sb. panther, S3, Voc.—OF. pantere ; Lat. panthēra ; from Gr. πάνθηρ

records.label: Panyer
records.text: Panyer , sb. pannier, bread-basket, PP; payneres , pl. , PP.—AF. panyer . See Payn .

records.label: Papejay
records.text: Papejay , sb. parrot, popinjay, C2; popeiay , PP; papinjay . Voc.; popinjay , Voc.; popyngay , S3, HD; papyngay , HD; papingais , pl. , S3; popyngayes , S3.—AF. papejaye parrot (mod. papegai ); cp. OF. papegaux pl.; Low Lat. pappagallus by popular etymology from the Low Gr. παπαγάς , see Ducange.

records.label: Pappe
records.text: Pappe , sb. breast, S, Voc.; pappes , pl. , S ( n ), WW; pappys , HD.

records.label: Par
records.text: Par , prep. by, with. Comb. : par amour , by love, with love, C; for paramour , for love, C2; paramour , a lover (of either sex), C, WA; paranioure , Manip. ; par auenture , peradventure, S2, C2, C3, PP; perauntere , H; parauntre , S2; perauenture , W; par cas , by chance, C3; par de ( par Dieu ), C, C3; pardee , C2 par fay , by my faith, C2, C3.

records.label: Parage
records.text: Parage , sb. kindred, family; hence, birth, descent, HD, JD, CM; equality, DG.—AF. parage ; Late Lat. * paraticum , an equality, from Lat. par , equal. Cf. Disparage .

records.label: Parcel
records.text: Parcel , sb. part, share, little bit, PP; parcele , WA.—AF. parcele , part; Late Lat. particella ; cp. It. particella .

records.label: Parcel-mele
records.text: Parcel-mele , adv. separately, bit by bit, PP; percel-mel , S2, PP.

records.label: Parcenel
records.text: Parcenel , sb. partner, H.

records.label: Parcenelynge
records.text: Parcenelynge , sb. partnership, H.

records.label: Parcener
records.text: Parcener , sb. sharer, HD, W2; partener , W; partynere , S3; parceneris , pl. , W, W2; parteneris , W; partyneris , W.—AF. parcenere , parsenere , pl. parceners , perceners ; Late Lat. partionarinm (acc.).

records.label: Parchementer
records.text: Parchementer , sb. preparer of parchment, Cath.; parmenter , Voc.

records.label: Parchemyn
records.text: Parchemyn , sb. parchment, W, PP; perchemyn , PP; perchemen , WA.—AF. parchemin , Gr. περγαμηνή from Πέργαμος (cp. Lat. pergamena ).

records.label: Parclos
records.text: Parclos , sb. an enclosure, partition, screen, S3, Palsg. ; parcloos , Prompt.; perclos , HD; perclose , HD.—OF. parclos , pp., closed completely; Lat. per + clausum .

records.label: Pardon
records.text: Pardon , sb. pardon, PP.—AF. pardun .

records.label: Pardoner
records.text: Pardoner , sb. a seller of pardons, C, PP; pardonere , Prompt.

records.label: Parement
records.text: Parement , sb. an adorning, C2, CM; paramentz , pl. , C. Phr. : chambre of parementz , the presence-chamber, C2.—OF. parement ; also chambre de parement , the Chamber of Presence (Cotg.).

records.label: Parfit
records.text: Parfit , adj. perfect, S2, PP, GS, W; parfyt , PP; perfyt , C; parfight , C; perfit , C3, W; perfight , C.—OF. parfit , parfeit ; Lat. perfectum .

records.label: Parfitliche
records.text: Parfitliche , adv. perfectly, PP; perfitliche , PP; parfitly , C2, CM; parfitli , W; perfytliest , superl. , H.

records.label: Parfournen
records.text: Parfournen , v. to perform, PP, C2, CM, SPD (p. 280); parforme , PP; perfourne , PP; performen , PP.—AF. parurnir , parfournir , to perform, to furnish. Cf. Furnish .

records.label: Parische
records.text: Parische , sb. parish, PP; parisch , PP; paresche , PP; parsche , PP.—OF. paroisse ; Church Lat. paroecia (also parochia ); Gr. παροικία .

records.label: Parischen
records.text: Parischen , sb. parishioner, Cath., C; parisschens , pl. , PP, S2; parshens , PP.—OF. paroissien . See above.

records.label: Paritorie
records.text: Paritorie , sb. pellitory, C3, SkD; peritorie , the wall-plant bartram, Manip.; paratory , colitropium , Voc.; parietary , HD.—OF. paritoire , pellitory (Cotg.) and paritarie (Alph.); Late Lat. paritaria (Alph.); Lat. parietaria , from paries , wall.

records.label: Parlement
records.text: Parlement , sb. parliament, conference, PP, S2.—AF. parlement , from OF. parler , to talk; Low Lat. parabolare (Brachet).

records.label: Parloure
records.text: Parloure , sb. the conversation room in nunneries, PP; parlowr , ‘colloquotorium,’ Cath.; parlur , S.—OF. parloir ; Church Lat. parlatorium (Ducange).

records.label: Parochien
records.text: Parochien , sb. parishioner, PP; perrochioun , S3; paroschienes , pl. , PP.—OF. parochien ; Church Lat. parochianum ; from parochia . See Parische .

records.label: Partie
records.text: Partie , sb. part, portion, PP; partye , party (in a law suit), PP; party , side, S2; parties , pl. , parts, S2. Phr. : a party , partially, S2.—AF. partie ( partye ), person; Lat. partita , divided.

records.label: Partly
records.text: Partly , adv. briskly; see Perk .

records.label: Partriche
records.text: Partriche , sb. partridge, S3, PP; partrich , C; pertryche , Prompt.—AF. perdrice , perdriz ; Lat. perdicem .

records.label: Parvis
records.text: Parvis , sb. the open space in front of St. Paul’s cathedral, HD; parvys , C, CM; parvyse , HD; parvyce , Prompt.—OF. parvis , the porch of a church, the outer court of a palace (hence Low Lat. parvisum ), parevis , pareïs , paraïs ; Late Lat. paradisum (acc.), the portico of St. Peter’s, Rome (Ducange), also paradise (Vulg.); Gr. παράδεισος . For the intercalation of v in OF. parvis , see Brachet (s.v. corvée ).

records.label: Pas
records.text: Pas , sb. a step, pace, pass, passage, canto, narrow path, C2, C3, PP, S2; paas , C3; pass , S2; pace , Prompt.; pas , pl. , S2; pases , S2.—AF. pas ; Lat. passum (acc.).

records.label: Paschen
records.text: Paschen , v. to dash, to strike; pash , HD; paschte , pt. s. , PP; passhed , pp. , passchet , pp. , S2.

records.label: Paske
records.text: Paske , sb. passover, W, PP, HD; pask , W.—AF. pask ; Church Lat. pascha ; Gr. πάσχα ; Heb. pesak , a passing-over.

records.label: Passamen
records.text: Passamen , sb. a kind of lace, SPD (p. 272), HD; passements , pl. , SPD, DG. Comb. : passamen lace , NQ (5. 9. 231); parchment lace , SPD.—OF. passement , a lace (Cotg.): It. passamáno (Florio); cp. Sp. passamáno , G. posament (Weigand). Cf. Perchmentier .

records.label: Passen
records.text: Passen , v. to pass, surpass, PP, C2, C3; pace , S2, C2, C3; to die, C2; y-passed , pp. , PP; pasand , pr. p. , S3.—AF. passer .

records.label: Passyng
records.text: Passyng , pr. p. as adv. surpassing, i.e. very, S3; adj. , C3.

records.label: Passyngly
records.text: Passyngly , adv. in a surpassing degree, S3.

records.label: Pas-tans
records.text: Pas-tans , sb. pastime, S3; pastance , S3; pastaunce , HD.—OF. passe-tans , passe-tens , passe-temps .

records.label: Patter
records.text: Patter , v. to repeat prayers, to say repeatedly, S3; patred , pt. s. , S3 ( n ), HD.—From Church Lat. pater , the first word in the pater-noster (‘Our Father’).

records.label: Paue
records.text: Paue , v. to pave; y-paued , pp. , S3.—OF. pauer .

records.label: Pauement
records.text: Pauement , sb. pavement, C2; pauiment , SkD; pament , S3, Voc., Cath. ( n ), H; pawment , Prompt.—AF. pavement ; Lat. pauimentum .

records.label: Paume
records.text: Paume , sb. palm of the hand, PP; pawme , PP, W, Prompt. ; pame , Voc. Comb. : palme-play , game of ball played with the hand, S3.—OF. paume , palm of the hand; Lat. palma ; cp. F. jeu de paume , tennis.

records.label: Pautener
records.text: Pautener , sb. a vagabond, a libertine, HD; adj. , rascally, ribald, B.—OF. pautonier , paltunier , a rascal (Bartsch); cp. Low Lat. paltonarius (Ducange). For cognates see SkD (s.v. paltry ).

records.label: Pauilon
records.text: Pauilon , sb. pavilion, tent, PP; pauilyoune , S2; pauiloun , lawyer’s coif, PP; pauyloun , coif, PP; pauylons , pl. , tents, S2.—AF. pavillon , tent; Lat. papilionem , a tent, a butterfly.

records.label: Pavyce
records.text: Pavyce , sb. a shield, defence, Prompt.; pauice , SkD; pauys , Prompt. ( n ), SkD, Voc., HD; pavisse , HD; pauish , Prompt. ( n ), HD; paluoise , Florio (s.v. testudine ); palueise , Florio (s.v. pauese ).—AF. pavise ; Low Lat. pavisium (acc.), also pavesium ; cp. OF. pavois (Cotg.); Low Lat. pavensem (Ducange).

records.label: Pavyser
records.text: Pavyser , sb. a soldier armed with a pavise, HD.

records.label: Pax-brede
records.text: Pax-brede , sb. a tablet with a crucifix which received from the worshippers the ‘osculum pacis,’ Voc., HD. See Bred (2) .

records.label: Paye
records.text: Paye , sb. satisfaction, HD, S2, PP; paie , S2; pay , S2.—AF. paie .

records.label: Payen
records.text: Payen , v. to please, satisfy, pay, PP, S2, H; payed , pp. , satisfied, PP; paied , W; payd , S2; paid , S2; y-payed , C.—OF. paier , to satisfy, pay: Prov. pagar ; Lat. pacare .

records.label: Payen
records.text: Payen , adj. and sb. pagan, heathen, C; as a personal name , Bardsley; payn , S; paene , S; payns , pl. , S; paynes , S; pains , S; paens , S; payens , S2, C3, CM.—AF. païen ; Late Lat. paganum , heathen.

records.label: Payn
records.text: Payn , sb. bread, PP; payne , PP. Comb. : payn-demayn , bread made of the finest flour, C2; paynmayn , Voc.; paynemayn , C2 ( n ); payman , Voc., HD.—OF. pain demaine , demeine ; Church Lat. panem dominicum , bread of our Lord.

records.label: Payne
records.text: Payne , sb. penalty, S2; see Peyne .

records.label: Paynyme
records.text: Paynyme , sb. heathendom, S; painime , S; paynym , a pagan, Saracen (an incorrect use), PP, H; payneme , S2; paynymes , pl. , PP; painems , HD (s.v. payen ).—AF. paenime , heathen lands, paganism; OF. paienisme ; Late Lat. paganismum (ace.). See Payen .

records.label: Paynymery
records.text: Paynymery , sb. paganism, Cath.

records.label: Peak
records.text: Peak , v. to pry about narrowly, to peep, ND. Comb. : peak-goose , a peaking goose, ND; peek-goos , S3; pea-goose , ‘a simple, doltish fellow, a noddy peak, a ninny-hammer, a coxe,’ Cotg. (s.v. benet ).

records.label: Peakish
records.text: Peakish , adj. looking sneakingly, ND.

records.label: Peas
records.text: Peas , sb. peace, S3; see Pees .

records.label: Pease
records.text: Pease , v. to become peaceable; peaste , pt. s. , S3.

records.label: Pece
records.text: Pece , sb. a bit, portion, a cup, S2, PP, Prompt., Cath., Palsg., HD; peyce , S3.—AF. pece , piece ; cp. Low Lat. pecia , a piece (Voc.), a cup (Ducange).

records.label: Pecok
records.text: Pecok , sb. peacock, PP; pecoke , Voc.; pekok , PP; pacoke , Cath.; pacok , Voc.; pakok , PP; pocok , PP, C; pokok , PP; pocokk , Voc.; pokoc , Voc.; pacokkis , pl. , S3.—AS. péa ( páwo ); Lat. pauo ; see Sievers, 37. 2. Cf. Poun .

records.label: Peekgoose
records.text: Peekgoose , sb. a silly fellow, S3; see Peak .

records.label: Peel
records.text: Peel , sb. skin, rind of fruit, Cotg. (s.v. coupeau ).—OF. pel ; Lat. pellem .

records.label: Pees
records.text: Pees , sb. peace, silence, S2, C2, W, PP; pes , S, S2; peas , S3; pays , PP; pais , S.—AF. pees , pes , OF. pais ; Lat. pacem .

records.label: Peesid
records.text: Peesid , pp. appeased, W2.

records.label: Peirement
records.text: Peirement , sb. damage, detriment, W.

records.label: Peiren
records.text: Peiren , v. to injure, PP, CM; peyren , PP; peired , pp. , S2.—OF. peirier ; Late Lat. peiorare ; cp. OF. empeirier , to become worse, to make worse, impair (Bartsch).

records.label: Peiryng
records.text: Peiryng , sb. damage, destruction, W.

records.label: Peis
records.text: Peis , sb. weight, PP; peys , S2, PP; peyce , Prompt.; peise , S3, Prompt.; poys , S3.—OF. peis ( pois ); Lat. pensum .

records.label: Peisen
records.text: Peisen , v. to weigh, W2; peysede , pt. s. , S2; peised , PP; poised , PP.—AF. peiser ( poiser ); Lat. pensare .

records.label: Peitrel
records.text: Peitrel , sb. breast-plate of a horse in armour, HD; peytrel , C3, Prompt.; pewtrel , Manip.; peytrelle , CM; paytrelle , HD, Voc.; pettrylle , Voc.—AF. peitrel ; Lat. pectorale .

records.label: Pelet
records.text: Pelet , sb. pellet, stone-ball, S2, PP, Cath., CM, Prompt.; pelot , Prompt.; pylotes , pl. , Cath. ( n ).—AF. pelote , ball, cp. It. pillótta (Florio); dimin. of Lat. pila .

records.label: Pelle
records.text: Pelle , sb. a pall, Prompt.; see Palle .

records.label: Pelrimage
records.text: Pelrimage , sb. pilgrimage, S; see Pylgrimage .

records.label: Pelte
records.text: Pelte , pt. s. pushed, S; see Pulten .

records.label: Pelure
records.text: Pelure , sb. fur-work, PP; pellure , S2, Prompt., PP.—AF. pelure , OF. peleüre (from OF. pel ); Late Lat. pellatura , from Lat. pellem , skin.

records.label: Pen
records.text: Pen , sb. a pen, enclosure, crib, Sh., SkD; penne , caula , Manip.; penez , pl. , S2. See Pynnen .

records.label: Penaunce
records.text: Penaunce , sb. suffering, punishment, penance, penitence, W, C, PP.—OF. penance , peneänce ; Lat. poenitentia .

records.label: Penauncer
records.text: Penauncer , sb. one who imposes a penance, PP.

records.label: Penaunt
records.text: Penaunt , sb. one undergoing penance, C2, PP; penawnte , Prompt.—OF. penant , peneänt ; Lat. poenitentem .

records.label: Pencell
records.text: Pencell , sb. a little banner, pennon, S2; pensel , PP, CM; pensell , Palsg., Cath. (p. 280 n ).—OF. penoncel , pennoncel , dimin. of pennon , a flag, streamer. See Penoun .

records.label: Penible
records.text: Penible , adj. careful to please, C2; see Peyneble .

records.label: Penid
records.text: Penid , sb. a pennet, little wreath of sugar taken in a cold, sugar-candy, Florio (s.v. diapiéde ); penet , Florio; pennet , ND, Cotg., PP, Notes (p. 110); penydes , pl. , Alph.—OF. penide (Cotg.); Late Gr. πηνίδιον , a little twist of thread, from Gr. πήνη , thread. Cf. Dia-penidion .

records.label: Penne
records.text: Penne , sb. quill of a feather, Voc.; a pen, Cath.; pennes , pl. , S2, W2.—AF. penne ; Lat. penna .

records.label: Penoun
records.text: Penoun , sb. a pennon, small banner, SkD; pynoun , C; penounes , pl. , S3.—AF. penon , feather of a cross-bow bolt, OF. pennon , feather of an arrow, flag, streamer; cp. It. pennóne (Florio).

records.label: Peny
records.text: Peny , sb. penny, S2; penye , S; peny , S2; peni , S; pens , pl. , W, S2, S3, C3; pons , S2; pans , W. Comb. : penny-breid , penny’s breadth, S3.—AS. pening (Mk. 12. 15), penning (Schmid), pending , a little pledge or token (SkD); cp. OHG. phending (Tatian), dimin. of phand ; Lat. pannus , a piece of cloth; Late Lat. pannum , pledge, something pledged or pawned (Ducange). Cf. Pane .

records.label: Peosen
records.text: Peosen , sb. pl. peas, S2; see Pese .

records.label: Perauntere
records.text: Perauntere , peradventure, H; see Par .

records.label: Percelmel
records.text: Percelmel , adv. bit by bit, S2; see Parcel-mele .

records.label: Percen
records.text: Percen , v. to pierce, S2, PP, C2; persen , W, PP; perche , Cath., HD; pershaunt , pr. p. , PP; persand , S3; pearst , pp. , S3; persid , W2.—AF. percer ; OF. percher ; Late Lat. * particare , to part. For suffix -icare , cp. Late Lat. * coacticare (whence F. cacher ); see BH, § 97. Cp. also OF. person = partitionem , Ps. 15. 6 (Apfelstedt).

records.label: Perchmentier
records.text: Perchmentier , sb. dealer in ‘parchment lace,’ S3.—Cp. It. passamentiere (Florio). See Passamen .

records.label: Percyl
records.text: Percyl , sb. parsley, S2; percil , PP; percyll , Prompt.; parcelle , Cath.; persylle , Voc.; percelle , Cath.; persile , Alph.—OF. persil ; Late Lat. petrocillum (Voc.); from Gr. πετροσέλινον . For the effect of the Greek accent see Brachet, and cp. F. encre ( Enke ).

records.label: Pere
records.text: Pere , adj. and sb. equal, a peer, PP, C2; per , SkD; peer , PP, C2; peare , S3; peres , pl. , PP; pieres , S3.—AF. per (pl. pers , peres ); Lat. parem .

records.label: Pere
records.text: Pere , sb. pear, Voc., Cath.; peere , Prompt.; perys , pl. , CM. Comb. : peere apple , Prompt.; pere-ionette , an early ripe pear, PP; perjonette , CM.—AS. pere , peru ; Lat. pirum . Cf. Pereye .

records.label: Peregrin
records.text: Peregrin , adj. foreign; peregryn , C2.—OF. peregrin ; Lat. peregrinum . Cf. Pylgrim .

records.label: Peregrin
records.text: Peregrin , sb. a kind of falcon, HD.—Cp. Late Lat. peregrina falco (Ducange).

records.label: Peren
records.text: Peren , v. to appear, P.—OF. pareir ( paroir ); Lat. parēre , to appear.

records.label: Pereye

Picchen .
