records.text: Quainen , v. to lament, MD (s.v. hwenen ); whene , MD.—AS. hwánan (in á-hwǽnan , BT).

records.label: Quair
records.text: Quair , sb. quire, book, S3; quayre , Manip., CM; quayer , Voc.—OF. quayer (F. cahier ), Prov. cazern for cadern ; It. quaderno ; Lat. quaternum ; cp. Late Lat. quaternio a sheet folded in four (Voc.). See Quartern .

records.label: Quaken
records.text: Quaken , v. to quake, tremble, S2; cwakien , S; quakede , pt. s. , PP, MD; quok ( strong form ), PP; quook , C2, SkD; quoke , S2, H.—AS. cwacian .

records.label: Quakynge
records.text: Quakynge , sb. trembling, Prompt., MD; quakyng , W.—AS. cwacung .

records.label: Qual
records.text: Qual , sb. whale, MD, Cath. ( n ); qwal , Prompt.; qwaylle , Cath.; quale , S2; whal , W2; hwel , MD; qualle , pl. , S2, Cath. ( n ); quhalis , S3, Cath. ( n ).—AS. hwæl .

records.label: Qualm
records.text: Qualm , sb. death, pestilence, S2, H; cwalm , MD; qualme , dat. , C.—AS. cwealm . See Quelen .

records.label: Quarel
records.text: Quarel , sb. a square-headed cross-bow bolt, quarrel, WA, SkD; quarelle , S2; quarrel , WA, ND.—AF. quarel , cross-bow bolt; Late Lat. quadrellum (ace.), a quarrel, a square tile, dimin. of Lat. quadrus , square.

records.label: Quarere
records.text: Quarere , sb. quarry, Prompt.; quareres , pl. , S2.—OF. quarriere (Cotg.); Late Lat. quadraria , quarry, deriv. from quadrus . See above.

records.label: Quartern
records.text: Quartern , sb. prison; cwarterne , dat. , MD; quarterne , S, MD.—AS. cweartern , prison, perhaps for AS. quatern , ‘quaternio’ (OET). Cp. Fr. caserne (Sp. caserna ), barracks; Lat. quaterna (see Brachet); an etym. illustrated by the Fr. sea-term casernet , log-book, a deriv. of Lat. quaternum , see Diez, p. 755 (s.v. cahier ).—See Quair .

records.label: Quarteroun
records.text: Quarteroun , sb. a quarter, P, HD; quartrun , PP.

records.label: Quat, Quað
records.text: Quat, Quað , pt. s. quoth, S; see Queðen .

records.label: Quatriuials
records.text: Quatriuials , sb. pl. the quadrivials, the quadrivium, the four higher sciences: astrology, geometry, arithmetic, music, S3 (14. 511).—From Late Lat. quadrivium , the four mathematical sciences; in Lat. a place where four ways meet.

records.label: Quave-mire
records.text: Quave-mire , sb. quagmire, HD; quamier , DG.

records.label: Quauen
records.text: Quauen , v. to shake, S2, PP, Prompt.; quave , HD, JD, DG.

records.label: Quauynge
records.text: Quauynge , sb. shaking, MD.

records.label: Quayle
records.text: Quayle , v. to curdle, to coagulate, Palsg., Prompt., Manip.—OF. coailler Lat. coagulare .

records.label: Quaynt
records.text: Quaynt , adj. prudent, wise, H; quaynte , quaint, curious, WA; see Coint .

records.label: Quayntis
records.text: Quayntis , sb. wisdom, prudence, H; see Cointise .

records.label: Quayre
records.text: Quayre , sb. quire, book, CM see Quair .

records.label: Queade
records.text: Queade , sb. evil, iniquity, S2; see Quad .

records.label: Queale
records.text: Queale , sb. a blister, pimple, pupula , Manip.; see Whele .

records.label: Quecchen
records.text: Quecchen , v. to shake, MD; qvycchyn , Prompt.; quytche , Palsg.; quitch , Cotg. (s.v. oeil ); cwehte , pt. s. , MD; quehte , MD.—AS. cweccan .

records.label: Qued
records.text: Qued , adj. bad, S2, PP; see Quad .

records.label: Quedschipe
records.text: Quedschipe , sb. wickedness, MD; queadschipe , S; cweadschipe , S.

records.label: Queere
records.text: Queere , sb. quire, choir, Prompt.; queer , W2; quere , W2; queir , S3.—OF. choeur (Cotg.); Lat. chorum (acc.); Gr. χορός .

records.label: Quek
records.text: Quek , adj. living, S2; see Quik .

records.label: Quelen
records.text: Quelen , v. to die, MD; cwelen , MD.—AS. cwelan , pt. cwæl (pl. cwǽlon ), pp. cwolen . Cp. OHG. quelan , ‘cruciari’ (Tatian).

records.label: Quellen
records.text: Quellen , v. to kill, S, S2, C3, C; quelde , pt. s. , S; cwelled , pp. , S.—AS. cwellan ; cp. OHG. quelen ‘cruciare’ (Tatian), quellen (Otfrid).

records.label: Quellere
records.text: Quellere , sb. executioner, MD.—AS. cwellere .

records.label: Queme
records.text: Queme , adj. pleasing, S, MD; qweme , convenient, WA; cweme , S; wheme , MD.—AS. ( ge ) cwéme , from c ( w ) óm , pt. of cuman ; cp. OHG. ( bi ) queman , to come to, to suit, fit (Otfrid); see Kluge (s.v. bequem ). See Comen .

records.label: Quemeful
records.text: Quemeful , adj. placable, W2.

records.label: Quemen
records.text: Quemen , v. to please, S, H, PP; cwernen , S; cwemde , pt. s. , S; i-quemd , pp. , S; i-cwemet , S.—AS. cwéman .

records.label: Quenchen
records.text: Quenchen , v. to quench, S, Prompt., S3, SkD; cwennkenn , S; queynte , pt. s. , MD, S2; queynt , pp. , MD, C; y-kuenct , S2; quenchid , W2.—AS. cwencan .

records.label: Quene
records.text: Quene , sb. queen, wife, woman, quean, S, C2, C3, WA; quen , S, C; cuen , S; kuen , MD; kwene , S; cwene , MD.—AS. cwén ; cp. OHG. quena , wife (Otfrid); for root see Brugmann, § 467, 3.

records.label: Querel
records.text: Querel , sb. a complaint, dispute, quarrel, S2, W2; querele , SkD.—AF. querele ; Late Lat. * querella , for Lat. querēla .

records.label: Querne
records.text: Querne , sb. hand-mill, C2, Prompt., Palsg., MD; queerne , W.—AS. cweorn ; cp. Goth. kwairnus ; see Brugmann, § 442.

records.label: Querrour
records.text: Querrour , sb. quarry-man, CM. See Quarere .

records.label: Quest
records.text: Quest , sb. an inquiry, jury, verdict, G.—OF. queste , a quest (Cotg.). Quest is used for the proper legal term enquest ; OF. enqueste .

records.label: Queste
records.text: Queste , sb. will, bequest, G; quiste , S. A corrupt form of Quide (q.v.), influenced by the above word.

records.label: Queðen
records.text: Queðen , v. to speak, MD; cweðen , S, MD; cwað , pt. s. , S; cweð , S; queð , S; quað , S, S2; quoð , S; quat , S; quad , S; quod , S, S2, C2; koth , S3; couth , MD; cothe , MD; hwat , MD; wat , S; ko , S3; i-cwede , pp. , S.—AS. cweðan , pt. cwæð (pl. cwǽdon ), pp. ge-cweden .

records.label: Queynt
records.text: Queynt , adj. prudent, fine, quaint, MD; queynte , S3, C2, MD; see Coint .

records.label: Queynte
records.text: Queynte , pt. s. was extinguished, S2; see Quenchen .

records.label: Queyntelich
records.text: Queyntelich , adv. skilfully, neatly, MD; queynteli , S3; see Cointeliche .

records.label: Queyntise
records.text: Queyntise , sb. skill, S3; see Cointise .

records.label: Quide
records.text: Quide , sb. speech, bequest, MD; cwide , S, MD.—AS. cwide ; cp. OHG. quiti , ‘testimonium’ (Tatian). See Queðen .

records.label: Quidities
records.text: Quidities , sb. pl. , S3.—From Late Lat. quiditas , a term of the Schoolmen; that which relates to the essence of a thing, having reference to the question quid est , what is it? Cp. OF. quidditatif , ‘quidditative, doubtful, full of quirks, contentions, wrangling’ (Cotg.).

records.label: Quik
records.text: Quik , adj. and adv. living, quick, flowing (of water), S, S2, W; quic , S, S2; quek , S2; quyk , S3, W, W2; cwic , S; cwike , S; cwuce , S; quicke , S; quike , pl. , S, S2; quyke , S, C; quycke , S3.—AS. cwic ( cuc ); cp. OHG. quek (Otfrid).

records.label: Quikie
records.text: Quikie , v. to cause to revive, also, to be kindled, PP; quike , C3; quyke , C; cwikien , MD.—AS. cwician .

records.label: Quikliche
records.text: Quikliche , adv. quickly, PP; quicliche , S2.

records.label: Quiknen
records.text: Quiknen , v. to give life, to receive life, SkD; quykene , W, W2.

records.label: Quiste
records.text: Quiste , sb. will, bequest, S; see Queste .

records.label: Quiten
records.text: Quiten , v. to repay, PP; see Quyten .

records.label: Quitter
records.text: Quitter , sb. filth that runs from a wound, HD: quytur , rottenness, HD; quytere , W2; quitture , DG.

records.label: Quod
records.text: Quod , pt. s. quoth, S, S2, C2; see Queðen .

records.label: Quok
records.text: Quok , pt. s. quaked, C2; see Quaken .

records.label: Quoynte
records.text: Quoynte , adj. skilful, MD, HD; see Coint .

records.label: Quoynteliche
records.text: Quoynteliche , adv. skilfully, MD; see Cointeliche .

records.label: Quoyntyse
records.text: Quoyntyse , sb. quaintness of dress, PP; quointise , stratagem, S2; see Cointise .

records.label: Quyk
records.text: Quyk , adj. living, moving, S3, W, W2; see Quik .

records.label: Quyk-myre
records.text: Quyk-myre , sb. quagmire, S3.

records.label: Quyknar
records.text: Quyknar , sb. giver of life, S3.

records.label: Quyr-boilly
records.text: Quyr-boilly , sb. boiled leather, used for making defensive armour, C2.—OF. cuir bouilli (Cotg.).

records.label: Quyrry
records.text: Quyrry , sb. the quarry, the dog’s share in the slaughtered game, S3; quyrre , SkD (s.v. quarry , p. 824); guerre , SkD.—OF. cuiree ; Late Lat. coriata , from Lat. corium , hide, skin (OF. cuir ).

records.label: Quyten
records.text: Quyten , v. to requite, repay, settle, satisfy, S2, C2, C3, PP, W, H; quiten , S2, PP; quitte , pt. s. G; qwit , H; quyt , pp. , PP; y-quit , C2.—OF. quiter ; Late Lat. quietare .

records.label: Quytly
records.text: Quytly , adj. quite, H; whitely , H.

records.label: Quytter
records.text: Quytter , v. to twitter, S3.

records.label: Quytur
records.text: Quytur , sb. rottenness, HD (p. 660); see Quitter .

records.label: Ra
records.text: Ra , sb. roe, deer, CM; see Roo .

records.label: Rabete
records.text: Rabete , sb. a war-horse; rabett , HD; rabyghte , HD; rabetis , pl. , WA.—Icel. rábítr , an Arabian steed; cp. Icel. rábitar , Arabs, see CV; cp. OF. arrabi (BH).

records.label: Rac
records.text: Rac , sb. driven vapour, S2; see Wrak .

records.label: Rachenteges
records.text: Rachenteges , pl. chains, S; see Raken-teie .

records.label: Racke
records.text: Racke , v. to stretch rent to its full value, S3. Cp. ODu. racken , to rack, recken , to stretch, reach out.

records.label: Rad
records.text: Rad , adj. afraid, S2, SD, H, JD, B; redd , WA; rade , S2, H; radde , S2.—Icel. hræddr .

records.label: Rad
records.text: Rad , pt. s. rode, S2; see Riden .

records.label: Rad
records.text: Rad , adj. quick, S; rade , ready, S; see Raðe .

records.label: Radde
records.text: Radde , pt. s. advised, S2; see Reden .

records.label: Raddour
records.text: Raddour , sb. violence, WA; see Reddour .

records.label: Rade
records.text: Rade , sb. road, S2; see Rode .

records.label: Radnesse
records.text: Radnesse , sb. terror, SD; radnes , B.

records.label: Radyous
records.text: Radyous , adj. radiant, shining, S3; radious , S3; radius , S3.—Lat. radiosus ; cp. F. radieux . See Ray .

records.label: Ræd
records.text: Ræd , sb. advice, counsel, S; see Rede .

records.label: Ræh
records.text: Ræh , adj. fierce, cruel, SD, S; reh , SD.—AS. hréoh .

records.label: Ræueden
records.text: Ræueden , pt. pl. spoiled, S; see Reuen .

records.label: Ræueres
records.text: Ræueres , sb. pl. robbers, S; see Reuere .

records.label: Rafte
records.text: Rafte , pt. s. reft, robbed, C2; see Reuen .

records.label: Rage
records.text: Rage , sb. madness, S2.—AF. rage ; Lat. rabiem .

records.label: Rage
records.text: Rage , v. to toy wantonly, C; ragid , pp. , been wanton, WA.

records.label: Ragerie
records.text: Ragerie , sb. wantonness, CM.

records.label: Raght
records.text: Raght , pp. reached, S2; see Rechen .

records.label: Ragman
records.text: Ragman , sb. a craven, the devil; rageman , PP; raggeman , PP.—Icel. ragr (for argr ), craven, cowardly.

records.label: Ragman-roll
records.text: Ragman-roll , sb. the craven’s roll, a term in Scottish history, JD, ND; a game, HD; ragman’s rewe , a long jest, DG; ragmanrew , series , Manip. Hence ragman , a deed sealed, a papal bull, PP; ragemon , S2; rageman , a list, S3; ragman , a tedious story, JD; ragment , JD.—Cp. E. rigmarole .

records.label: Rair
records.text: Rair , v. to roar, S3; see Roren .

records.label: Raiss
records.text: Raiss , pt. s. rose, S2; see Rysen .

records.label: Rake
records.text: Rake , sb. only in compounds, as in erend-rake , messenger, SD.—AS. ǽrend-raca ; cp. Icel. eyrend-reki , so land-reki , a king, see CV (s.v. reki ). See Ærnd-race .

records.label: Rake
records.text: Rake , v. to run, wander, go, S, S3, HD, PP, JD, B; rayke , H, S2; raik , WA, JD; reyke , JD; reke , HD; raykande , pr. p. , S2.—Icel. reika , to wander, cp. Swed. raka , to run hastily (Rietz).

records.label: Rake
records.text: Rake , sb. course, way, WA; rakke , WA.

records.label: Rakel
records.text: Rakel , adj. hasty, rash, CM, SkD (s.v. rake ); rakle , CM; racle , CM; rackel , JD; rakyl , Manip.; rakehell , a bad fellow, Manip., ND.—Icel. reikull , wandering, unsettled. See above.

records.label: Raken
records.text: Raken , v. to scrape, diminish, to rake, S, Prompt.; raked , pp. , C2.—Icel. raka , to scrape, to rake away.

records.label: Raken-teie
records.text: Raken-teie , sb. chain; raketeie , S; raketeye , S; rachenteges , pl. , S; rakenteis , HD.—AS. racentéah (Voc.); racente , a chain + téah , a tye. With racente , cp. Icel. rekendr , OHG. rahhinza . See Rekenthis .

records.label: Ram
records.text: Ram , sb. a ram, Prompt.—AS. ram (Voc.).

records.label: Ramage
records.text: Ramage , adj. wild, CM, HD.—OF. ramage , wild (of a hawk), living in the branches (Cotg.); Late Lat. * ramaticum , from ramus , a branch.

records.label: Rammish
records.text: Rammish , adj. strong-scented, C3, CM.

records.label: Ramne
records.text: Ramne , sb. bramble, W2; ramyn , H; rammyn , H.—Lat. rhamnus (Vulg.); Gr. ῥάμνος ( LXX ).

records.label: Rampe
records.text: Rampe , sb. an ill-conditioned woman, C2 ( n ), HD.

records.label: Rampen
records.text: Rampen , v. to ramp, to seize or scratch with the paws, to rage, C2; raumpe , S2; rawmpide , pt. s. , HD.—AF. raumper , OF. ramper , to clamber.

records.label: Rande
records.text: Rande , sb. a strip or slice of meat, S3, HD; rand , Cotg. (s.v. giste ), ND.—AS. rand , a rim, edge; cp. Swed. rand , a strip, stripe, Icel. rönd (pl. randir ).

records.label: Randoun
records.text: Randoun , sb. force, impetuosity, SkD. Phr. : in a randoun , in a furious course, B; at randon , left to one’s own force, SkD.—OF. randon , ‘the swiftness and force of a strong and violent stream’ (Cotg.); from OTeut. * randa , a rim; cp. AS. rand . See above.

records.label: Ranke
records.text: Ranke , adj. strong, luxuriant, rebellious, WA, Prompt.; rank , S3; ronk , S2; rang , HD.—AS. ranc ; cp. Icel. rakkr (for rankr ), straight, upright, bold.

records.label: Ransaken
records.text: Ransaken , v. to search, S, PP, C, H.—Icel. rannsaka , to search a house; Icel. rann : Goth. razn ; cp. AS. ræsn a plank, a beam, see Sievers, 179.

records.label: Rap
records.text: Rap , sb. rope, S; see Rope .

records.label: Rap
records.text: Rap , pt. s. reaped, W; see Repen .

records.label: Rape
records.text: Rape , sb. haste, S, PP, Prompt.; rap , S2.—Icel. hrap , a falling down.

records.label: Rape
records.text: Rape , adj. hasty, G; rapest , superl. , PP.

records.label: Rapeliche
records.text: Rapeliche , adv. hastily, PP; rapely , G; rapelike , S; rapli , S2, G; rapelier , comp. , PP.

records.label: Rapen
records.text: Rapen , v. to hasten, S, PP, Prompt.; rappe , PP; rappe adoune , to hurry along, PP. Phr. : rape and renne , to seize and plunder, C3; rapen and rinen , C3 ( n ); rap and rend , HD; rap or rende , Palsg.; rap and run , HD; rap and ran , C3 ( n ); rap and reeve , C3 ( n ); rap and ree , C3 ( n ).—Icel. hrapa , to fall, rush headlong, hurry.

records.label: Rascall
records.text: Rascall , sb. scrapings, refuse; rascaile , PP; rascayle , an animal not a beast of the chase, a hart not six years old, Prompt. ( n ); the common people, Prompt.; raskaille , the common herd, SkD; rascall , refuse beast, Palsg., ND; rascalles , pl. , common sort of men, low fellows, villains, S3.—AF. rascaille ( raskaylle , raskayle ), a rabble; cp. F. racaille ; from OF. rasquer , to scrape (Ducange); cp. OIt. rascare (Florio).

records.label: Rascall
records.text: Rascall , adj. common, low, HD; Comb. : rascall wine , tortivum vinum , Prompt. ( n ).

records.label: Rase
records.text: Rase , v. to run, to race, SD, S2; rese , S2; reysed , pp. ridden, C.—AS. rǽsan .

records.label: Rase
records.text: Rase , sb. a race, rush, SkD; ras , SkD, S2; rese , S2; res , SD, G ( n ); rees , attack, fit of passion, G.—AS. rǽs .

records.label: Rasen
records.text: Rasen , v. to scrape, Prompt.—OF. raser ; Late Lat. rasare , freq. of Lat. radere .

records.label: Rasour
records.text: Rasour , sb. razor, C2, C, W2; rasure , H (Ps. 51. 2).—OF. rasoir ; Late Lat. rasorium .

records.label: Raspen
records.text: Raspen , v. to rasp, scrape, SkD; rospen , S.—OF. rasper ; OHG. raspón , see Weigand.

records.label: Rasse
records.text: Rasse , sb. a raised mound or eminence, a cairn of stones, S2; raise , HD. See Reysen .

records.label: Rat
records.text: Rat , pr. s. reads, PP; see Reden .

records.label: Raþ
records.text: Raþ , sb. advice, S, SD.—Icel. ráð .

records.label: Rathe
records.text: Rathe , v. to advise, HD. See above.

records.label: Raðe
records.text: Raðe , adj. quick, swift, SD; rad , quick, S; rade , pl. , S; raddere , comp. pl. , S.—AS. hræð , hreð , also hræd , hred , quick, also rad . Cp. Chron. ann. 755 (Parker) with the Laud MS.

records.label: Rathe
records.text: Rathe , adv. early, PP, S2, S3; quickly, S, S2; reaðe , S; rath , B; raðer , comp. , sooner, rather, PP, S, S2, C2; redþer , S; raðest , superl. , PP; raðeste , S.

records.label: Rathly
records.text: Rathly , adv. quickly, S2; reaðliche , S; readliche , S; radeliche , HD; radely , S2; redliche , S.—AS. hræðlice .

records.label: Raton
records.text: Raton , sb. rat, PP, Cath.; ratoun , PP; ratones , pl. , PP.

records.label: Ratoner
records.text: Ratoner , sb. rat-catcher, PP, Voc.; ratonere , PP.

records.label: Ratte
records.text: Ratte , sb. rat, PP; rotte , Voc.; rattis , pl. , PP.—AS. ræt (Voc.).

records.label: Ratten
records.text: Ratten , v. to tear, SD.—Cp. MHG. ratzen , see Weigand (s.v. ratsche ).

records.label: Rattes
records.text: Rattes , sb. pl. rags, S; rats , pieces, shreds, HD.

records.label: Raughte
records.text: Raughte , pt. s. reached, C2; see Rechen .

records.label: Raunson
records.text: Raunson , v. to ransom, redeem, PP.

records.label: Raunsoun
records.text: Raunsoun , sb. ransom, S2, C; raunson , S2; raunsun , S2; raunceoun , PP; ransoune , B.—AF. raunson , ranson , OF. raënson , reänçon ; Lat. redemptionem .

records.label: Raueyn
records.text: Raueyn , sb. rapine, prey, W, PP; ravyne , S3; ravyn , Cath.; raueyns , pl. , W2.—AF. ravine ; Lat. rapina see BH, § 150.

records.label: Raueynour
records.text: Raueynour , sb. robber; raueinour , W; rauynour , W2.

records.label: Ravin
records.text: Ravin , adj. ravenous, S3, Sh.

records.label: Ravin
records.text: Ravin , v. to seize and devour greedily, Sh., WW.

records.label: Ravined
records.text: Ravined , adj. ravenous, Sh.

records.label: Rauischen
records.text: Rauischen , v. to seize with violence, PP; ravish , WW; raueische , imp. pl. , W2; rauyschiden , pt. pl. , W2.—AF. ravir (pr. p. ravissant ); Late Lat. * rapīre ; Lat. rapere .

records.label: Rawe
records.text: Rawe , sb. row, Cath.; raw , B, JD, SkD, S3, S2; rowe , SkD; rewe , C, G, W; rewis , pl. , S3.—AS. ráwe , rǽwe .

records.label: Ray
records.text: Ray , sb. striped cloth, rella , pannus , Voc.; stragulum , Voc., Cath., HD; raye , S3; rayes , pl. , S2, PP. Comb. : ray-cloth , striped cloth, W2, Prompt.—AF. drap de raye , cloth of ray, pl. reies , OF. rai , raid ; Lat. radium (acc.).

records.label: Rayeres
records.text: Rayeres , sb. pl. sellers of ray , PP.

records.label: Rayid
records.text: Rayid , adj. striped, Prompt.

records.label: Raykez
records.text: Raykez , pr. s. roams, S2; raykande , pr. pt. , advancing, S2. See Rake .

records.label: Rayl
records.text: Rayl , sb. rail, Prompt.; raylle , Cath.—Cp. Low G. regel , G. riegel , a bolt; see Kluge.

records.label: Rayle
records.text: Rayle , v. to rail, arrange in a row, S2; railed , pp. , S2.

records.label: Rayle
records.text: Rayle , sb. a kerchief, Palsg.; see Reȝel .

records.label: Raylle
records.text: Raylle , v. to flow, S3; raile , ND; reilen , SD.

records.label: Raymen
records.text: Raymen , v. to roam about, S2; see Romen .

records.label: Raynes
records.text: Raynes , sb. fine linen of Rheims, WA.—So named from Rheims; see SkD (p. 815); cp. It. renso , fine flax (Diez, p. 393).

records.label: Read
records.text: Read , sb. advice, S; see Rede .

records.label: Reade
records.text: Reade , adj. red, S; see Reed .

records.label: Readen
records.text: Readen , v. to advise, care for, S; see Reden .

records.label: Readi
records.text: Readi , adj. ready, S; see Redi .

records.label: Real
records.text: Real , adj. real, a term in medieval philosophy; reall , S3.—OF. real ; Schol. Lat. realem , from res .

records.label: Real
records.text: Real , adj. royal, CM; riall , S3, PP, CM; ryall , S3, CM; ryell , S3; roial , CM; roialler , comp. , S2, C3.—OF. real , AF. roial , reial ; Lat. regalem .

records.label: Realte
records.text: Realte , sb. royalty, royal state, PP; reaulte , PP; reaute , PP; roialtee , C3.—AF. realte ; Late Lat. regalitatem .

records.label: Realyche
records.text: Realyche , adv. royally, S2; realy , S2; rially , CM.

records.label: Reame
records.text: Reame , sb. kingdom, S2; see Rewme .

records.label: Rearde
records.text: Rearde , sb. voice, cry, S2; see Rerd .

records.label: Reaðe
records.text: Reaðe , adv. quickly, S; see Rathe .

records.label: Reaðliche
records.text: Reaðliche , adv. quickly, S; see Rathly .

records.label: Reaume
records.text: Reaume , sb. realm, kingdom, C2, S2; see Rewme .

records.label: Rebekke
records.text: Rebekke , sb. a kind of fiddle, SkD; see Rybybe .

records.label: Rebounden
records.text: Rebounden , v. to re-echo; rebownden , to sound again, reboare , Prompt.; rebounde , pt. s. , S2.—AF. rebundir , to re-echo, cp. OF. bundir , to resound (Roland, 3119); inchoative verb, from Late Lat. bombitare .

records.label: Receyt
records.text: Receyt , sb. receipt, recipe, retreat, Prompt., Manip.; receit , C3, WW, Manip., S3; receite , WW; reset , place of refuge, B.—AF. receite ; Late Lat. recepta (Ducange).

records.label: Reche
records.text: Reche , sb. smoke, S3; see Reke .

records.label: Recheles
records.text: Recheles , adj. careless, S, PP; reccheles , PP; retcheles , S3; rekkeles , S3; recchelees , S2, C2; rechlesse , S3.—AS. réceléas , also recceléas .

records.label: Rechelesnesse
records.text: Rechelesnesse , sb. carelessness, PP; recchelesnes , PP.

records.label: Rechen
records.text: Rechen , v. to care, reck, S, HD; reke , H; recche , S, HD, S2, C2; rekke , HD, C2; rekþ , pr. s. , S; reches , S2; roȝte , pt. s. , S; roughte , C2; roght , H; rohten , pl. , S; roucht , pt. s. , subj. , S2.—AS. récan : OS. rókian ; also, AS. * reccan .

records.label: Rechen
records.text: Rechen , v. to explain, S; ræcchen , to relate, S; rechede , pt. s. , S.—AS. reccan : OS. rekkian : OHG. rachjan , in Otfrid rachón .

records.label: Rechen
records.text: Rechen , v. to reach, attain, SkD, PP; rauhte , pt. s. , PP, S2; rauȝte , PP; raghte , PP; raughte , C2; raught , S3; raght , pp. , S2.—AS. rǽcan (BT), also rǽcean , to get into one’s power, pt. s. rǽhte , see Sievers, 407.

records.label: Reclayme
records.text: Reclayme , v. to bring a hawk to the wrist by a call, C3; recleymyn , to make tame, Prompt.; recleymyd , pp. redomitus (used of hawks), Prompt.—OF. reclaimer , recleimer , reclamer ; cp. AF. reclame , pp., reclaimed (as a falcon).

records.label: Recles
records.text: Recles , sb. incense, S; see Rekels .

records.label: Recluse
records.text: Recluse , sb. a female anchorite, SkD; ‘ankyr, anachorita ’ Prompt.—AF. reclus ; recluse , a f. pp. from OF. reclure , to shut up; Late Lat. recludere .

records.label: Recluse
records.text: Recluse , sb. convent, monastery, S3.—OF. recluse .

records.label: Reclused
records.text: Reclused , pp. shut up, withdrawn from the world, PP.

records.label: Recognisance
records.text: Recognisance , sb. an obligation binding one over to do some particular act, S3, SkD.—AF. reconisance , OF. recoignisance .

records.label: Recomand
records.text: Recomand , v. to commend, S2, C3; recomaundiþ , PP.—OF. recommander , recumander .

records.label: Reconforte
records.text: Reconforte , v. to comfort, C; reconforted , pp. , P.—OF. reconforter ; cp. AF. recunforter .

records.label: Reconsyle
records.text: Reconsyle , v. to recover, regain the possession of; reconsyled , pp. , S2; recounselid , W.—AF. reconciler ; Lat. reconciliare , to reconcile, re-establish, restore.

records.label: Record
records.text: Record , sb. witness, S3, WW; recorde , PP.—AF. record , OF. recort , mention (Bartsch).

records.label: Recorde
records.text: Recorde , v. to call to mind, C, PP; recorded , pt. pl. declared, PP.—OF. recorder ; Late Lat. recordare ; Lat. recordari .

records.label: Recoure
records.text: Recoure , v. to recover, PP; recour , HD; recure , HD; recured , pp. , S3.—AF. recoverer ; OF. recourer , recouvrer ; Lat. recuperare .

records.label: Recours
records.text: Recours , sb. recourse, C2.—AF. recours , soleill recours , sunset.

records.label: Recouerer
records.text: Recouerer , sb. restorer, saviour, S2.

records.label: Recrayed
records.text: Recrayed , pp. defeated, PP. See below.

records.label: Recreaunt
records.text: Recreaunt , adj. recreant, defeated, CM, PP; recreant , PP.—AF. recreaunt , OF. recreänt , giving up the contest; Late Lat. recredentem .

records.label: Recueil
records.text: Recueil , sb. a collection, compilation, DG; recuyell , S3; recule , HD.—OF. recueil (Cotg.).

records.label: Recule
records.text: Recule , v. to recoil, S3, Palsg., SkD, ND.—OF. reculer .

records.label: Reculyng
records.text: Reculyng , sb. recoiling, S3.

records.label: Recure
records.text: Recure , sb. recovery, S3.

records.label: Recure
records.text: Recure , v. to recover, HD; see Recoure .

records.label: Reddour
records.text: Reddour , sb. violence, rigour, HD, Trevisa (3. 313); raddour , WA.—OF. rador , later roideur (Cotg.); from rade , roide ; Lat. rigidum .

records.label: Rede
records.text: Rede , adj. red, C2; see Reed .

records.label: Rede
records.text: Rede , adj. ready, WA; redeliche , adv. , PP; redeli , S2.—AS. ( ge ) rǽde : Goth. ( ga ) raids .

records.label: Rede
records.text: Rede , sb. advice, S, S2, S3, B; read , S; red , S, S2, B; reed , C2; reid , B; ræde , S; reade , S; rade , S; reades , pl. S.—AS. rǽd .

records.label: Redels
records.text: Redels , sb. riddle, SkD; redeles , PP; rydels , Cath.; rydel , Prompt.; riddle , Manip.

records.label: Reden
records.text: Reden , v. to give advice, to take counsel, S, S2, S3, C2, B; readen , S; raden , to succour, S; raddest , 2 pt. s. , S; radde , pt. s. , HD, S2, P; redden , pl. , S; rad , pp. , S2.—AS. ( ge ) rǽdan , pt. rǽdde , pp. gerǽd .

records.label: Reden
records.text: Reden , v. to read, S, C2, C3; raden , S; rat , pr. s. , PP; reed , pt. s. , PP; radden , pl. , W; redden , W; radde , S2; rad , pp. , S, S3, C3; red , S3, W. Der. : redunge , passage read, S.—AS. ( ge ) rǽdan .

records.label: -reden
records.text: -reden , suffix (used to form abstracts).—AS. -rǽden . See hat-reden , SkD; cun-reden , kindred, SkD; fer-reden , S; ȝe-fered , S; uelaȝ-rede , S2.

records.label: Redgownd
records.text: Redgownd , sb. a sickness of young children, scrophulus , Prompt.; reed gounde , Palsg.; radegoundes , pl. , sores, PP.—ME. rede , red + gownde , a sore; AS. gund . Cp. E. red-gum .

records.label: Redi
records.text: Redi , adj. ready, S, W, PP; redy , C2; reddy , B; readi , S; rædiȝ , SD; rediliche , adv. , PP, S2; redily , C3.

records.label: Redliche
records.text: Redliche , adv. quickly, S; see Rathly .

records.label: Redoutable
records.text: Redoutable , adj. to be feared, redoubtable, SkD.

records.label: Redouten
records.text: Redouten , v. to fear; redoubt , Cotg.—AF. reduter , OF. redouter ; Lat. re + dubitare .

records.label: Redoutyng
records.text: Redoutyng , sb. reverence, C.

records.label: Reduce
records.text: Reduce , v. to bring back, S3, ND.—Lat. reducere .

records.label: Redymyte
records.text: Redymyte , pp. wreathed, crowned, S3.—Lat. redimitus , pp. of redimire .

records.label: Reed
records.text: Reed , sb. advice, C2; see Rede .

records.label: Reed
records.text: Reed , sb. reed, PP, Prompt.; reod , PP; rehed , W, W2; reheed , W2; reodes , pl. , PP; redes , PP. Comb. : red-ȝerde , a reed-sceptre, S.—AS. hréod .

records.label: Reed
records.text: Reed , adj. red, C2, C3, S2, W2, PP; rede , C2, C3, S2, PP, B; reid , S3; reade , S.—AS. réad .

records.label: Reednesse
records.text: Reednesse , sb. redness, C3.

records.label: Rees
records.text: Rees , sb. fit of passion, G; see Rase .

records.label: Reest
records.text: Reest , adj. rancid (as flesh), Prompt.; reste , Cath.

records.label: Reestyn
records.text: Reestyn , v. to be rancid, Prompt.

records.label: Reeuell
records.text: Reeuell , sb. joy, revelry, PP; reuel , C, C2; rule , SPD; reueles , pl. , revels, C2.—OF. revel , joy (Bartsch).

records.label: Refen
records.text: Refen , v. to roof in, S.—AS. ( ge ) hréfan . See Roof .

records.label: Reflac
records.text: Reflac , sb. robbery, S; see Reuen .

records.label: Refreissche
records.text: Refreissche , v. to refresh, C; refreschyn , Prompt.—AF. refreschir .

records.label: Refreyne
records.text: Refreyne , sb. the burden of a song, literally, a repetition, CM; refraine , SkD.—OF. refrain , from refraindre , to repeat, to sing a song (see Constans); Lat. re + frangere .

records.label: Refreynen
records.text: Refreynen , v. to bridle, refrenare , W, Prompt.; refrayne , Manip.; refrain , WW.—OF. refrener , to bridle; Lat. refrenare (Vulg.).

records.label: Refute
records.text: Refute , sb. refuge, Prompt., W2; refuit , W2; refuyt , CM, HD, W2; refut , S2, C3; refutt , W2.—AF. refute ; OF. refuite , re + fuite ; Lat. fugita , pp. f. of fugere .

records.label: Regal
records.text: Regal , adj. as sb. kingly (power), S2.—AF. regal Lat. regalem . Cf. Real .

records.label: Regne
records.text: Regne , sb. rule, a kingdom, S2, C2, C3; rengne , S; ryngis , pl., S3.—AF. regne ; Lat. regnum .

records.label: Regnen
records.text: Regnen , v. to reign, C2, PP; ring , S3; ryngis , pr. pl. , S3; reygned , pp. , S2; rengned , S2.—AF. regner ; Lat. regnare .

records.label: Regrate
records.text: Regrate , v. to retail wares, HD.—OF. regrater , to mend, scour, trick up an old thing for sale (F. regratter , to bargain): It. rigattáre , to strive for the victory, to regrate, to sell by retail (Florio); Sp. regateár , ‘to huck in buying or selling’ (Minsheu). Cp. E. regatta ; It. rigátta , a struggling for the mastery (Florio).

records.label: Regratere
records.text: Regratere , sb. retail dealer, PP.—OF. regratier ; cp. Low Lat. regratarium (Ducange).

records.label: Regratorie
records.text: Regratorie , sb. selling by retail, PP, S2; regraterye , PP.—OF. regraterie .

records.label: Regratour
records.text: Regratour , sb. retail dealer, S2, PP.—AF. regratour .

records.label: Reguerdon
records.text: Reguerdon , sb. reward, ND; reguerdoun , S2.—Cp. OF. reguerdonner , to guerdon abundantly (Cotg.).

records.label: Reguerdonment
records.text: Reguerdonment , sb. requital, DG.

records.label: Rehed
records.text: Rehed , sb. reed, W, W2; see Reed .

records.label: Rehersaille
records.text: Rehersaille , sb. rehearsal, C3.

records.label: Rehersen
records.text: Rehersen , v. to rehearse, enumerate, C2, S2, PP; rehercen , PP, C2; rehearse , WW, Sh.—AF. reherser , rehercer . See Herce .

records.label: Rehersyng
records.text: Rehersyng , sb. rehearsal, C.

records.label: Reheten
records.text: Reheten , v. to refresh, to cheer, H, CM, WA, HD, JD; reheyit , H; rehetid , pp. , H.—OF. rehaitier (Bartsch), cp. OF. haitier , to make joyful, see BH, Diez, p. 609.

records.label: Rehetynge
records.text: Rehetynge , sb. comfort, refreshing, H.

records.label: Reioysen
records.text: Reioysen , v. to rejoice, PP, C2; reioisshen , PP; reiosyng , pr. p. , S3.—OF. resjoïss- , stem of resjoïssant , pr. p. of resjoïr , from re + esjoïr ; Lat. ex + gaudēre (Late Lat. * gaudīre ); see Constans, glossaire (prefix res- ).

records.label: Reke
records.text: Reke , sb. vapour, smoke, S2, H (Ps. 67. 2), Cath.; reyk , B; reik , B; reche , S2.—AS. réc ; cp. Icel. reykr : OTeut. * rauki- ; see Kluge (s.v. rauch ).

records.label: Rekels
records.text: Rekels , sb. incense, Cath.; recles , S, S2. Comb. : recle-fat , incense-vessel, censer, S, SD.—AS. récels .

records.label: Reken
records.text: Reken , v. to smoke, Cath.—AS. récan .

records.label: Rekenen
records.text: Rekenen , v. to reckon up, to give account, C2, W, PP; rekne , S2, PP; rikenen , S, PP; rikynyd , pp. , W2; y-rekened , C2. Cp. Du. rekenen .

records.label: Rekeninge
records.text: Rekeninge , sb. reckoning, C3.

records.label: Rekenthis
records.text: Rekenthis , sb. pl. chains, WA; rekanthes , WA.—AS. racente ; cp. Icel. rekendr . Cf. Rakenteie .

records.label: Rekkeles
records.text: Rekkeles , adj. careless, S3; see Recheles .

records.label: Rekken
records.text: Rekken , v. to reck, care, C2; see Rechen .

records.label: Relenten
records.text: Relenten , v. to melt, C3, Palsg., Prompt., SkD.—OF. ralentir (Cotg.).

records.label: Reles
records.text: Reles , sb. relaxation, forgiveness, also taste, odour, Prompt.; relees , Prompt. ( n ); relece , Prompt. Phr. : out of relees , without ceasing, C3.—AF. reles , relees , relais . See below.

records.label: Releschen
records.text: Releschen , v. to relax, release; relecen , Prompt.; relesse , C3; releschand , pr. p. , S3; relessed , pt. s. , forgave, C2; relesed , pp. , forgiven, PP; relessed , PP.—AF. relascher , relesser , releisser Lat. relaxare .

records.label: Releuen
records.text: Releuen , v. to raise up again, to rise, PP, C3; relyue , S3; relieve , imp. , take up again, S3.—AF. relever ; Lat. releuare .

records.label: Relif
records.text: Relif , sb. what remains, a fragment taken up from the table; releef , Prompt.; relefe , Cath., SkD; reliefe , Cath. ( n ); relifs , pl. , W, W2; relifes , W; relifis , W2; relyues , S2.—OF. relief , remainder (Bartsch), from reliev- , accented stem of relever , to raise up; Lat. releuāre .

records.label: Relikes
records.text: Relikes , sb. pl. remains, H; relikis , W2.—AF. relikes ; Lat. reliquias .

records.label: Relyen
records.text: Relyen , v. to rally, call back, re-assemble, to take courage again, PP; rely , B; releyt , pt. s. , B, S2; releit , pp. , S2, B.—AF. relier , to rally (OF. ralier , in Bartsch); Lat. re + ligare , to bind.

records.label: Relyue
records.text: Relyue , v. to rise, S3; relyued , pt. s. , raised, S3; see Releuen .

records.label: Rem
records.text: Rem , sb. a kingdom, S2; reme , C; see Rewme .

records.label: Rem
records.text: Rem , sb. a cry, S; reames , pl. , S.—AS. hréam , OS. hróm , Icel. rómr .

records.label: Reme
records.text: Reme , v. to cry, roar, S, PP; raum , HD; romy , H; romiand , pr. p. , S2; rumyand , H; romyd , pt. s. , H; remden , pl. , S.—AS. hréman : OS. hrómian .

records.label: Remedie
records.text: Remedie , sb. remedy, C2; remede , S3.—OF. remede , AF. remedie ; Lat. remedium .

records.label: Remen
records.text: Remen , v. to give place, to quit, S, SD; roume , PP; rumen , SD; rimen , SD.—AS. rýman : OS. rúmian ; cp. OFris. rêma , G. räumen , see Weigand. See Rowm .

records.label: Remenant
records.text: Remenant , sb. remnant, C2, C3, S3; remenaunt , C, Prompt.; remanand , B; remelawnt , Prompt.; remlawnt , HD; remlin , Prompt. ( n ).—AF. remenant , OF. remanant , pr. p. of remanoir (Bartsch); Lat. remanēre .

records.label: Remlet
records.text: Remlet , sb. remnant, HD, Prompt. ( n ). See above.

records.label: Remouyn
records.text: Remouyn , v. to remove, Prompt.; remeuen , S3, C3, Palsg., SkD.—AF. remoever (with change of conjugation) from OF. removoir ; Lat. re + mouēre .

records.label: Remuen
records.text: Remuen , v. to remove, CM, ND, SkD; remown , Prompt.; remwe , to depart, S3; remewed , pp. , C2.—OF. remuër ; Lat. re + mutare .

records.label: Renable
records.text: Renable , adj. eloquent, PP; see Resunable .

records.label: Renably
records.text: Renably , adv. reasonably, CM; runnably , HD. See above.

records.label: Rend
records.text: Rend , v. to make to run into a shape, to cast metal, melt, H; rind , rynde , to melt, as lard, &c., JD.—Icel. renna , to make to run, to pour (of a melted substance), causal of renna ( rinna ), to run. See Rennen .

records.label: Renden
records.text: Renden , v. to tear, PP; reendyn , Prompt.; rente , pt. s. , S; rended , pp. , S2; y-rent , C3.—ONorth. rendan , to cut or tear down (BT).

records.label: Renegat
records.text: Renegat , sb. renegade, C3; runagate , WW.—OF. renegat ; Late Lat. renegatum .

records.label: Renewlen
records.text: Renewlen , v. to renew, W; renule , W2; renewlid , pp. , W; renulid , W2.—AF. renoveler ; Late Lat. renovellare .

records.label: Reneye
records.text: Reneye , v. to deny, reject, abandon, S2, PP, C2, CM.—OF. reneier ; Late Lat. renegare .

records.label: Reng
records.text: Reng , sb. rank, SD; renges , pl. , C; rengis , HD.—OF. reng , renc ; cp. AF. renc , ring of people, rencs , ranks; OHG. hring , ring. See Ring .

records.label: Renk
records.text: Renk , sb. a man, PP; renke , PP; renkes , pl. , men, creatures, PP, HD; renkkes , S2; reynkes , PP.—Icel. rekkr (for renkr ), a man, used in poetry, also in law. Cp. AS. rinc , a warrior, a man (Grein). See Ranke .

records.label: Renne
records.text: Renne , v. See under Rapen .

records.label: Rennen
records.text: Rennen , v. to run, SD, S, S2, S3, C2, W, PP; rin , S3; rynne , S3; ryn , S2; eornen , S, S2; ernen , S; urnen , S; ȝerne , S; ærneð , pr. pl. , S; rynnys , S3; ron , pt. s. , S2, PP; urnen , pl. , S; eorn , S; iorne , pp. , S; ronnen , PP; ronne , PP, C2; y-ronne , C2; y-ronnen , C; arnde , pt. s. (weak), S, SD; ernde , SD; ærnden , pl. , SD.—AS. rinnan , pt. s. ran , pp. gerunnen , also irnan , yrnan , pt. s. arn , pl. urnon , pp. urnen .

records.label: Rennyng
records.text: Rennyng , sb. running, S3; rennyngis , pl. , currents, streams, W2.

records.label: Renome
records.text: Renome , sb. renown, WW, S3; renoume , WW; renowme , WW. See below.

records.label: Renomee
records.text: Renomee , sb. renown, WW; renoume , B.—OF. renomee ; Late Lat. * renominatam .

records.label: Renoumed
records.text: Renoumed , adj. renowned, WW; renowmed , WW.—Cp. OF. renommé ; see Constans.

records.label: Renoun
records.text: Renoun , sb. renown, SkD; renowne , B.—AF. renoun , renun , OF. renon , renom ; Lat. re + nomen ; cp. Sp. renombre , renown (Minsheu).

records.label: Rente
records.text: Rente , sb. revenue, pay, reward, S, C2; rent , Prompt.; rentes , pl. , S, PP, S2; rentis , PP.—AF. rente ; Late Lat. * rendita ; Lat. reddita ; from OF. rendre ; Lat. reddere .

records.label: Renten
records.text: Renten , v. to endow, PP.

records.label: Renule
records.text: Renule , v. to renew, W2; see Renewlen .

records.label: Reod
records.text: Reod , sb. a reed, PP; see Reed .

records.label: Reousien
records.text: Reousien , v. to grieve, SD.—AS. hréowsian , see Sievers, 411. See Rewen .

records.label: Reowen
records.text: Reowen , v. to grieve, vex, S; see Rewen .

records.label: Reowsunge
records.text: Reowsunge , sb. repentance, SD.—AS. hréowsung .

records.label: Reowðe
records.text: Reowðe , sb. ruth, pity, S; see Rewðe .

records.label: Repair
records.text: Repair , sb. a place of resort, ND; repeir , return, S3.—OF. repaire .

records.label: Repairen
records.text: Repairen , v. to go to, C2, C3; repeiring , pr. p. , C2; raparyt , pt. pl. , S3; reparit , pp. , S2.—AF. repeirer , OF. repairier ; Lat. repatriare , to return to one’s country.

records.label: Reparailen
records.text: Reparailen , v. to repair; reparaild , pp. , H.—OF. repareiller ; cp. apareillier , to prepare; from pareil , like; Late Lat. pariculum (Ducange).

records.label: Reparaylynge
records.text: Reparaylynge , sb. restoration, H.

records.label: Repe
records.text: Repe , sb. sheaf, manipulus , Voc., SD; reepe , SD; repis , pl. , H.

records.label: Repen
records.text: Repen , v. to cut grain, PP, W, W2; ripen , S; rap , pt. s. , W; repen , pl. , S; ropen , PP; ropun , W; rope , W2.—OMerc. répan ( rýpan , rípan ) Goth. raupjan , to pluck; see Sievers, 159.

records.label: Repples
records.text: Repples , sb. pl. staves, cudgels (?), S.

records.label: Repreuable
records.text: Repreuable , adj. reprehensible, C3, W.

records.label: Repreue
records.text: Repreue , v. to reprove, PP, Prompt., C3; repreued , pp. , S2.—OF. repruever , reprover ; Lat. reprŏbare .

records.label: Repreuynges

records.label: Repromyssioun
records.text: Repromyssioun , sb. promise, W.—Lat. repromissionem (Vulg.).

records.label: Repugnen
records.text: Repugnen , v. to fight against, W2; to deny, PP.—Lat. repugnare .

records.label: Repylle-stok
records.text: Repylle-stok , sb. an implement for cleaning flax, Voc. See Ripple .

records.label: Rerage
records.text: Rerage , sb. arrears, PP, HD; rerages , pl. , PP. Cf. Arerage .

records.label: Rerd
records.text: Rerd , sb. voice, sound, SD; rerid , WA; reorde , S; rorde , SD: rearde , S2; rurd , S2; rerde , dat. , SD, HD.—AS. reord for reard , cp. OHG. rarta : Goth. razda ; cp. Icel. rödd (gen. raddar ).

records.text: Rerden , v. to speak, to sound; reordien , SD; rerdit , pt. pl. , S3.—AS. reordian .

records.label: Reren
records.text: Reren , v. to make to rise, to rear, S2, B; rerde , pt. s. , S, S2; rerid , pp. , S2; rered , S2.—AS. rǽran : Goth. raisjan . See Rysen .

records.label: Resalgar
records.text: Resalgar , sb. realgar, red orpiment, C3, HD.—Sp. rejalgar , arsenic (Minsheu).

records.label: Rescouen
records.text: Rescouen , v. to rescue, SkD; rescowe , CM; reskew , B.—OF. rescou- , stem of rescouant , rescoant , pr. p. of rescorre . See below.

records.label: Rescous
records.text: Rescous , sb. rescue, S3, C, SkD, CM.—OF. rescous ( rescos ) pp. of rescorre , to help, repair a damage, also resqueure (BH); Lat. re + excutere , to shake off.

records.label: Rese
records.text: Rese , sb. and v. ; see Rase .

records.label: Resen
records.text: Resen , v. to shake, C; see Rusien .

records.label: Reset
records.text: Reset , sb. place of refuge, B; see Receyt .

records.label: Resownen
records.text: Resownen , v. to resound; resowne , C; resouned , pt. s. , C2.—OF. resoner ; Lat. resonare .

records.label: Respyt
records.text: Respyt , sb. respite, delay, leisure, C3, C; respyte , Prompt., Cath.; respit , B.—AF. respit ; Late Lat. respectum (acc.), respite, prorogation (Ducange); a technical sense of Lat. respectus , consideration.

records.label: Rest
records.text: Rest , sb. rest; reste , S.—AS. rest ; cp. OHG. resti (Tatian).

records.label: Resten
records.text: Resten , v. to rest, S.—AS. restan ; cp. OHG. resten (Tatian).

records.label: Resun
records.text: Resun , sb. reason, talk, S2, PP, Prompt.; resoun , C2, S2, PP; reson , C2, PP, HD; reison , PP.—AF. resoun ( reison , reasoun ), also raisoun , reason, language; Lat. rationem .

records.label: Resunable
records.text: Resunable , adj. reasonable, talkative, eloquent, Prompt.; resonable , PP; resnabyl , HD; renable , PP; runnable , PP. Notes (p. 23).—AF. resonable , OF. resnable , raisnable ; Lat. rationabilem .

records.label: Retenaunce
records.text: Retenaunce , sb. retinue, company, PP, HD.—AF. retenaunce ; Late Lat. retinentia (Ducange).

records.label: Retenue
records.text: Retenue , sb. retinue, suite, C2.—OF. retenuë , a retinue (Cotg.); Late Lat. retenuta (Ducange). In F. retenue means ‘reserve, modesty’, and has become obsolete in the English sense of a ‘suite’, a body of attendants.

records.label: Rethor
records.text: Rethor , sb. orator, C, C2, Manip.—Late Lat. rhethor ; Lat. rhetor ; Gr. ῥήτωρ .

records.label: Rethoryke
records.text: Rethoryke , sb. rhetoric, C2; retoryke , PP; retoryk , PP.—Lat. rhetorica .

records.label: Retten
records.text: Retten , v. to account, impute, C, H, Prompt., W; rectyn , Prompt.—AF. retter , reter , to accuse (pp. rette , rete ); Lat. reputare see BH, § 153; by popular etymology Low Lat. rectare , ‘in jus vocare,’ rectatus , accused (Schmid). Cf. A-retten .

records.label: Reuful
records.text: Reuful , adj. compassionate, S2; see Rewful .

records.label: Reule
records.text: Reule , sb. rule, PP, C; rewle , PP, S3; riwle , S; reuel , S2; reul , S2; riulen , pl. , S.—AF. reule ; Lat. regula ; also OF. riule , rigle ; Late Lat. rigula (for regula ).

records.label: Reulen
records.text: Reulen , v. to rule, PP, C; rewled , pt. s. , S2.—AF. reuler ; Lat. regulare .

records.label: Reuliche
records.text: Reuliche , adv. ruefully, S2; see Rewliche .

records.label: Reume
records.text: Reume , sb. kingdom; see Rewme .

records.label: Reue
records.text: Reue , sb. reeve, prefect, minister of state, steward, S, PP, Prompt.; reeve , C; reuen , pl. , S. Comb. , ref-schipe , reeveship, prefecture, S.—AS. ( ge ) réfa .

records.label: Reue
records.text: Reue , sb. clothing, spoil, plunder, SD; ræf , SD. Comb. : ref-lac , robbery, S, SD.—AS. réaf clothing, spoil; cp. Icel. rauf , spoil. Cf. Robe .

records.label: Reuel
records.text: Reuel , sb. revel, C; see Reeuel .

records.label: Reuen
records.text: Reuen , v. to rob, plunder, S, S2, S3; reaue , S2; rieue , S3; refand , pr. p. , H; reuede , pt. s. , S; rafte , C2; ræueden , pl. , S: y-raft , pp. , C.—AS. réafian , to despoil.

records.label: Reuere
records.text: Reuere , sb. robber, SD; reuer , S3; ræueres , pl. , S.—AS. réafere .

records.label: Reuing
records.text: Reuing , sb. robbery, S; rauing , S.

records.label: Rewe
records.text: Rewe , sb. row, C; rewis , pl. , S3; see Rawe .

records.label: Rewel
records.text: Rewel (?). Comb. ; rewel boon , C2; rowel boon , CM; reuylle bone , C2 ( n ); ruelle bones , pl. , HD, C2 ( n ); rewle stone , HD (p. 698).

records.label: Rewen
records.text: Rewen , v. to rue, grieve, S, PP, S2, S3, C2; reowen , S; ruwyn , Prompt.; rewing , pr. p. , S3; reouð , pr. s. , S; rwez , S2; rewede , pt. s. , S.—AS. hréowan ; cp. OS. hrewan .

records.label: Rewere
records.text: Rewere , sb. one who pities; reewere , S2.

records.label: Rewful
records.text: Rewful , adj. piteous, S, S2, C3; reuful , S2; reowfule , pl. , S.

records.label: Rewle
records.text: Rewle , sb. rule, S2; see Reule .

records.label: Rewliche
records.text: Rewliche , adj. pitiable, PP; rewli , piteous, S; reweli , S; ruly , HD.—AS. hréowlic .

records.label: Rewliche
records.text: Rewliche , adv. piteously, S; reowliche , S; reuliche , S2; rewli , S; rwly , S2.—AS. hréowlice .

records.label: Rewlyngis
records.text: Rewlyngis , sb. pl. rough shoes, S3; see Riveling .

records.label: Rewme
records.text: Rewme , sb. kingdom, S2, W, H, PP; realme , CM; reaume , C2, S2; reume , PP, S2; reame , S2, PP; reme , C, PP, Cath.; rem , S2; reum , H.—OF. reaume , AF. realme ; Late Lat. * regalimen .

records.label: Rewðe
records.text: Rewðe , sb. ruth, pity, S, C2, C3, G; reowðe , S; rouðe , S2, G; reoðe , S; routh , S3; ruþe , S, S3; rawðe , S2; rewþes , pl. , S2. See Rewen .

records.label: Rewðelese
records.text: Rewðelese , adj. ruthless, C3; rewðles , PP.

records.label: Reyn
records.text: Reyn , sb. rain, W2, PP, C2; rien , S; rein , S; reyne , PP; reane , S3; ran , S3.—AS. regn ( rén ).

records.label: Reynen
records.text: Reynen , v. to rain, PP; reinen , S; ranyt , pt. s. , B.—AS. regnian (also rignan , rínan ), see Sievers, 92.

records.label: Reysed
records.text: Reysed , pp. ridden, C; see Rase .

records.label: Reysen
records.text: Reysen , v. to raise, G, CM; reisen , W2, S; reas , S3.—Icel. reisa ; cp. Goth. raisjan . See Risen , Reren .

records.label: Reȝel
records.text: Reȝel , sb. a garment, rail, SkD; rail , JD; raile , HD; rayle , a kerchief, Palsg., Voc.; rayles , pl. , ND.—AS. hrægl (Voc.). Cf. Y-rayled .

records.label: Riall
records.text: Riall , adj. royal, CM, S3, PP; see Real .

records.label: Rially
records.text: Rially , adv. royally, CM; see Realyche .

records.label: Ribaud
records.text: Ribaud , sb. villain, worthless creature, ribald, PP; rybaud , PP; ribaude , the Evil One, PP; ribalde , PP; ribaut , S3; ribaudes , pl. , sinners, PP; ribauz , S.—AF. ribald (pl. ribaus , ribaldes ), OF. ribaud .

records.label: Ribaudie
records.text: Ribaudie , sb. sin, S2, PP; ribald jesting, C3.—OF. ribaudie .

records.label: Ribaudour
records.text: Ribaudour , sb. profligate fellow, PP; rybaudour , PP.

records.label: Ribaudrie
records.text: Ribaudrie , sb. ribaldry, PP; rybaudrie , PP, S3.

records.label: Riche
records.text: Riche , adj. powerful, rich, S; ryche , PP; ryke , PP; rice , S.—OF. riche .

records.label: Riche
records.text: Riche , sb. kingdom, S, S2; ryche , PP; rice , S; rike , H, S2.—AS. ríce .

records.label: Richelike
records.text: Richelike , adv. richly, S; richeliche , S2.

records.label: Richen
records.text: Richen , v. to grow rich, PP; recheð , pr. pl. , PP.

records.label: Richesse
records.text: Richesse , sb. wealth, PP, S2, S3, C2; ritchesse , W; richeise , S; riches , WW; richesses , pl. , costly articles, S2; ricchessis , WW; riȝtchessis , W.—OF. richese , AF. richesce .

records.label: Rict
records.text: Rict , adj. right, S; see Ryght .

records.label: Riden
records.text: Riden , v. to ride, S, S2; ridend , pr. p. , S; rydinge , C3; ryd , imp. , S; rit , pr. s. , PP, C3; ritt , PP; ryt , PP, C; rad , pt. s. , S2, B; rod , S, S2; rood , C2; riden , pl. , S, C3, C; rade , S2; raid , B; riden , pp. , C2; rad , B. Comb. : redyng-kyng , a kind of feudal retainer, PP; redyng-kynges , pl. , PP.—AS. rídan , pt. s. rád , pl. ridon .

records.label: Ridere
records.text: Ridere , sb. rider, S; rideres , pl. , S; rideren , S.

records.label: Ridil
records.text: Ridil , sb. a sieve, Prompt.; rydelle , Cath.; ryddel , ruddle, Cath. ( n ). Cf. Rydder .

records.text: Ridilen , v. to sift; rydelyn , Prompt.; ridile , W; ridlande , pr. p. , S2. Phr. : riddlide watris = Lat. cribrans aquas (Vulg.), Cath. ( n ).

records.text: Rif , v. to rive, S2; see Ryuen .

records.label: Rift
records.text: Rift , sb. veil, curtain; rifft , S.—AS. rift ; cp. Icel. ript , ripti .

records.label: Riften
records.text: Riften , v. eructare , H (Ps. 18. 2); rift , to belch, Manip.—Icel. rypta .

records.label: Riht
records.text: Riht , adj. and sb. right, S; see Ryght .

records.label: Rihten
records.text: Rihten , v. to direct, correct, S; rigten , to set straight, S; riȝti , S2; rightid , pt. s. , S2.—AS. rihtan .

records.label: Rihtlecen
records.text: Rihtlecen , v. to direct, set right, S; riȝtleche , S2, HD; ryȝtlokede , pp. , S3.—AS. rihtlǽcan .

records.label: Rihtwis
records.text: Rihtwis , adj. righteous, S; see Ryght .

records.label: Rike
records.text: Rike , sb. kingdom, S2; see Riche .

records.text: Rikenare , sb. reckoner, S.

records.label: Rikenen
records.text: Rikenen , v. to reckon, S, PP; see Rekenen .

records.label: Rin
records.text: Rin , v. to run, S3; see Rennen .

records.label: Ring
records.text: Ring , v. to reign, S3; see Regnen .

records.label: Riot
records.text: Riot , v. to revel, live dissolutely, gluttonously, WW; ryot , B; riotte , to be dissolute, luxuriare , Manip.

records.label: Riote
records.text: Riote , sb. uproar, SkD; riot , dissolute, luxurious living, WW; riotte , Manip.; ryot , depredation, B.—AF. riote ( ryot ), confusion, OF. rïote , quarrelling (Bartsch), also feasting (Ducange); cp. ODu. revot , ‘caterva nebulonum, luxuria’; see SkD.

records.label: Riotour
records.text: Riotour , sb. rioter; rioter , glutton, WW; ryotoures , pl. , C3.—AF. riotour , OF. riotheir (Ps. 36. 1).

records.label: Riotour
records.text: Riotour , adj. luxurious, dissolute, WW.—Cp. Low Lat. riotosus (Ducange).

records.label: Ripe
records.text: Ripe , adj. fit for reaping, mature, S; rype , C2.

records.label: Ripen
records.text: Ripen , v. to become ripe, Prompt.; ripede , pt. s. , S.—AS. rípian .

records.label: Ripen
records.text: Ripen , v. to divide by tearing open, to rip, to search diligently, examine, HD, JD, SkD (s.v. rip ); rype , Palsg.; riped , pt. s. , S2.—Cp. Swed. repa , to scratch.

records.label: Ripple
records.text: Ripple , sb. an instrument for ripping off the flax-seeds, JD. Comb. : repylle-stok , an implement for cleaning flax, Voc.

records.label: Ripplen
records.text: Ripplen , v. to ripple flax, JD; rypelen , SkD, Prompt.

records.label: Rishe
records.text: Rishe , sb. rush, S3; see Rusche .

records.label: Rist
records.text: Rist , pr. s. riseth, rises, C3; see Rysen .

records.label: Rit
records.text: Rit , pr. s. rides, C3; see Riden .

records.label: Riuelic
records.text: Riuelic , adv. frequently, S2. See Ryfe .

records.label: Riveling
records.text: Riveling , sb. a kind of shoe, SD, HD; rullion , JD; rewlyngis , pl. , S3; rowlyngis , JD.—AS. rifelingas , ‘obstrigelli’ (Voc.); cp. AF. rivelinges , rivelins .

records.label: Rixan
records.text: Rixan , v. to reign, S.—AS. rícsian ( ríxian ); cp. OHG. rîhhisôn (Tatian), see Sievers, 411. See Riche .

records.label: Rixlien
records.text: Rixlien , v. to reign, S. See above.

records.label: Riȝt
records.text: Riȝt , sb. right, justice, S2; see Ryght .

records.label: Ro
records.text: Ro , sb. quiet, S2; see Roo .

records.label: Robben
records.text: Robben , v. to plunder, spoil, rob, SkD, PP; robby , S2.—AF. robber ; cp. It. robbare , to rob (Florio).

records.label: Robbeour
records.text: Robbeour , sb. robber, PP; robbour , PP.—AF. robeöur , OF. robeör ; Low Lat. robatorem ; cp. It. robbatore , robber (Florio).

records.label: Robe
records.text: Robe , sb. robe, PP; robes , pl. , clothes, PP; robis , PP.—AF. robe ; cp. It. róbba , gown, robe, goods (Florio).

records.label: Roberie
records.text: Roberie , sb. robbery, S.—AF. roberie .

records.label: Roche
records.text: Roche , sb. rock, S, S3, C2, H; rooch , S2, W2. Comb. : roche-wall , rock-wall, S.—AF. roche .

records.label: Rod
records.text: Rod , pt. s. rode, S, S2; see Riden .

records.label: Rode
records.text: Rode , sb. a road, a riding, SkD, WW, Sh.; rade , S2, JD; roade , WW; roode , place where vessels ride at anchor, bitalassum , Prompt.—AS. rád .

records.label: Rode
records.text: Rode , sb. red complexion, C2, S2; see Rude .

records.label: Rody
records.text: Rody , adj. ruddy, S2, C2, PP; rodi , W.

records.label: Roggen
records.text: Roggen , v. to shake, PP, HD, S2, Prompt.; rug , JD.—Icel. rugga , to rock a cradle.

records.label: Rohten
records.text: Rohten , pt. pl. recked, S; see Rechen .

records.label: Roial
records.text: Roial , adj. royal, CM; see Real .

records.label: Roialtee
records.text: Roialtee , sb. royalty, C3; see Realte .

records.label: Rokke
records.text: Rokke , sb. a distaff, Prompt., Cath., HD; rok , S3; roche , Manip.; rocks , pl. , S3, HD.—Icel. rokkr .

records.label: Rokken
records.text: Rokken , v. to rock, Prompt.; y-rokked , pp. , S2.

records.label: Romblen
records.text: Romblen , v. to ramble; romblynge , pr. p. , PP.

records.label: Romen
records.text: Romen , v. to rove about, to ramble, wander, roam, C2, C3, PP, SkD; rame , HD; raymen , PP, S2; rowme , PP; rombe , PP. Cp. OS. rómón , OHG. râmên , to strive after (Otfrid).

records.label: Romere
records.text: Romere , sb. roamer, wanderer, PP; rowmer , PP; romares , pl. , PP; romberis , PP.

records.label: Rome-renneres
records.text: Rome-renneres , sb. pl. agents at the court of Rome, PP.

records.label: Ron
records.text: Ron , pt. s. ran, S2; see Rennen .

records.label: Rong
records.text: Rong , pt. s. rang, C3; see Ryngen .

records.label: Roo
records.text: Roo , sb. roe, deer, S2, Prompt.; ro , S2; ra , JD; rays , pl. , S3.—AS. ráh (Voc.), also ráha (Voc.), see Sievers, 117.

records.label: Roo
records.text: Roo , sb. rest, quiet, S2, HD; ro , HD, S2.—Icel. ró AS. rów : OHG. ruowa (G. ruhe ).

records.label: Rood
records.text: Rood , pt. s. rode, C2; see Riden .

records.label: Roode
records.text: Roode , sb. the rood, cross, gallows, PP, G, Prompt.; rode , PP, S, S2, S3; rude , B; roid , B; rod , a rod, SkD. Phr. : rule the rod , to bear sway, NQ (6. 3. 169); Comb. : rode-tre , the cross, S2; rude evyn , eve of the Rood (Sept. 13), B.—AS. ród : OS. róda ; cp. OHG. ruoda (G. rute ).

records.label: Roof
records.text: Roof , sb. roof, W, Prompt.; rhof , SkD; roff , PP; roue , S3; rofe , PP; roouys , pl. , W2.—AS. hróf .

records.label: Roomth
records.text: Roomth , sb. room, space, ND. See Rowm .

records.label: Roomthie
records.text: Roomthie , adj. spacious, Cotg. (s.v. large ).

records.label: Roomthsome
records.text: Roomthsome , adj. spacious, DG.

records.label: Rop
records.text: Rop , sb. a rope, PP; rapes , pl. , S.—AS. ráp ; cp. Icel. reip .

records.label: Rope
records.text: Rope , pt. pl. reaped, W2; see Repen .

records.label: Ropere
records.text: Ropere , sb. rope-maker or rope-seller, PP.

records.label: Roploch
records.text: Roploch , adj. coarse, applied to woollen stuffs, JD; sb. coarse woollen cloth, S3 raplach , raplock , reploch , JD.

records.label: Roren
records.text: Roren , v. to roar, C, PP; roorin , Prompt.; rarin , H (Ps. 76. i); rar , B; rair , S3, B.—AS. rárian , to lament loudly, to bellow.

records.label: Ros
records.text: Ros , pt. s. rose, S, C2; see Rysen .

records.label: Rose
records.text: Rose , sb. rose, Prompt.; roose , W2; rois , S3; ross , S3 (11 a. 6); rosen , pl. , SkD; roosis , W2. Comb. : rose-reed , red as a rose, C3.—OProv. rose ; Lat. rosa ; cp. AS. róse .

records.label: Rosen
records.text: Rosen , v. to praise, reflex. to boast, H; roose , JD; ruse , JD; roysen , H; rees , JD.—Icel. hrósa , to praise, reflex. to boast, from hróðr , praise, fame.

records.label: Rospen
records.text: Rospen , v. to scrape, S; see Raspen .

records.label: Rost
records.text: Rost , sb. roast (meat), PP; roste , PP. Phr. : rules the rost , takes the lead, domineers, S3, ND, NQ (6. 3. 170), HD (s.v. rule-stone , SPD (s.v. roast ).—AF. rost , roste .

records.label: Roste
records.text: Roste , v. to roast, C; y-rosted , pp. , S3.—OF. rostir .

records.label: Rote
records.text: Rote , sb. root, W2, PP, S2, C2; rot , S2; roote , a term in astrology, S2, C3; foot, C2; rutis , pl. , S3; rotes , PP.—Icel. rót ; the same word as AS. wrót , snout, ‘bruncus;’ see Voc. (cp. wrótan , to grub up).

records.label: Rote
records.text: Rote , sb. a musical instrument, C, HD, ND, SkD; roote , HD.—AF. rote ; OHG. hrota ; cp. Low Lat. chrotta , OIr. crot (Windisch). Cf. Crowde .

records.label: Rote
records.text: Rote , v. to rot, H (Ps. 15. 10). Der. : rotyng , rotting, S2.—AS. rotian .

records.label: Rote
records.text: Rote , in phr. by rote ; see Route .

records.label: Roten
records.text: Roten , adj. rotten, C3; rotyn , HD; rotun , W2; rottyn , B.—Cp. Icel. rotinn , perhaps a pp. form.

records.text: Roðer , sb. a paddle for rowing, used also as a rudder, S, S2; rothyr , Prompt.; rodyr , Voc., Prompt.; rudyr , oar, Cath.; rither , rudder, DG. See Rowen .

records.label: Roðer
records.text: Roðer , sb. an ox, SD, HD; reðer , SD; reoðer , SD; reoðeren , pl. , SD; reðeren , SD; roðeren , S3; roðeron , S2; riðeren , SD; ruðeren , SD. Phr. : rule the rother , ND. records.label: Roþun
records.text: Roþun , sb. a driving storm, S2.—Cp. Icel. róði , the wind, tempest.

records.label: Rouken
records.text: Rouken , v. to lie close, cower down, CM, C, HD, JD.

records.label: Rouncle
records.text: Rouncle , v. to wrinkle, S2; see Runkylle .

records.label: Rouncy
records.text: Rouncy , sb. a horse, C, CM; rounsy , HD; rownsy , HD.—AF. runcin (Roland); cp. OF. roucin (F. roussin ), Sp. rocin , whence rocinante , see Diez, p. 277.

records.label: Rounde
records.text: Rounde , adj. round, PP.—AF. rounde , OF. reont , roont ; Lat. rotundum (acc.).

records.label: Roundel

records.label: Spousaille

records.label: Spouse
records.text: Spouse , sb. spouse, bridegroom, bride, W; spuse , S; spowse , Prompt. Comb. : spousbreche , adulterer, SD; spusbruche , adultery, SD; spousebrekere , adulterer, W; spoushod , marriage, S2.—AF. espouse ( espuse ); Lat. sponsam ; also OF. espos , spous ; Lat. sponsum ; see BH, § 169.

records.label: Spousen
records.text: Spousen , v. to espouse, W, S2, C2; spousi , S2; i-spoused , pp. , S2; y-spoused , S2; i-spused , S.—OF. espouser ; Lat. sponsare .

records.label: Sprayngis
records.text: Sprayngis , sb. pl. sprinklings, S3. See Sprengen .

records.label: Spreden
records.text: Spreden , v. to spread, PP, S, S2; spradde , pt. s. , C2; spredd , pp. , S; sprad , C; y-sprad , C2.—AS. sprǽdan .

records.text: Spreit , sb. spirit, S3; spyryte , Prompt.—Lat. spiritus .

records.text: Sprengen , v. to sprinkle, W, G; sprente , pt. s. , S3; spreynten , pl. , W2; spreynd , pp. , S2, C2, C3, W; spreind , W; spreynt , W; y-spreynd , C.—AS. sprengan , causal of springan .

records.text: Sprengen , v. to spring, to be diffused; sprent , pt. s. , S3.—AS. sprengan , to spring (Sweet).

records.text: Sprenkelin , v. to sprinkle, to dart, Prompt.; sprynkland , pr. p. , darting in various directions (of fish in the water), S3.

records.label: Spring

Der. : springing , beginning, source, C2.—AS. springan , pt. sprang (pl. sprungon ), pp. sprungen .

records.text: Springen , v. to make to spring, rouse; sprange , pt. pl. , S3. See below.

records.label: Springen
records.text: Springen , v. to sprinkle, C2; y-spronge , pp. , S2. Der. : springyng , sprinkling, W. See Sprengen .

records.text: Spuylis , pl. spoils, W; see Spoile .

records.label: Spynke
records.text: Spynke , sb. finch, rostellus , Voc.; spink , Cotg., JD, HD; spynk , S3 (s.v. gold ). Cp. Gr. σπίγγος , and OF. pinçon (BH), F. pinson .

records.text: Spynnare , sb. spinner, spider, Prompt.; spinner , Sh., HD.

records.text: Spyrakle , sb. the breath of life, S2.—Lat. spiraculum uitae , Gen. 7. 22 (Vulg.).

records.text: Squaymous , adj. loth, fastidious, CM; see Skeymowse .

records.label: Squier
records.text: Squier , sb. squire, S, C2; squyer , C2, S2.—OF. esquïer , escuier ; Late Lat. scutarium , from Lat. scutum , shield; cp. It. scudiére .

records.label: Squyler
records.text: Squyler , sb. dish-washer, S2; sqwyllare , Prompt., SkD (s.v. scullery ); swyllere , Voc.—OF. sculier (Ducange); Late Lat. scutelarium , one in charge of the dishes (Ducange); from Lat. scutella . (It seems to have been confused with swiller ; see SkD, s.v. scullery .—W. W. S.)

records.label: Squylerey
records.text: Squylerey , sb. room for washing dishes in, a scullery, SkD.—Cp. OF. esculier ; Late Lat. scutellarium , ‘locus ubi reponuntur scutellae’ (Ducange). See above.

records.label: Sqware
records.text: Sqware , adj. square, Prompt.; sware , S2.—OF. esquarre ; Lat. ex + quadram ; cp. It. squadra .

records.label: Srid
records.text: Srid , pt. s. clothed, S; see Schrouden .

records.text: Srud , sb. dress, S; see Schroud .

records.text: Sseawere , sb. a mirror, S2; see Schawere .

records.label: Sseawy
records.text: Sseawy , v. to show, S2; see Schewen .

records.text: Ssoldren , pl. shoulders, S2; see Schuldere .

records.label: Stable
records.text: Stable , adj. constant, firm, fixed, C2, W, PP; stabli , adv. , W.—AF. estable ; Lat. stabilem .

records.label: Stable
records.text: Stable , v. to establish, confirm, to cause to rest, S3, W, P, C; y-stabled , S3.—OF. establir .

records.label: Stablischen
records.text: Stablischen , v. to establish, W; stablisse , PP.—OF. establiss- , stem of establissant , pp. of establir .

records.text: Stac , pt. s. closed up, S2; see Steken .

records.text: Stad , pp. bestead, circumstanced, beset, WA, S2.—Icel. staddr , circumstanced, Swed. stadd .

records.text: Staf , sb. a staff, stick, a letter of the alphabet, PP, SD; staffe , Prompt.; staues , pl. , S2, PP. Comb. : stef-creft , the art of grammar, S; staf-slinge , staff-sling, C2; staff-slynge , HD; staff-slyngere , staff-slinger, HD.—AS. stæf , staff, stick, twig, letter written on a twig, see Weigand (s.v. buchstab ); cp. Icel. stafr , OHG. stab , buohstab (Tatian).

records.text: Stalken , v. to step slowly, C, G; stalkyn , Prompt.; stalked him , pt. s. refl. , C2.—AS. stealcian ; see Sweet, Anglo-Saxon Primer , 83. 37.

records.label: Stalle
records.text: Stalle , sb. place, state, station, prison, stall, booth, PP, Prompt.; steal , S; stal , Prompt.; stale , S3.—AS. steal : OHG. stal (Otfrid).

records.label: Stamyn
records.text: Stamyn , sb. stamine, linsey-woolsey cloth, a garment made of that material, Prompt., Cath. ( n ); stamin , S; stamine , HD.—OF. estamine , tamine, also a strainer (Cotg.).

records.label: Stamyn
records.text: Stamyn , sb. the stem, bows of a vessel, S2; stamyne , Cath. ( n ).—Icel. stafn , stamn , a post, prow-post, also stern-post; cp. It. stamine , the upright ribs or pieces of timber of the inside of a ship, of our shipwrights called foot-stocks (Florio).

records.text: Stane , sb. dat. stone, S; see Stoon .

records.text: Stang , sb. stagnant pool; stanc , S2; stank , HD; stangis , pl. , H; stangeȝ , S2; staunkis , H.—OF. estang , estan ( estanc ); Lat. stagnum .

records.text: Stannyris , sb. pl. the small stones and gravel at the side of a river, S3. See Stoon .

records.text: Starnys , pl. stars, S3; see Sterne .

records.label: Stat
records.text: Stat , sb. state, condition, S2; staat , existence (= Lat. status ), W. Cf. Estat .

records.text: Steoren , v. to perfume with incense, S.—Cp. AS. stéran (Leo). See Stor .

records.text: Steoren , v. lead, direct, S; see Steren .

records.label: Steorren
records.text: Steorren , pl. stars, S; see Sterre .

records.text: Step-barn , sb. orphan, H.—Cp. AS. step-cild , orphan, Ps. 67. 6 (VP); AS. stéop , orphaned; cp. OHG. stiuf .

records.label: Stepe
records.text: Stepe , adj. steep, WA, SkD.—AS. stéap .

records.label: Stepe
records.text: Stepe , adj. bright, shining (of eyes), CM, C, S3, HD; steapre , comp. , S3 (p. 426).

records.label: Stere
records.text: Stere , adj. strong, stout, firm, S, HD. See Store .

records.text: Stere , sb. tiller, helm, rudder, steering-gear, the stern of a ship, C3, S; steere , W2; stiere , PP. Comb. : sterelees , without a rudder, S2, C3; sterman , steersman. Voc.—Icel. stýri , rudder.

records.label: Stere
records.text: Stere , sb. helmsman, C3, S2.

records.label: Steren
records.text: Steren , v. to lead, direct, steer, S, S3, PP; steir , B; steoren , S.—AS. stéoran , stýran .

records.label: Steren
records.text: Steren , v. to stir, to move, S2, WA, PP; see Stiren .

records.label: Sterlinge
records.text: Sterlinge , sb. coin, penny of standard currency, C3, PP, SkD.—Cp. Low Lat. sterlingus (Ducange).

records.label: Sterne
records.text: Sterne , sb. star, WA, H, S2; stern , S2, B; starnys , pl. , S3.—Icel. stjarna . Cf. Sterre .

records.label: Sterne
records.text: Sterne , adj. stern, Prompt.; sturne , S, S2; steryn , WA; sterin , HD; steryne , HD; stiarne , pl. , S; adv. , S; sterne , PP; sternelich , CM, PP. Der. : sturnhede , sternness, S2.—AS. styrne .

records.text: Sterre , sb. star, S, S2, S3, C2, C3, W, PP; storre , S; steorren , pl. , S; steores , S; sterris , W, PP; sterren , S, S2. Comb. : sterre-liht , starlight, S2. Der. : i-stirret , starred, S; stirrede , SD.—AS. steorra : OS. sterro ; cp. OHG. sterro (Tatian).

records.label: Steruing
records.text: Steruing , sb. dying, S2.

records.label: Steuene
records.text: Steuene , sb. voice, command, note, C2, S; steuen , S2; time of performing any action, CM; stefne , S; stevynnys , pl. , S3.—AS. stefn : Goth. stibna ; cp. OHG. stemna (Tatian), G. stimme .

records.text: Stewe , sb. fish-pond, vivarium , C, HD, SD, CM, Prompt.; stwe , Prompt.

records.text: Stewe , sb. bath, Cath.; stue , Cath. ( n ); stwe , Prompt.; stewes , pl. brothels, PP; stywes , CM; stues , P.

records.text: Stiarne , adj. pl. stern, S; see Sterne .

records.text: Sticchen , v. to prick, stitch, SD; stiȝte , pt. s. , SD; stiȝt , pp. , SD; i-stihd , S; i-sticched , S (p. 119).

records.text: Sties , pl. paths, S2; stighes , H; see Sty .

records.text: Stikien , v. to stick, to pierce, stab, S, S2, C2, C3; styken , S2; steek , S3; stekit , pt. s. , B; stekyt , S3; y-styked , pp. , S2.—AS. stician . See Steken .

records.label: Stikke
records.text: Stikke , sb. stick, C3; stykke , Prompt.

records.label: Stillatorie
records.text: Stillatorie , sb. vessel used in distillation, C3, CM; stillatory , a place where distillations are performed, ND.—Late Lat. stillatorium , from Lat. ( di ) stillare .

records.text: Stingen , v. to sting; stonge , pt. pl. , S; stongen , pp. , C, H; y-stongen , S3; y-stonge , C3; stungen , H.—AS. stingan , pt. stang (pl. stungon ), pp. stungen .

records.label: Stiren
records.text: Stiren , v. to stir, to move, to instigate, PP, C3, W2, S, S2; stere , PP, S2, G; sturen , S, W; styren , S; steir , S3, B.—AS. styrian .

records.label: Stiring
records.text: Stiring , sb. stirring, commotion, W, W2.

records.label: Stith
records.text: Stith , sb. anvil, C, CM, Sh.; stythe , Prompt.—Icel. steði .

records.label: Stobil
records.text: Stobil , sb. stubble, W2; stobul , Prompt.—AF. stuble (Ps. 82. 12, Oxford Psalter): Prov. estobla ; OTeut. * stuppula ; cp. OF. estoulle (Ps. 82. 13), F. éteule ; see Kluge (s.v. stoppel ), and BH, § 153.

records.label: Stok

records.label: Stonge
records.text: Stonge , pt. pl. stung, S; see Stingen .

records.label: Stonien
records.text: Stonien , v. to stun, to make a loud din, to amaze with a blow, SD; stunay , H; stunayd , pp. , H; stoynde , S3. See Astonen .

records.label: Stoniynge
records.text: Stoniynge , sb. astonishment, W; stonying , W; stoneyinge , S2; stoynynge , Prompt.

records.label: Stont
records.text: Stont , pr. s. of Standen .

records.label: Stony
records.text: Stony , adj. rocky, Prompt. Comb. : stony see , Adria, the Adriatic Sea, W.—Cp. Ducange ‘ adria , petra; adriaticus , petrosus, lapidosus portus.’

records.label: Stoon
records.text: Stoon , sb. stone, PP, W2; ston , PP, S, S3; stane , dat. , S; stanes , pl. , S. Comb. : stoon-stille , still as a stone, G.—AS. stán : Goth. stains .

records.label: Stoor
records.text: Stoor , sb. store, stock, provision, Prompt., C, C2, C3, G; store , PP. Phr. : telle no store , set no store by, set no value upon, C.—OF. estore (Bartsch).

records.text: Stope , pp. advanced, C; stopen , CM, SkD (s.v. step ).—AS. stapen , pp. of stapan (pt. stóp ).

records.text: Stor , sb. incense, S; store , dat. , S.—AS. stór , incense, storax; Lat. storacem , acc. of storax (Vulg.), also styrax ; Gr. στύραξ .

records.label: Stordy

records.text: Tapet , sb. cloth, hangings, tapestry, Prompt., ND; tappet , HD; tapite , S3; tapyt , Voc.; tapett , Cath.; tapetis , pl. (= Lat. tapetes ), W2; tapites , HD; tapets , S3. Der. : tapiter , a maker of tapestry, HD.—Lat. tapete , from Gr. ταπήτιον Cf. Tapecer .

records.label: Taske
records.text: Taske , sb. a taxing, Prompt.; a task, HD, Palsg.—Cp. Late Lat. tasca for taxa , a tax. See Taxen .

records.label: Tasker
records.text: Tasker , sb. a thrasher, Voc., HD; taskar , B; taskur , Bardsley.

records.label: Tassel
records.text: Tassel , sb. male hawk; see Tercel .

records.label: Tast
records.text: Tast , sb. taste, S3, PP; taast , Prompt.

records.text: Tasten , v. to feel, touch, kiss, taste, C3, PP; taasten , Prompt.; tast , pt. s. , probed, HD.—OF. taster , to feel by touch, to taste (F. tâter ); Late Lat. * taxitare , frequent. of Lat. taxare , to handle.

records.text: Tatter , a shred, loose-hanging rag, a ragged person, ND, SkD; totters , pl. , rags, Sh. Der. : tatered , adj. , jagged, S3.—Icel. tötturr (for tölturr ), töturr .
