records.text: Þrosshen , pp. threshed, S; see Þreschen .

records.label: Þrote
records.text: Þrote , sb. throat, S, PP.—AS. þrotu (Voc.); cp. OHG. drozza (whence G. drossel ); related to Du. stroot ; cp. It. strozza (Diez). See Kluge (s.v. drossel ).

records.label: Þrowe
records.text: Þrowe , sb. a little while, course, time, moment, Prompt., PP, S2, C2, C3, HD; throw , HD; þroȝe , S; thrawe , S2; thraw , S2, B.—AS. þrág .

records.label: Þrowe
records.text: Þrowe , sb. suffering, aerumna , SD, Prompt.

records.label: Þrowen
records.text: Þrowen , v. to throw, S; þreu , pt. s. , S; þrewe , threw himself, P; 2 pt. s. , S; þrowe , PP; þrawen , pp. , S2; þrowen , S2; y-throwe , C2.—AS. þráwan , to twist, to whirl, pt. þréow , pp. þráwen .

records.label: Þrowen
records.text: Þrowen , v. to suffer, S; þrowede , pt. s. , S.—AS. þrowian ; cp. OHG. thruoén (Tatian).

records.label: Þrowunge
records.text: Þrowunge , sb. suffering, passion; þroweunge , dat. , S; þrowenge , S; þroweinge , S.—AS. þrowung .

records.label: Þrublen
records.text: Þrublen , v. to press, crowd; þrublande , pr. p. , S2.

records.label: Þruh
records.text: Þruh , sb. coffin, S; throh , HD.—AS. þruh .

records.label: Þrum
records.text: Þrum , sb. strength, a crowd, glory, SD; þrom , SD. Comb. : þrim-setel , thronus , SD; þrimsettles , pl. , S.—AS. þrymm , þrymsetl .

records.label: Þrunnesse
records.text: Þrunnesse , sb. Trinity, S; see Þreo .

records.label: Þruppe
records.text: Þruppe , adv. thereupon, S; see Þer- .

records.label: Þrusche
records.text: Þrusche , sb. a thrush, S.—AS. þrysce .

records.label: Þrustel
records.text: Þrustel , sb. the song-thrush, S; þrostle , S. Comb. : þrustel-cock , thrustlecock, C2; þrestelcoc , S2.—AS. þrostle (Voc.).

records.label: Þrusten
records.text: Þrusten , v. to thrust, SD; threste , C; thristen , W; thruste , pt. s. , W; þrist , S; þriste , pp. , S.—Icel. þrýsta .

records.label: Þu
records.text: Þu , pron. thou, S; see Þou .

records.label: Þues
records.text: Þues , pron. dem. pl. these, S2; see Þes .

records.label: Þuften
records.text: Þuften , sb. handmaid, S; þuhten , S.—A fem. deriv. of AS. ( ge ) þofta , a comrade, properly one who sits on the same rowing-bench; from þofta ‘transtra’ (Voc.); cp. Icel. þopta .

records.label: Þulke
records.text: Þulke , adj. that, those, S2; see Þilke .

records.label: Þulli
records.text: Þulli , adj. such, S, SD; þellich , SD; þellyche , S2.—AS. þullic , þyllic , also þuslic , þyslic , from þus ; see Sievers, 349. See Þus .

records.label: Þunre
records.text: Þunre , sb. thunder, S; see Þoner .

records.label: Þurfen
records.text: Þurfen , v. to need; þarf , pt.-pr. s. , need, ei opus est , S; thare , H; thar , H; tharst , 2 pt.-pr. s. , PP; þurt , pt. s. , needed, S2, H, B. Comb. : thardestow , thou wouldst need, PP.—AS. þurfan , pt.-pr. þearf ; pt. þorfte ( þurfte ), Icel. þurfa , pt.-pr. þarf ; pt. þurfum ; cp. OHG. thurfan , to need (Tatian).

records.label: Þurgh
records.text: Þurgh , prep. through, S2, C2; þurȝ , S2, W2; þureȝ , S; þurh , S; þurch , S; þuruh , S; þorȝ , S2; þoruȝ , S2, W2; þorw , S; þoru , S, S2; thorou , W; thurght , H; þurð S, S2; þurf , S2, HD; þoruȝlike , adv. , thoroughly, S. Comb. : thurghfare , thoroughfare, C; þurhfaren , to pass through; thurghfare , S2; thurgh-girt , pierced through, C; thurchhurt , thoroughly hurt, S3; þurh-lefien , to live through; þurhlefede , pt. s. , S; þurh-seon , to perceive; þurhsihð , pr. s. , S; þuruh-ut , wholly, S; thurghout , C2; þuruhtut , throughout, S; þoru-out , S2.—AS. þurh ; cp. OHG. thuruh (Tatian).

records.label: Þurl
records.text: Þurl , sb. an aperture for admitting light, a hole, S; thurles , pl. , HD.—AS. þyrel , hole, from þurh , through; so (with different suffix) Goth. thairko , hole, the eye of a needle, from thairh , through; see Kluge (s.v. durch ). See Þurh .

records.label: Þurlen
records.text: Þurlen , v. to pierce, S, S2, PP; þirlen , C, S2, PP, H; thrill , H.—AS. þyrlian ( þirlian ).

records.label: Þurst
records.text: Þurst , sb. thirst, S, C2; see Þrist .

records.label: Þus
records.text: Þus , adv. thus, S; tus , S (in Ormulum). Comb. : þusgate , in this way, PP; þusgates , HD, PP.—AS. þus , OS. thus .

records.label: Þuster
records.text: Þuster , adj. dark, S; see Þester .

records.label: Þut
records.text: Þut , for Þu it , S; see Þou .

records.label: Þuvele
records.text: Þuvele , sb. pl. twigs, S.—AS. þýfel , ‘frutex’ (Voc.). See Þefe .

records.label: Þwang
records.text: Þwang , sb. thong, S; see Þwong .

records.label: Þwert
records.text: Þwert , adv. thwart, SD. Comb. : þwert-ut , throughout, S.—Icel. þvert , neuter of þverr , transverse; cp. AS. þweorh , Goth. thwairhs , angry, cross.

records.label: Þwong
records.text: Þwong , sb. strip of leather, thong, S, S2, W; þwang S; þong S.—AS. þwang .

records.label: Þwytel
records.text: Þwytel , sb. a knife, whittle; thwitel , SkD; thewtill , S3. See below.

records.label: Þwyten
records.text: Þwyten , v. to cut, to whittle, Voc., Prompt., Palsg. Der. : thwytynge , cutting, whittling, PP.—AS. þwítan .

records.label: Þy
records.text: Þy , sb. thigh, Prompt.; þe , SkD, HD; þee , HD; þyȝ , S2; þih , SkD; þeiȝ , SkD.—AS. þéo , þéoh .

records.label: Þyester
records.text: Þyester , adj. dark, S2; see Þester .

records.label: Þyesternesse
records.text: Þyesternesse , sb. darkness, S2; see Þesternesse .

records.label: Þyht
records.text: Þyht , adj. close, compact, tight. Prompt.; thite , HD; tiȝt , SkD.—Cp. G. dicht , Icel. þéttr ; see Kluge (s.v.).

records.label: Þyhtyn
records.text: Þyhtyn , v. to make tight, Prompt.; y-tiȝt , pp. , S3.

records.label: Þynken
records.text: Þynken , v. to seem; þynkeþ , pr. s. impers. , PP; þuncð , S; þunchð , S; þincheð , S; þinkð , S; þingð , S2; þenkeð , PP; þuhte , pt. s. , S; þuȝte , S; þoȝte , S2; thoughte , C3; þout , S2.—AS. þyncan , pt. þúhte , pp. ( ge ) púht . See Þenchen .

records.label: Ti
records.text: Ti , pron. poss. thy, S; see Þou .

records.label: Tid
records.text: Tid , sb. time, season, hour, hora canonica , S, S2, S3; tide , S2; tyde , S2, C3, PP. Comb. : tideful , seasonable (= Lat. opportunus ), H; tydfulnes , needfulness, H.—AS. tíd , time, hour; cp. Icel. tíð , time, ‘hora canonica.’

records.label: Tid
records.text: Tid , adv. quickly, PP; tyd , PP. See Tit .

records.label: Tiden
records.text: Tiden , v. to happen, S; tyden , S2, C3; tid , pr. s. , PP; tit , PP; tydde , pt. s. , PP; tidde , S2.—AS. tídan .

records.label: Tidi
records.text: Tidi , adj. seasonable, honest, respectable, S; tidy , PP; tydy , PP, Prompt.

records.label: Tidif
records.text: Tidif , sb. the name of some very small bird, C2; tydy , a sort of singing bird, ND.

records.label: Tiding
records.text: Tiding , sb. an event, tidings, S; tyding , C2, C3; tidinge , pl. , S2; tydinge , S; tydinges , C2. See Tiðing .

records.label: Tiffen
records.text: Tiffen , v. to trick out, trim, adorn, SkD.—OF. tiffer , to trim, adorn.

records.label: Tiffung
records.text: Tiffung , sb. adornment, finery, S.

records.label: Til
records.text: Til , prep. and conj. to, till, S, PP, S2, C3; tyl , S, PP; till , S, S3.—Icel. til .

records.label: Tilden
records.text: Tilden , v. to set a trap, S; tildeþ , 2 pr. pl. , set up, S3; see Telden .

records.label: Tilien
records.text: Tilien , v. to till, cultivate, earn, gain, PP; tilen , S, PP; tylie , PP; tulien , PP; telie , PP; tolie , S; tylle , S2.—AS. tilian , to aim at, to till land; cp. OHG. zilón , to attempt (Tatian).

records.label: Tilier
records.text: Tilier , sb. tiller, husbandman, W.

records.label: Tillen
records.text: Tillen , v. to draw, entice, S, H, PP; see Tollen .

records.label: Tilðe
records.text: Tilðe , sb. labour, toil, tilth, S; tulthe , PP; telðe , PP.—AS. tilð . See Tilien .

records.label: Timen
records.text: Timen , v. to prosper, S.—Icel. tíma (reflex.), to happen.

records.label: Tin
records.text: Tin , pron. poss. thy, thine, S; see Þou .

records.label: Tinsel
records.text: Tinsel , sb. a stuff made partly of silk and partly of silver, S3, TG, SkD.—OF. estincelle , a spark, a flash (BH).

records.label: Tintreȝe
records.text: Tintreȝe , sb. torment; tintreow , S; tintreohe , S; tintreohen , pl. , S.—AS. tintreg (Grein).

records.label: Tirannye
records.text: Tirannye , sb. tyranny, C2, C3; tirandye , HD.

records.label: Tiraunt
records.text: Tiraunt , sb. tyrant, C2, PP; tyraunt , PP, W; tirant , S2; tyrauns , pl. , oppressors, PP.—AF. and OF. tirant , tiranz ; Lat. tyrannus ; see Constans, Supplement, p. 57, and BH, § 72.

records.label: Tirauntrie
records.text: Tirauntrie , sb. tyranny, W2; tyrauntrye , HD.

records.label: Tis-dæi
records.text: Tis-dæi , sb. Tuesday, S; Tisdei , S.—AS. Tíwes-dæg , the day of Tiw , the English name of a Teutonic deity; cp. OHG. Zio , Icel. Týr ; see Grimm, Teut. M. , cap. ix, and Kluge (s.v. dienstag ).

records.label: Tit
records.text: Tit , adv. quickly, PP; tyt , S2; tyte , PP, S2, H; tite , PP, S2, H; tiȝt , S2; tiȝtly , S2; titere , comp. , H; titter , S2.—Icel. títt , neut. of tiðr . See Tid .

records.label: Tiðende
records.text: Tiðende , sb. pl. tidings, news, customs, S; tiðenden , S; tiðand , S2; tiðandes , S2.—Icel. tíðindi , pl., tidings, news; from tíða , to happen; cp. tíðska , a custom, tíðr , customary, frequent.

records.label: Tiðing
records.text: Tiðing , sb. tidings, news, S, S2; tyðyng , S, S2; tiðinge , pl. , S; tiðinges , S2.—Cf. Tiding .

records.label: Titill
records.text: Titill , sb. an epistle, WA.

records.label: Titmose
records.text: Titmose , sb. titmouse, S3, Manip.; tytemose , Prompt.; tytmase , Voc.—AS. máse , a word forming the second element of the names of many kinds of small birds, see SkD.

records.label: Titte
records.text: Titte , sb. a quick pull, S2.

records.label: Titte
records.text: Titte , v. to pull tightly, HD; tytted , HD.

records.label: Tixt
records.text: Tixt , sb. text, PP; see Texte .

records.label: Tiȝen
records.text: Tiȝen , v. to tie, PP, S2; teiȝen , S2; tey , B; te , B; teien , pr. pl. , SkD; teyd , pp. , C2; y-teyd , C.—AS. tígan (* tégan ).

records.label: Tiȝt
records.text: Tiȝt , adv. quickly, S2; see Tit .

records.label: To
records.text: To , prep. to, at, in, upon, for, with reference to, by, against, after, as, until, PP, S, S2; te , S, S2. Comb. : tabide , to abide, S; tacord , C3; taffraye , C2; tallege , C; talyghte , C2; tamenden , S2, C2; tanoyen , S2; tapese , S3; tariue , S; tarraye , C2; tassaile , C2; tassaye , C2; taswage , S3; tembrace , C2; tencombre , S3; tendure , S3; tenforme , S3; tenrage , S3; tespye , C2; texpounden , C2.

records.label: To
records.text: To , adv. too, S, PP; te , S.

records.label: To
records.text: To , num. two, S, S2; see Tuo .

records.label: To-
records.text: To- , prefix (1). The prep. to in composition.

records.label: To-
records.text: To- , prefix (2), in twain, asunder, to pieces.—AS. tó- ; cp. OHG. zi- (Tatian), Lat. dis- .

records.label: To-belimpen
records.text: To-belimpen , v. to belong to, S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-bellen
records.text: To-bellen , v. to swell extremely; tobolle , pp. , PP. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-beren
records.text: To-beren , v. to part; tobar , pt. s. , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-beten
records.text: To-beten , v. to beat in pieces, C3. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-breden
records.text: To-breden , v. to spread out; tobreddest , 2 pt. s. , S2. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-breiden
records.text: To-breiden , v. to tear asunder, distorquere ; tobreidynge , pr. p. , W; debreidynge , W; tobraidide , pt. s. , W. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-breken
records.text: To-breken , v. to break in pieces, S, C3, W; to-brac , pt. s. , PP; to-brak , G; to-brake , pt. s. subj. , S; to-broken , pp. , PP, G; to-broke , PP, S2, W. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-bresten
records.text: To-bresten , v. to burst asunder, C; to-bersteð , pr. s. , S: to-barst , pt. s. , S2, G; to-brast , W; to-brosten , pp. , C. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-brisen
records.text: To-brisen , v. to break to pieces; tobrisid , pp. , W. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-cleue
records.text: To-cleue , v. to cleave asunder, to fall to pieces, PP; to-cleef , pt. s. , PP; to-clief , PP. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-comen
records.text: To-comen , v. to come together; to-comen , pt. pl. , PP. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-comyng
records.text: To-comyng , adj. future, W2. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-cweme
records.text: To-cweme , adv. agreeably, S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-cyme
records.text: To-cyme , sb. advent, S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: Tod
records.text: Tod , sb. a fox, JD, ND, HD, SkD; toddis , pl. , S3. Comb. : Todman , Bardsley.—The word is common in Mid Yorkshire and Cumberland, see EDS (Ser. C).

records.label: Tod
records.text: Tod , sb. a bush, generally of ivy, HD; todde , SkD.

records.label: To-dasht
records.text: To-dasht , pt. s. dashed (herself) in pieces, S3. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-delen
records.text: To-delen , v. to divide, S, S2; to-dælen , S; to-dealen , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-drawen
records.text: To-drawen , v. to draw asunder, S2, W; to-draȝen , S; to-drowe , pt. pl. , PP; to-droȝe , S; to-drawun , pp. , W; to-drahen , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-dreuen
records.text: To-dreuen , v. to trouble; to-dreued , pp. , S2, ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-driuen
records.text: To-driuen , v. to drive asunder; to-dryue , PP; to-drif , imp. s. , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-dunet
records.text: To-dunet , pp. struck with a sounding blow, S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-fallen
records.text: To-fallen , v. to fall in pieces, SD. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-flight
records.text: To-flight , sb. refuge, S2. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-foren
records.text: To-foren , prep. and adv. before, SD; toforn , PP, S3; tofore , S, PP, S2; touore , S, S2; tofor , S, PP, S2, W. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-forrow
records.text: To-forrow , adv. previously, S3. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: Toft
records.text: Toft , sb. hillock, eminence, a slightly elevated and exposed site, PP, S2; campus , Prompt.—Cp. OSwed. tomt , a cleared space (Dan. tomt , a toft); from Icel. tómr , empty. See Tome .

records.label: To-gadere
records.text: To-gadere , adv. together, S, S2; tegædere S; togedere , S, PP; togedre , PP; togeddre , S; togidere , PP; togider , S, C2; togederes , PP, S; togideres , PP; togidres , PP, C3; togederis , PP; togeders , PP; togedders , S2. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-gan
records.text: To-gan , v. to go asunder, SD; togað , pr. pl. , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-genes
records.text: To-genes , prep. towards, S; togeines , S; toȝeines , S; toȝenes , S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: Toggen
records.text: Toggen , v. to draw, allure, sport, S, Prompt.

records.label: To-grinden
records.text: To-grinden , v. to grind in pieces; togrynt , pr. s. , PP. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-hewen
records.text: To-hewen , v. to hew in pieces, S, S2, C3. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-hope
records.text: To-hope , sb. hope, S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-hurren
records.text: To-hurren , v. to hurry apart, S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: Tokker
records.text: Tokker , sb. fuller, one who thickens cloth, S2, PP; towker , PP; toucher , PP; tucker , HD; touker , Bardsley; tuker , Bardsley. See Tuken .

records.label: Tokne
records.text: Tokne , sb. token, PP; tocne , S; tacne , S; taken , PP, S2; takun , W; takens , pl. , S2.—AS. tácn : Goth. taikns ; cp. OHG. zeichan (Tatian).

records.label: Toknynge
records.text: Toknynge , sb. signification, PP; tocninge , S; toknyng , PP; takning , S2; takeninge , S2; tokening , C3.—AS. tácnung .

records.label: Tolie
records.text: Tolie , v. to till, S; see Tilien .

records.label: To-liggen
records.text: To-liggen , v. to pertain to; tolið , pr. s. , S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: Tolke
records.text: Tolke , sb. a man, S2; see Tulk .

records.label: Tolle
records.text: Tolle , sb. toll, custom, Voc.; tol , PP, Prompt. Comb. : tol-bothe , toll-booth (= Lat. telonium ), S2, W, Voc.—AS. toll : OFris. tolen , tolne ; Lat. telonium (Vulg.); Gr. τελώνιον . Note that the n of the stem appears in AS. tolnere , ‘teloniarius,’ Voc.; see Weigand (s.v. zoll ).

records.label: Tollen
records.text: Tollen , v. to take toll, C. Der. : tollere , taxgatherer, usurer, S2, PP; toller , Voc.

records.label: Tollen
records.text: Tollen , v. to draw, allure, entice, Prompt., PP, ND, SkD; tole , ND; tullen , CM, SD; tillen , S, H, PP.—AS. tyllan (in for-tyllan ).

records.label: To-loggen
records.text: To-loggen , v. to drag hither and thither, S2, PP; to-lugged , pp. , PP.

records.label: Tolter
records.text: Tolter , adv. unsteadily, totteringly, S3, SkD (s.v. totter ).

records.label: To-luken
records.text: To-luken , v. to rend asunder, S; toloken , pp. , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: Toly
records.text: Toly , sb. scarlet colour, WA; tuly , Prompt., HD; tuely , SkD (s.v. trap , 2).—Heb. tōlā’ , crimson (Isaiah 1. 18), properly a worm.

records.label: Tombestere
records.text: Tombestere , sb. female dancer, C3; see Tumbestere .

records.label: Tome
records.text: Tome , adj. empty, void, unoccupied, H, HD; toom , Prompt.; tume , JD.—Icel. tómr , vacant, empty. Cf. Toft .

records.label: Tome
records.text: Tome , sb. leisure, S2, PP, H (p. 169); toym , B; tume , B; Icel. tóm , leisure. See above.

records.label: To-morwen
records.text: To-morwen , adv. to-morrow, S; tomorwe , PP; tomoreȝe , S; tomorn , C. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-name
records.text: To-name , sb. cognomen, PP; towname , PP. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: Tonge
records.text: Tonge , sb. tongue, S2, C2, C3, PP; tunge , S, C, PP, W2; tounge , PP; tong , S3; tung , S2. Der. : tongede , tongued, talkative, PP.—AS. tunge .

records.label: Tonge
records.text: Tonge , sb. pair of tongs, forceps , S, S2, Prompt.; tange , Voc.—AS. tange (Voc.).

records.label: Tonne
records.text: Tonne , sb. tun, PP, S3, C2, G; tunne , S, PP. Comb. : tonne-greet , as large round as a tun, C.—AS. tunne .

records.label: Too
records.text: Too , sb. toe, C; taa , S2, HD; toon , pl. , C; ton , C; tas , S2; taes , S2.—AS. tá (pl. tán ).

records.label: Tool
records.text: Tool , sb. tool, weapon, C, Prompt.; toles , pl. , PP; tooles , PP.—AS. tól .

records.label: Toom
records.text: Toom , adj. empty; see Tome .

records.label: Toord
records.text: Toord , sb. stercus , W2, Prompt.

records.label: Topase
records.text: Topase , sb. topaz, Cotg.; topace , S3; tupace , SkD; topacius , W (Apoc. 21. 20); thopas , C2 (p. 151).—OF. topase ; Lat. topazum (acc.); Gr. τόπαζος .

records.label: Toppe

records.label: Toret
records.text: Toret , sb. turret, G, C, Prompt.; touret , SkD.—OF. tourette (Cotg.).

records.label: To-reuen
records.text: To-reuen , v. to completely take away, PP. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: Torf
records.text: Torf , sb. turf, S2; turf , Voc.; turues , pl. , S2.—AS. turf (Voc.).

records.label: Torfare
records.text: Torfare , sb. hardship, misery, peril, WA.—Icel. torfœra .

records.label: Torment

records.text: Tormentyse , sb. torture, C2.

records.text: Torne , sb. a turn, trick, wile, G.

records.label: Tornen
records.text: Tornen , v. to turn, PP; see Tournen .

records.label: To-rof
records.text: To-rof , pt. s. of To-riven .

records.label: Tortuous
records.text: Tortuous , adj. oblique (term in astrology), C3.—Lat. tortuosus , crooked.

records.label: To-samen
records.text: To-samen , adv. together, S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-schaken
records.text: To-schaken , v. to shake asunder, S. ( To- 2 .)

records.text: To-scheden , v. to part asunder; tosched , pp. , S2. ( To- 2 .)

records.text: To-schellen , v. to shell, peel; toshullen , pp. , PP. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-schreden
records.text: To-schreden , v. to cut to pieces, C. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-spreden
records.text: To-spreden , v. to scatter; to-sprad , pp. , S2. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-swellen
records.text: To-swellen , v. to swell greatly; toswolle , pp. , S, PP. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-swinken
records.text: To-swinken , v. to labour greatly, C3. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-tasen
records.text: To-tasen , v. to pull to pieces; to-tose , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: Toten
records.text: Toten , v. to peep, look about, PP, S3; tutand , pr. p. , projecting, pushing out, S3; totede , pt. s. , S3; y-toted , pp. , S3. Comb. : tote-hylle , specula , Prompt.—AS. tótian ; see SkD (s.v. tout ).

records.label: To-teren
records.text: To-teren , v. to tear to pieces, C3; toteoren , S; toteore , S; totorne , pp. , PP; totorn , S; totore , C3. ( To- 2 .)

records.text: To-turn , sb. refuge, SD. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-twicchen
records.text: To-twicchen , v. to pull apart; totwichet , pr. pl. , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.text: Toun , sb. an enclosure, farm-stead, town, S2, C, W; toune , PP; tun , S, S2; toune , dat. , S2, C2. Comb. : toune-men , men of the town, not rustics, PP; tun-scipe , the people of the farm-stead, S. Der. : townish , belonging to the town, S3.—AS. tún , enclosure, farm, town; cp. OHG. zún , hedge (Tatian).

records.label: Tour
records.text: Tour , sb. tower, S, S2, C2, PP, W2; tur , S; torres , pl. , S2.—OF. tur , tor , tour : Lat. turrem .

records.label: Tournen
records.text: Tournen , v. to turn, PP; turnen , S, S2, PP; tornen , S2, PP; teornen , S2; tirnen , S; y-tornd , pp. , S2; i-turnd , S, S2.—AF. turner ; Lat. tornare , from tornus , a lathe.

records.label: Tourneyment
records.text: Tourneyment , sb. tournament, C2.—OF. tornoiement .

records.label: Towaille
records.text: Towaille , sb. towel, C2; towayle , Prompt., Voc.; twaly , Prompt.; towelle , Voc.; towylle , Voc.—AF. towaille ( tuaille ), OF. touaile (Bartsch); Low Lat. toacula ; of Teutonic origin, cp. OHG. duáhila , washing-cloth; from duahan , also thuahan , to wash (Tatian). See SkD, also Kluge (s.v. zwehle ).

records.label: To-walten
records.text: To-walten , v. to roll with violence; pt. pl. , overflowed, S2. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: To-ward
records.text: To-ward , prep. towards, against, S, PP; touward , S; towart , S. ( To- 1 .)

records.label: To-warde
records.text: To-warde , adj. present, as a guard or protection, PP. ( To- 1 .)

records.text: Towker , sb. a fuller; see Tokker .

records.text: To-wringen , v. to distort; towrong , pt. s. , S. ( To- 2 .)

records.text: To-wrye , v. to cause to go on one side, S3 (4. 164) ( To- 2 .)

records.label: Toȝeines
records.text: Toȝeines , prep. towards, S; see To-genes .

records.label: To-ȝere

records.label: To-ȝesceoden
records.text: To-ȝesceoden , v. to separate, S. ( To- 2 .)

records.label: Trace
records.text: Trace , sb. track of a way over a field, trace , Prompt., C, SkD; tras , PP; trass , S2.

records.label: Tracen
records.text: Tracen , v. to trace, to draw a picture, to trace one’s way, to conduct oneself, Prompt., CM, S3; trasen , S3.—OF. tracer ( trasser ); Late Lat. * tractiare , from Lat. tract- , base of pp. of trahere ; see BH, § 131.

records.label: Trade
records.text: Trade , sb. a trodden path, S3, TG, SkD, HD. See Treden .

records.label: Tradicion
records.text: Tradicion , sb. surrender, S3.—Lat. traditionem . Cf. Tresoun .

records.label: Traitorye
records.text: Traitorye , sb. treachery, C3, CM.

records.label: Traitour
records.text: Traitour , sb. traitor, S; traytour , S; treitur , S.—AF. traitur ; Lat. traditorem .

records.label: Tram
records.text: Tram , sb. engine, machine, WA; trammys , pl. , B.

records.label: Trappe
records.text: Trappe , sb. the trappings of a horse, SkD; trappys , pl. , SkD.

records.label: Trapped
records.text: Trapped , adj. adorned with trappings, C, Prompt.

records.label: Trappings
records.text: Trappings , sb. pl. ornaments, Sh.

records.label: Trappure
records.text: Trappure , sb. trappings of a horse, Prompt.; trappures , pl. , C.

records.label: Trauail
records.text: Trauail , sb. work, labour, toil, trouble, S2, PP; trauaille , C2; trawayle , S2; trauell , S2; trauel , W, W2, H (Ps. 108. 10).—AF. travail , travaille ; Late Lat. * trabaculum ; from Lat. trabem , a beam; cp. It. traváglio , a frame for confining unruly horses. See Trave .

records.label: Trauaille
records.text: Trauaille , v. to work, toil, travel, trouble, vex, torment, PP; traueilen , W, S2; trauele , W, W2.—AF. travai ( l ) ler , to work, to vex. See above.

records.label: Trauailous
records.text: Trauailous , adj. laborious, W2.

records.label: Trave
records.text: Trave , sb. a frame in which farriers confine unruly horses, CM. See Trauail .

records.label: Trawed
records.text: Trawed , pt. pl. trowed, expected, S2; see Trowen .

records.label: Tray
records.text: Tray , sb. vexation; see Treȝe .

records.label: Trays
records.text: Trays , sb. pl. traces, horse-harness, C; trayce , Prompt.; trayse , Cath.—OF. trays , horse-harness (Palsg.) for traits , pl., of traict a trace for horses (Cotg.); Lat. tractum , pp. of trahere .

records.label: Trayste
records.text: Trayste , v. to trust, S2; traste , PP, S2.—Icel. treysta , from traust . See Trist .

records.label: Traystnes

records.label: Traystynge
records.text: Traystynge , sb. confidence, H.

records.text: Traytyse , sb. treaty, truce, S3; see Tretis .

records.text: Tre , sb. tree, wood, lignum. Prompt., S2, PP, W, W2; treo , S, PP; treowe , dat. , S; treuwe , pl. , S; tren , S2; treen , S3; treon , S; trewes , S; trowes , PP. Comb. : tre tymus ( lignum thyinum ), W.—AS. tréow ( tréo ), dat. tréowe , pl. tréowu ( tréo ), see Sievers, 250; cp. Goth. triu .

records.label: Treatise
records.text: Treatise , sb. a passage (lit. a treatise), S3; see Tretis .

records.label: Treatyce
records.text: Treatyce , sb. treaty, truce, S3; see Tretis .

records.label: Trechery
records.text: Trechery , sb. treachery, trickery, S; see Tricherie .

records.label: Trechoure
records.text: Trechoure , sb. a cheat, HD.—OF. trichëor (Bartsch); Late Lat. tricatorem .

records.label: Trechurly
records.text: Trechurly , adv. treacherously, S3.

records.label: Tred
records.text: Tred , sb. a foot-mark. SkD (s.v. trade ).

records.text: Treden , v. to tread, C, Prompt., PP; pt. pl. , W, PP; tret , pr. s. CM; troden , PP; trade , H (Ps. 55. 2); troden , pp. , C3; trodun , W2; treddede , pt. s. ( weak ), S3.—AS. tredan , pt. træd (pl. trǽdon ), pp. treden .

records.label: Treget
records.text: Treget , sb. guile, trickery, CM.

records.label: Tregetrie

records.text: Tregettowre , sb. a juggler, joculator , Prompt.; tregetour , Prompt. ( n ), CM, HD.

records.label: Tregettyn
records.text: Tregettyn , v. to juggle, Prompt.—OF. tresgeter (Ducange); Lat. trans + iactare .

records.label: Treien
records.text: Treien , v. to betray, P; trayet , pp. , HD.—OF. traïr ; Late Lat. * tradīre for Lat. tradere .

records.label: Treilȝis
records.text: Treilȝis , sb. trellis, S3; trelys , cancellus , Prompt.—OF. treillis , from treille , a vine, arbour (Bartsch); Late Lat. * tricla ; Lat. trichila ; see BH, § 98.

records.text: Tremlen , v. to tremble, stagger, PP; tremelyn , Prompt.; trimlen , HD; trymlen , S3; tremblen , W, PP; trimble , Manip.—Picard F. tremler (AF. trembler ); Late Lat. tremulare .

records.label: Tremlynge
records.text: Tremlynge , sb. trembling; tremelynge , Prompt.; trimlyng , S3; trymlinge , HD.

records.label: Trental
records.text: Trental , sb. a set of thirty masses for the dead, SkD, ND, PP; trentall , money paid for a trental, S3; a month’s mind, ND.—OF. trental , trentel ; Church Lat. trigintalem (Ducange).

records.label: Treo
records.text: Treo , sb. tree, S; treon , pl. , S; see Tre .

records.label: Treowe
records.text: Treowe , adj. true, S; see Trewe .

records.text: Trepeget , sb. a military engine, HD, CM; trebget , Prompt.; trebgot , an instrument for catching birds, Prompt.

records.label: Tresor
records.text: Tresor , sb. treasure, S, S2, C3; tresour , PP, S2, S3, C2; treosor , S; tresores , pl. , PP; tresures , S.—AF. tresor ; Lat. thesaurum .

records.label: Tresorere
records.text: Tresorere , sb. treasurer, PP; treserour , PP.—AF. tresorer .

records.label: Tresorie
records.text: Tresorie , sb. treasury, S2; tresory , WA.—AF. tresorye .

records.label: Tresoun
records.text: Tresoun , sb. treason, craft, C, PP; tresun , Prompt., S; treson , WA, C2, H; treison , PP; trayson , S.—AF. treson , traïson ; Lat. traditionem .

records.label: Trespas
records.text: Trespas , sb. trespass, PP; trespace , PP, C.

records.label: Trespassen
records.text: Trespassen , v. to trespass, PP, WW; trespace , C2; trespasside , pt. s. , W (Acts 1. 25).—AF. trespasser , to cross over, to disobey.

records.label: Tretee
records.text: Tretee , sb. treaty, C2, C3; trete , C.—OF. traite ; Late Lat. tracta . See Tretis .

records.label: Tretis
records.text: Tretis , adj. well made, pretty; tretys , CM, C; treitys , CM.—OF. tretis , treitis , traitis , nicely made (Bartsch); from traitier ; Lat. tractare .

records.label: Tretis
records.text: Tretis , sb. treatise, short poem, PP, C2, WA; treatise , S3. See below.

records.label: Tretis
records.text: Tretis , sb. treaty, B, CM; tretys , S2, C2, C3; treatyce , S3; traytyse , S3.—AF. tretiz ; Late Lat. * tracticium .

records.label: Trewage
records.text: Trewage , sb. tribute, S, JD; truage , Voc., S2, WA; trouage , WA.—OF. treüage ( truage ), toll, tax, from treü , treüd , tribute; Lat. tribūtum ; see Constans (s.v.).

records.label: Trewe
records.text: Trewe , adj. true, S, PP, S2, C2; treowe , S; trywe , PP; triwe , S2; trew , S2, C2; tru , S2.—AS. tréowe : OS. triuwi .

records.label: Trewe
records.text: Trewe , sb. fidelity, trust, agreement, truce, PP; treowe , SkD; treowes , pl. , truce, SkD; trewes , PP; trewis , B; treuwes , PP; triwes , SkD; truwys , Prompt.; trewysse , Cath.

records.label: Trewehede
records.text: Trewehede , sb. truth, uprightness, S2.

records.label: Treweliche
records.text: Treweliche , adv. truly, PP, C2; trewely , C2.

records.label: Trewen
records.text: Trewen , v. to think to be true, to trow, believe, S.—AS. tréowan . See Trowen .

records.label: Trewes
records.text: Trewes , pl. trees, S; see Tre .

records.label: Trewes
records.text: Trewes , sb. pl. truce; see Trewe .

records.label: Trewðe
records.text: Trewðe , sb. truth, troth, S, C2, PP; treuðe , S, S2, PP; trouthe , S2, C3; trouth , H; tryuðe , PP; trowwðe , S; trawðe , S2; treothes , pl. , S; truthes , pledges, S2.—AS. tréowðu .

records.label: Trey
records.text: Trey , sb. a throw at dice, viz. three, SkD; treye , C3. Comb. : trey-ace , the throw of three and one; a quick exclamation, S3.—OF. trei , treis ; Lat. trēs .

records.label: Treȝe
records.text: Treȝe , sb. affliction, grief, SD; treiȝe , S; treie , S; treye , S2; tray , vexation, B.—AS. trega ; cp. Icel. tregi , Goth. trigo .

records.label: Treȝen
records.text: Treȝen , v. to afflict, SD.

records.label: Triacle
records.text: Triacle , sb. a remedy, healing medicine, S2, PP, C3, NQ (6. 1. 308); tryacle , Voc., PP, NQ; treacle , TG, Prompt.; tryakill , S3.—OF. trïacle (Bartsch); Lat. theriaca , lit. an antidote against the bite of serpents; cp. Gr. θηριακὰ φάρμακα . For examples of the intrusive l see Cronicle .

records.label: Triblen
records.text: Triblen , v. to trouble, H; see Trublen .

records.label: Tricherie
records.text: Tricherie , sb. treachery, trickery, S, PP, S2; trecherie , PP; trechery , S; treccherie , C.—AF. tricherie ; from OF. tricher , trecher , to cheat; Late Lat. tricare for Lat. tricari .

records.label: Trick
records.text: Trick , adj. neat, elegant, ND; trig , JD.—For the voicing of the guttural in North.E. cp. prigmedainty (JD), with prickmedainty or prickmedenty (HD); see SkD (s.vv. prig , trigger ).

records.label: Trien
records.text: Trien , v. to try, PP; triȝede , pp. , S2, PP; i-triȝed , S2; itriȝet , S2; y-tried , PP; y-tryed , PP; tried , pp. as adj. , choice, PP; trye , PP, C2; triedest , superl. , S2, PP; trieste , PP; tryest , PP; triedliche , adv. , excellently, PP; triȝely , PP, S2; trielich , P.—AF. trier ; Late Lat. tritare , to thresh corn.

records.label: Triennels
records.text: Triennels , sb. pl. masses said for three years, PP; triennales , P.—OF. triennal ; Church Lat. triennale .

records.label: Trillen
records.text: Trillen , v. to turn round and round, to trickle, CM, Prompt., C2, S3, Sh., SkD; tryll , Palsg.; tril , Manip.—Cp. Swed. trilla , to roll.

records.label: Trinal
records.text: Trinal , adj. threefold, RD; trinall , Spenser, 1. Comb. : trinal triplicities , SkD.—Late Lat. trinalis .

records.label: Trine
records.text: Trine , adj. taken three at a time, ND. Comb. : trine aspect (in astrology), SkD, ND; tryne compas , the round world containing earth, sea, and heaven, C3—OF. trine ; Lat. trinum .

records.label: Trinite
records.text: Trinite , sb. Trinity, S2, PP; Trinitee , PP.—AF. Trinite , Trinitet ; Church Lat. Trinitatem .

records.label: Trisen
records.text: Trisen , v. to hoist up, to trice, to pull off, SkD; tryce , C2; trice , CM. Der. : tryyste , tryys , windlass, Prompt.—Cp. Dan. tridse , to haul up, to trice , Swed. trissa , a pulley. The final -se is the same as in E. clean-se .

records.label: Trist
records.text: Trist , sb. trust, a tryst, meeting-place, B, W, W2, PP, S2; station in hunting, HD; trust , PP.—Icel. traust . For E. ī = Icel. au , cp. ME. mire = Icel. maurr ; see SkD (s.v. pismire ).

records.label: Tristen
records.text: Tristen , v. to trust, S2, C3, W, W2, PP; trysten , S2, PP; truste , S2; trosten , S3, S2, PP; truste , pt. s. , S, S2. Der. : tristyng , a trust, W. See above.

records.label: Tristili
records.text: Tristili , adv. confidently, W, W2.

records.label: Tristnen
records.text: Tristnen , v. to trust, W. Der. : tristenyng , a trust, W.

records.label: Triuials
records.text: Triuials , sb. pl. studies connected with the trivium , the initiatory course taught in the schools, comprising grammar, rhetoric, and dialectic, S3; trivial , adj. , initiatory, ND.—Schol. Lat. trivialem .

records.label: Troblen
records.text: Troblen , v. to trouble, W; troubild , pp. , WA; see Trublen .

records.label: Trod
records.text: Trod , sb. a trodden path, SkD (s.v. trade ), HD. See Treden .

records.label: Troden
records.text: Troden , pp. of Treden .

records.label: Trofle
records.text: Trofle , sb. a trifle, S3; see Trufle .

records.label: Trompe
records.text: Trompe , sb. a trump, trumpet, C3; trumpe , C.—AF. trompe .

records.label: Trompe
records.text: Trompe , v. to play the trumpet, PP; trumpe , W, Prompt.—AF. trumper .

records.label: Tronchoun
records.text: Tronchoun , sb. a truncheon, broken piece of a spear-shaft. C; trunchone , Prompt.—OF. tronchon , tronçon .

records.label: Trone
records.text: Trone , sb. throne, S, PP, S3, C2, C3, W; trones , pl. , S; one of the nine orders of angels, WA; tronen , S2.—OF. trone ; Lat. thronum ; from Gr. θρόνος .

records.label: Tronen
records.text: Tronen , v. to enthrone, PP.—OF. troner .

records.label: Trost
records.text: Trost , subj. pr. s. trust, S2; see Tristen .

records.label: Trotevale
records.text: Trotevale , sb. a trifling thing, HD.

records.label: Trouble
records.text: Trouble , adj. troubled, S2, C2.—AF. truble , pp. of trubler ; see Trublen .

records.label: Trouthe
records.text: Trouthe , sb. truth, S.2, C3; see Trewthe .

records.label: Trowabile
records.text: Trowabile , adj. credible, H.

records.label: Trowen
records.text: Trowen , v. to believe, S, S2, S3, C2, C3, H, PP; tru , S2; trawed , pt. pl. , expected, S2.—Icel. trúa ; Swed. tro . See Trewen .

records.label: Trowyng
records.text: Trowyng , sb. belief, S2.

records.label: Truage
records.text: Truage , sb. tribute, S2; see Trewage .

records.label: Trublen
records.text: Trublen , v. to trouble, W; troblen , W; triblen , H.—AF. trubler ; Late Lat. turbulare .

records.label: Trufle
records.text: Trufle , sb. nonsense, absurd tale, trifle, PP, SkD; trofle , S3, SkD; trefele , PP; triful , PP; trifle , PP.—AF. trufle , trofle , mockery, OF. truffe , a jest, a flout, also a truffle (Cotg.); Lat. tubera , truffles; see SkD (s.v. truffle ). For the intrusive l cf. Triacle .

records.label: Truflen
records.text: Truflen , v. to beguile, SkD; trofle , SkD; trifelyn , Prompt.; treoflynge , pr. p. , S2.—OF. truffler , truffer , to mock (Cotg.).

records.label: Trukenen
records.text: Trukenen , v. to fail, S.

records.label: Trukien
records.text: Trukien , v. to fail, S.—AS. trucian , to fail, deceive.

records.label: Trusse
records.text: Trusse , sb. a bundle, Manip., CM.

records.label: Trussen
records.text: Trussen , v. to pack, to pack off, C, S2, PP, Manip. ; turss , B.—OF. trusser , trosser , torser ; Late Lat. * tortiare .

records.label: Truste
records.text: Truste , pt. s. trusted, S; see Tristen .

records.label: Tryce

records.text: Uthe , sb. wave, S; yþez , pl. , S2, HD.—AS. ýð : Lat. unda .

records.label: Ut-laȝe
records.text: Ut-laȝe , sb. outlaw, S.—Icel. útlaga , outlawed, útlagi , an outlaw. See Out-lawe .

records.label: Uttring
records.text: Uttring , sb. circulating, S3. See Outren .

records.label: Uȝten
records.text: Uȝten , sb. early morning, S; see Uhte .

records.label: Vacherye
records.text: Vacherye , sb. a dairy, Prompt.—OF. vacherie , a cow-house (Cotg.); Late Lat. vaccaria , from Lat. uacca , a cow.

records.label: Vader
records.text: Vader , sb. father, S, S2; see Fader .

records.label: Uæin
records.text: Uæin , adj. fain, S; see Fayn .

records.label: Uair
records.text: Uair , adj. fair, S2; see Fayr .

records.label: Uale
records.text: Uale , adj. many, S; see Fele .

records.label: Vale
records.text: Vale , sb. vale, PP.—AF. val ; Lat. vallem .

records.label: Valè
records.text: Valè , sb. valley, S2, B; valeie , S2; valeye , PP; valayis , pl. , B.—OF. valee ; cp. It. vallata .

records.label: Vale
records.text: Vale , v. to descend, S3.—Cp. OF. avaler , to descend. Cf. Aualen .

records.label: Valuwen
records.text: Valuwen , v. to become yellow, S; see Falwe .

records.label: Vane
records.text: Vane , sb. a vane, C2; see Fane .

records.label: Vanishen
records.text: Vanishen , v. to vanish, C2; vanshe , Voc.; vanshede , pt. s. , PP; vanyschiden , pl. , became vain, W; vanyssht , pp. , S2.—Cp. OF. esvanuïss- , base of pr. p. of esvanuïr ; Lat. ex + uanescere , from uanus .

records.label: Vant
records.text: Vant , v. to vaunt, WA.—OF. vanter ; Late Lat. vanitare , from Lat. uanus .

records.label: Vantwarde
records.text: Vantwarde , sb. vanguard, S2; see Vauntwarde .

records.label: Uaren
records.text: Uaren , v. to fare, S; see Faren .

records.label: Variaunt
records.text: Variaunt , adj. changing, fickle, C2.

records.label: Varien
records.text: Varien , v. to vary, Prompt.; wariande , pr. p. , S2; variand , S2, S3; variant , S3.—AF. varier ; Lat. uariare .

records.label: Varlet
records.text: Varlet , sb. a young vassal, servant, squire, SkD, Sh.; verna , Manip.; verlet , S3.—OF. varlet , vaslet , dimin. of vassal . See below.

records.label: Vassal
records.text: Vassal , sb. a servant, subject.—AF. vassal ; Low Lat. vassallum (acc.), from vassus , a man, a subject (of Celtic origin); cp. Wel. gwas , a youth, servant.

records.label: Vassalage
records.text: Vassalage , sb. good service, prowess in arms, courage, B; vasselage , C, CM.—AF. vasselage (Roland).

records.label: Vath
records.text: Vath , sb. danger, B.—Icel. váði .

records.label: Vath
records.text: Vath , interj. fie! (= vah ), W.

records.label: Uaumpe
records.text: Uaumpe , sb. the fore part of the foot, the vamp, Prompt., S; vampies , ND; wampe , pedana , pedium , ante pedale , Voc.; wampay , pedana , Voc.; vauntpe , Palsg.; vampett , Cath.—OF. uantpie (Palsg.), avant-pied , the fore part of the foot (Cotg.).

records.label: Vaunte
records.text: Vaunte , sb. a boast, WA. See Vant .

records.label: Vaunten
records.text: Vaunten , v. to vault, S3; vant , S3 (s.v. vaut ). Probably for vauut , vaut .

records.label: Vauntwarde
records.text: Vauntwarde , sb. vanguard, PP; vantwarde , S2; vaward , B, WA.—AF. avaunt-garde , OF. avantwarde , avantgarde .

records.label: Vauntynge
records.text: Vauntynge , sb. vaulting, S3.

records.label: Vavasour
records.text: Vavasour , sb. a sub-vassal, C, HD.—AF. vavasour ; OF. vavassor , a gen. pl. form, see Bartsch, p. 500; Low Lat. vassus vassorum , vassal of vassals (Diez, p. 338).

records.label: Vaylen
records.text: Vaylen , v. to avail; vaille , PP; vayleth , pr. s. , S3; vayls , H. See Auailen .

records.label: Vayn
records.text: Vayn , sb. vein, S3; see Veyne .

records.label: Ueale
records.text: Ueale , adj. many, S; see Uele .

records.label: Ueat
records.text: Ueat , sb. vessel, S; see Fat .

records.label: Veaw
records.text: Veaw , adj. few, S2; see Fewe .

records.label: Veder
records.text: Veder , sb. father, S; see Fader .

records.label: Veel
records.text: Veel , sb. veal, SkD; veale , calf, Manip.; veal , Manip.; veilys , pl. , calves, S3.—OF. veël (Ps. 28. 6): Prov. vedel ; Lat. uitellum (acc.).

records.label: Veer-tyme
records.text: Veer-tyme , sb. spring-time, W2. See Ver .

records.label: Veille
records.text: Veille , sb. watcher, P; veil , PP.—OF. veile ; Lat. uigilia , a vigil, a watch.

records.label: Ueir
records.text: Ueir , adj. fair, MD; see Fayre .

records.label: Ueir
records.text: Ueir , sb. beauty, S. See above.

records.label: Vekke
records.text: Vekke , sb. an old woman, CM.

records.label: Uelaȝ-rede
records.text: Uelaȝ-rede , sb. fellowship, S2; see Felawrede .

records.label: Uele
records.text: Uele , adj. many, S, S2; ueole , S; ueale , S; see Fele .

records.label: Uelen
records.text: Uelen , v. to feel, MD; see Felen .

records.label: Veluet
records.text: Veluet , sb. velvet, sericum villosum , Manip., Prompt.; velwet , Prompt.; velouette , C2; vellet , HD.—It. veluto (Florio); Late Lat. * villutum ; from Lat. uillus , shaggy hair; cf. OF. velu , shaggy (Cotg.).

records.label: Vendage
records.text: Vendage , sb. vintage, PP.—OF. vendange ; Lat. uindēmia ; see BH, § 167.

records.label: Venerie
records.text: Venerie , sb. hunting, C; venery , game, DG.—OF. venerie (Cotg.), from vener , to hunt; Lat. uenari .

records.label: Venesoun
records.text: Venesoun , sb. venison, P, Voc.; venysoun , PP.—AF. venesoun , venysoun , OF. venison ; Lat. uenationem , hunting, see Apfelstedt (Introd. xxx), BH, § 28.

records.label: Venge
records.text: Venge , v. to avenge, PP, ND, W; wenge , S2; vengide , pt. s. , W.—OF. venger , vengier ; Lat. uindicare .

records.label: Vengeable
records.text: Vengeable , adj. full of vengeance, S3, ND.

records.label: Vengeaunce
records.text: Vengeaunce , sb. vengeance, PP; vengance , WA; veniaunce , PP, W, W2; vengeans , B; veniauncis , pl. , W.—OF. venjance (BH).

records.label: Uenie
records.text: Uenie , sb. supplication for pardon on one’s knees, S.—Church Lat. venia (Ducange).

records.label: Venkisen
records.text: Venkisen , v. to vanquish, PP; vencuss , B; venkquyst , pt. s. , S2; venquysshed , pp. , S2, C3; venkised , PP; vencust , B.—AF. venquiss- , base of pr. p. of venquir , an inchoative form of OF. veincre ; Lat. uincere .

records.label: Uenne
records.text: Uenne , sb. dat. mud, S; see Fen .

records.label: Ventose
records.text: Ventose , sb. cupping-glass.—OF. ventose ( ventouse ), cupping-glass (Cotg.); Late Lat. uentosa .

records.label: Ventouse
records.text: Ventouse , v. to cup, HD.—OF. ventouser (BH).

records.label: Ventusynge
records.text: Ventusynge , sb. cupping, C.

records.label: Venust
records.text: Venust , adj. beautiful, S3.—Lat. uenustus .

records.label: Venym
records.text: Venym , sb. poison, PP, C; venim , C2, C3, PP, Manip.—OF. venin (Ps. 139, 3). Lat. uenēnum ; see BH, § 44.

records.label: Venym-makere
records.text: Venym-makere , sb. poisoner, W2, H.

records.label: Venymous
records.text: Venymous , adj. venomous, CM.—AF. venymouse , OF. venemouse .

records.label: Venymous-heede
records.text: Venymous-heede , sb. venom, PP.

records.label: Ueole
records.text: Ueole , adj. many, S; see Uele .

records.label: Ueond
records.text: Ueond , sb. enemy, S; see Feend .

records.label: Ueor
records.text: Ueor , adv. far, S; see Fer .

records.label: Ver
records.text: Ver , sb. spring, JD, H (Ps. 73. 18). Comb. : veer-tyme , spring-time, W2.—Lat. uer .

records.label: Ver
records.text: Ver , sb. glass, W2; verre , HD.—OF. verre ( voirre ); Lat. uitrum .

records.label: Uerd
records.text: Uerd , sb. army, MD; uerden , pl. dat. , S; see Ferd .

records.label: Uerden
records.text: Uerden , pt. pl. fared, S; see Faren .

records.label: Verdegrese
records.text: Verdegrese , sb. verdigris, PP; verdegrece , viride grecum , Voc.; verdegrees , C3.—OF. vert de gris , verdigrease (Cotg.); OF. Gris , Greeks (Ducange), pl. of gri ; Late Lat. grĕcum ; Lat. graecum ; see Constans, Notes, p. 25, and BH, § 32.

records.label: Verdite
records.text: Verdite , sb. verdict, C; verdyte , Palsg.—AF. veirdit ; Lat. uere dictum .

records.label: Uere
records.text: Uere , sb. companion, S; see Fere .

records.label: Vergere
records.text: Vergere , sb. an orchard, CM.—OF. vergier (BH); Late Lat. viridiarium ; see BH, § 134.

records.label: Verlet
records.text: Verlet , sb. a young servant, S3; see Varlet .

records.label: Vermel
records.text: Vermel , adj. vermilion-coloured, S3; vermayle , CM.—OF. vermeil ; Lat. uermiculus , scarlet (Vulg.).

records.label: Vermiloun
records.text: Vermiloun , sb. vermilion; vermyloun , Voc. ; vermylion , WA; vermeon , WA.—AF. vermiloun .

records.label: Vernage
records.text: Vernage , sb. an Italian white wine, Prompt., CM, HD.—AF. vernage ; It. vernaccia , ‘a kind of winter wine in Italy very strong like Malmezy,’ so Florio, cp. Dante, Purg. 24, 24; from It. vernaccio , a severe winter, from verno , winter; Lat. hibernum , belonging to winter. Cp. Low Lat. vernachia (Ducange).

records.label: Vernicle
records.text: Vernicle , sb. a copy of the handkerchief of St. Veronica, S2, PP, C; vernakylle , Cath.; vernacle , HD.—Church Lat. veronicula , also veronica from Veronica , the traditional name of the woman who wiped the Saviour’s face (the word being popularly connected with uera icon , true likeness); Veronica is a form of Bernice, the traditional name of the woman who was cured of an issue of blood. Bernice or Berenice is a Macedonian form of Φερενίκη , bearer of victory. See F. veronique in Cotg.

records.label: Vernisch
records.text: Vernisch , sb. varnish, S2, PP; vernysche , Prompt.; vernysh , bernix , Voc.; viridium , virificum , Voc.; vernish , encaustum , Manip.—OF. vernis , varnish, Cotg.; from OF. vernir ; Late Lat. * vitrinire , from uitrinus , from uitrum , glass (Diez, p. 339).

records.label: Vernish
records.text: Vernish , v. encaustare , Manip.—OF. vernisser , to varnish, to sleek, or glaze over with varnish (Cotg.).

records.label: Verony
records.text: Verony , sb. a vernacle, HD.—OF. veronie ; Low Lat. veronica (Ducange). See Vernicle .

records.label: Verraily
records.text: Verraily , adv. verily, C2, C; verralyest , superl. , H.

records.label: Verray
records.text: Verray , adj. true, S, S2, C2, C3, B; verrey , G, HD; very , W. Phr. : verray force , main force, C2.—AF. verrai , verai ; Late Lat. * verăcum (whence F. vrai ), from Lat. uerus .

records.label: Verrayment
records.text: Verrayment , adv. verily, C2; verament , S3, HD.

records.label: Vers
records.text: Vers , sb. verse, PP.—AF. vers ; Lat. uersus .

records.label: Versifie
records.text: Versifie , v. to compose verses, PP.

records.label: Versifyour
records.text: Versifyour , sb. versifier; vercefyour , S2.

records.label: Vertu
records.text: Vertu , sb. power, healing power, miracle, virtue, kindness, S2, PP, W, C2; vertues , pl. , S2. Phr. : the Lord of vertues , the Lord of hosts, W2, H.—OF. vertu , virtud ; Lat. uirtutem .

records.label: Verveine
records.text: Verveine , sb. vervain, SkD; verueyne , S2; verveyn , Voc.—OF. verveine ; Lat. uerbēna ; see BH, § 44.

records.label: Very
records.text: Very , adj. true, W; see Verray .

records.label: Vese
records.text: Vese , v. to drive away, HD; see Fesien .

records.label: Vese
records.text: Vese , sb. a rush of wind, C.—Cp. Icel. fýsi , impulse. See above.

records.label: Vestiment
records.text: Vestiment , sb. vestment, C2; uestimenz , pl. , S, C.—OF. vestiment (Bartsch); Lat. uestimentum .

records.label: Vewe
records.text: Vewe , adj. few, S2; see Fewe .

records.label: Veyne
records.text: Veyne , sb. vein, C; veine , SkD; vaine , S3; vayn , S3; vanys , pl. , S2; waynys , S3.—AF. veine ; Lat. uēna ; see BH, § 44.

records.label: Viage
records.text: Viage , sb. voyage, journey, S2, S3, C, C3, CM, B; vyage , S2.—OF. viage , (BH); Lat. uiaticum , provisions for a journey, from uia .

records.label: Vicarie
records.text: Vicarie , sb. vicar, PP; vicary , C2; vicorie , PP; vikery , PP; vickery , PP; vecory , Voc.—AF. vicaire (F. viquier ); Lat. uicarium , a substitute.

records.label: Vilanye
records.text: Vilanye , sb. villainy, C2, C3, PP; villanie , violentia , Manip.; vilonye , disgrace, G.—AF. vilanie , OF. vilenie ( vilonie ), from vilain , peasant, farm-servant, also bad, villainous (BH); Late Lat. villanus , farm-servant, from Lat. uilla , farm-stead, country-house.

records.label: Vile
records.text: Vile , adj. vile; vyle , PP; vil , PP.—AF. vil ; Lat. uilem .

records.label: Villiche
records.text: Villiche , adv. vilely, S2.

records.label: Vilte
records.text: Vilte , sb. vileness, H (Ps. 49. 22); vylte , HD; vilete , HD.—OF. vilté ; Lat. uilitatem .

records.label: Viole
records.text: Viole , v. to violate; violid , pp. , S3.—OF. violer ; Lat. uiolare .

records.label: Viole
records.text: Viole , sb. vial; violis , pl. , W (Rev. 5. 8); violes , C3.—OF. viole ; AF. fyole ; Lat. phiala ; Gr. φιάλη .

records.label: Virelay
records.text: Virelay , sb. a sort of rondeau, ND; virelayes , pi. , S3, CM; virolais , HD.—OF. virelay (Cotg.); OF. virer + lai ; OF. virer ; Late Lat. virare ; Lat. uibrare (Diez, p. 736). Cf. Vyre .

records.label: Visage
records.text: Visage , sb. face, PP, C2; vysege , S2.—AF. visage ; Late Lat. * visaticum , from Lat. uisum , acc. of uisus , sight.

records.label: Vitaille
records.text: Vitaille , sb. food, S2, C2, C3; vitaile , PP, WW; vitayle , S3; victual , WW; vitalis , pl. , B.—AF. vitaille ; Lat. uictuālia , provisions; see BH, § 6.

records.label: Vitailled
records.text: Vitailled , pp. provisioned, C3; vitailid , W.

records.label: Vitailler
records.text: Vitailler , sb. victualler, PP; vittelleris , pi. , foragers, B.

records.label: Vitremyte
records.text: Vitremyte , sb. woman’s cap, C2.—Lat. uitream mitram , glass head-dress (?). Cp. Sp. mitra , a sort of cap made of pasteboard, which was put on the heads of witches when led to punishment (Stevens). For the loss of r in -myte cp. F. marte for martre , a marten, also OF. feneste for fenestre , and terreste for terrestre ; see Apfelstedt (p. xxxviii).

records.label: Voide
records.text: Voide , adj. void, empty, W2.—AF. voide (F. vide ), OF. vuide , fem. of vuit ; Late Lat. * vocitum , from stem voc- ; [cp. Lat. uacare ; see BH, § 63, and Constans (s.v. vuit ).—A. L. M.]

records.label: Voiden
records.text: Voiden , v. to empty; voyden , to get rid of, C2; to expel, C; voidis , pr. s. , S3; voyde , imp. pl. , make room, S3; depart from, C2; voydeth , send away, C3; voyded , pt. s. , S2; voidid , pp. , made void, W.—AF. voider , to leave, OF. vuidier (Bartsch). See above.

records.label: Vokyte
records.text: Vokyte , sb. an advocate, Voc.; vocates , pl. , PP.—Lat. aduocatus .

records.label: Volage
records.text: Volage , adj. light of conduct, giddy, CM.—OF. volage , light (BH); Lat. uolaticum .

records.label: Volageouss
records.text: Volageouss , adj. light of conduct, B. See above.

records.label: Volatilis
records.text: Volatilis , sb. pl. birds (a misrendering of Lat. altilia ). W; so in the AS. version altilia is rendered by ‘fugelas’; birds (= Lat. uolatilia ), W2; volatils , HD.—Lat. uolatilia , poultry (hence F. volaille ), pl. of uolatilis (Voc.); from uolare , to fly.

records.label: Voluntè
records.text: Voluntè , sb. will, CM.—OF. volonta , voluntet ; Lat. uoluntatem .

records.label: Voluper
records.text: Voluper , sb. a woman’s cap, CM; volyper , Cath.—Cp. OF. envoluper , to wrap round (BH).

records.label: Vouches
records.text: Vouches , pr. s. avouches, S3; see Vowchen .

records.label: Vow
records.text: Vow , sb. vow, PP; vowes , pl. , PP; vouwes , S2.—OF. vou (Ps. 21); Lat. uotum . Cf. Auowe (p. 18).

records.label: Vowchen
records.text: Vowchen , v. to vouch, cite, call, HD; vouchen , to avouch, S3. Phr. : vouchen saf , to guarantee, vouchsafe, PP, HD; vouche sauf , C2.—AF. voucher , vocher ; Lat. uocare ; see BH , § 96.

records.label: Vowtres
records.text: Vowtres , sb. pl. vultures, WA.—OF. voutre ; Lat. uultur .

records.label: Vowtriere
records.text: Vowtriere , sb. adultress, WA. See Avoutrie .

records.label: Voys
records.text: Voys , sb. voice, S2, S3, C2, C3; woice , S2; voce , B; vois , PP.—OF. vois ; Lat. uōcem ; see BH , § 74.

records.label: Vyne
records.text: Vyne , sb. vine, PP.

records.label: Vyner
records.text: Vyner , sb. vineyard, W2; vynere , H; vyneris , pl. , W2; vyners , H.—OF. vinier (BH); Late Lat. vinarium , vineyard, from Lat. uinum , wine.

records.label: Vyner
records.text: Vyner , sb. vine-dresser, Manip.—OF. vinier (Ducange); Late Lat. vinarium (acc.).

records.label: Vynour
records.text: Vynour , sb. vine-dresser, Bardsley.—OF. vineür ; Lat. uinitorem .

records.label: Vyre
records.text: Vyre , sb. a crossbow-bolt, B.—OF. vire (Ducange). Cf. Virelay .

records.label: Wa
records.text: Wa , sb. woe, WA, B; waa , WA, HD; see Wo .

records.label: Wa
records.text: Wa , pron. who, S; see Who .

records.label: Waast
records.text: Waast , sb. waist, C2; see Waste .

records.label: Wacche
records.text: Wacche , sb. vigil, watch, PP, HD; wecche , S; wach , one who keeps a lookout; wecche , pl. , S; wecchess , S; wacchis , WA; wachis , sentinels, S3.—AS. wæcce .

records.label: Wacchen
records.text: Wacchen , v. to watch, SkD; vachit , pp. , S2.—AS. wacian .

records.label: Wachet
records.text: Wachet , sb. a sort of blue cloth, CM. See Philolog. Soc. Trans. 1885, p. 329.

records.label: Waden
records.text: Waden , v. to wade, PP; vayd , S2. Der. : vading , wading, S2.—AS. wadan , pt. s. wód , pp. gewaden .

records.label: Wæs
records.text: Wæs , imp. s. be, S, Comb. : wæs hail , be hale, S; wæs hæil , S; wassail , S; wassayl , S.—ONorth. wæs , AS. wes , imp. s. of wesan , to be.

records.label: Wæs
records.text: Wæs , pt. s. was, S; see Was .

records.label: Waff
records.text: Waff , v. to waft, lift up, raise, bear, SkD, JD; wafte , pt. s. , S2.—Icel. váfa , to wave, vibrate.

records.label: Wafre
records.text: Wafre , sb. a thin small cake, wafer, CM, PP; wafur , Prompt., Voc.—AF. wafre (F. gaufre ); ODutch wafel (see Kilian); cp. OHG. waba , honey-comb (Tatian); see Weigand (s.v. waffel ).

records.label: Wafrere
records.text: Wafrere , sb. a maker of wafer-cakes, confectioner, PP; wafereres , pl. , C3.

records.label: Wafrestre
records.text: Wafrestre , sb. a female maker or seller of wafer-cakes, PP.

records.label: Wage
records.text: Wage , sb. a gage, pledge, pay for service, WA, Prompt.; wages , pl. , PP.—AF. wage , gage ; Low Lat. wadium , a pledge; Goth. wadi ; cp. Lat. uas ( uadi- ). Cf. Wed .

records.label: Wagen
records.text: Wagen , v. to engage, to go bail, P, Prompt.—OF. gagier ; Low. Lat. wadiare , from wadium . See above.

records.label: Waggen
records.text: Waggen , v. to shake to and fro, Prompt., CM, PP; waggid , pp. , W.

records.label: Waghe
records.text: Waghe , sb. wall, H; wah , S; see Wowe .

records.label: Waille
records.text: Waille , v. to wail, C2; see Weilen .

records.label: Wait
records.text: Wait , pr. s. knows, S3; see Witen (1) .

records.label: Waith
records.text: Waith , sb. danger, peril, B, JD; wathe , WA; vath , B.—Icel. váði .

records.label: Waith
records.text: Waith , v. to hunt, fish.—Icel. veiða , to catch, hunt; cp. AS. wǽðan , to hunt, to wander (Grein). Related to F. gagner (see Brachet). See Gaignage .

records.label: Waith
records.text: Waith , sb. game, sport, a ‘take,’ S3, JD.—Icel. veiðr ; cp. OHG. weida (Otfrid), see Weigand (s.v. weide ).

records.label: Waithing
records.text: Waithing , sb. what is taken in hunting or fishing, JD, S3.

records.label: Wak
records.text: Wak , adj. wet, moist, S3, SkD (s.v. wake ). Der. : waknes , moistness, JD.—Cp. Du. wak , Icel. vökr ; cp. Icel. vök ( vaka- ), a hole in ice.

records.label: Wake
records.text: Wake , sb. a watch, vigilia , Cath. Comb. : wakepleyes , ceremonies attending the vigils for the dead, C.

records.label: Waken
records.text: Waken , v. to be awake, to wake, cease from sleep, S, PP, S2; woc , pt. s. , S; wok , S; wook , S2, C3.—AS. wacan , pt. wóc , pp. wacen .

records.label: Wakien
records.text: Wakien , v. to watch, to awake, S, PP; waky , S2; wakede , pt. s. , S, PP; waked , pp. , S.—AS. wacian , pt. wacede .

records.label: Waking
records.text: Waking , sb. a watch, S2, C2; wakynge , W.

records.label: Waknen

records.label: Walter

records.label: Walteren
records.text: Walteren , v. to roll about, welter, S2, S3, PP; weltyn , Prompt. Der. : waltrynge , a weltering, Prompt.; weltering , a turning over, S3.

records.label: Walwen
records.text: Walwen , v. to roll, CM, PP; welwyn , Prompt.; walowand , pr. p. , WA; walewide , pt. s. , W.—AS. wealwian : Goth. walwjan (in compounds).

records.label: Walwyng
records.text: Walwyng , sb. a rolling, W.

records.label: Wambe

records.text: Wan- , prefix , expressing lack, deficiency. Comb. : wan-beleue , perfidia , Prompt.; wan-hope , despair, S2, C, P, H, Voc.; wan-towen , untrained, wanton; wantown , C; wantoun , C2; wanton , WA; wantowe , Prompt.; wanton-nes , want of discretion, S3; wantownesse , C; wan-truce , fail, failure, S; wan-trukien , to fail, SD; wan-trokiynge , abatement, S2; wan-trust , distrust, CM.—Cp. Du. wan- , prefix.

records.text: Wand , sb. a rod (= Lat. uirga ), H (Ps. 109. 3), WA; wande , H (Ps. 44. 8).—Cp. OSwed. wand .

records.text: Wandren , v. to wander, to walk, S2, PP, W; wondren , S2, PP.—AS. wandrian .

records.text: Wane , sb. a quantity, a number, S2, S3; see Woon .

records.label: Wane
records.text: Wane , sb. want, deficiency, misery, S, S2, WA; wone , S.—AS. wana .

records.label: Wanelasour
records.text: Wanelasour , sb. one who rouses and drives game, alator , Voc. See HD (s.v. wanlace ).

records.label: Wanen
records.text: Wanen , v. to wane, to fail, to grow less, C, C2, S2; wanye , P; wanne , to ebb, S3; woned , pp. , S2.—AS. wanian ( wonian ).

records.label: Wanene
records.text: Wanene , adv. whence, S; see Whanene .

records.label: Wangeliste
records.text: Wangeliste , sb. evangelist, S2.—Church Lat. euangelista (Vulg.).

records.text: Wangtooth , sb. molar tooth, C2; see Wonge .

records.text: Wankel , adj. tottery, unstable; wankyll , S2.—AS. wancol (SkD, s.v. wench ); cp. OHG. wank , tottering (Otfrid).

records.text: Wanne , adv. , conj. when, S, S2; see Whanne .

records.label: Wannes
records.text: Wannes , adv. whence, S3; see Whannes .

records.label: Want
records.text: Want , adj. deficient; wannt , SkD; wonte , sb. deficiency, SkD.—Icel. vant , n. of vanr , deficient.

records.text: Wanten , v. to be lacking, carere , Cath.; wonte , S, S2; wantede , pt. s. , S; wayntyt , pl. , S3.—Icel. vanta .

records.label: Waranten
records.text: Waranten , v. to warrant, C3.

records.text: Ward , sb. a guard, SD; wardes , pl. , SD.—AS. weard ( m. ), ‘custos’.

records.label: Ward
records.text: Ward , sb. world (Lancelot of the Laik, E.E.T.S. No. 6). See Werd .

records.label: Warde
records.text: Warde , sb. ward, custodia , S; ward , care, heed, regard, S2; keeping, Prompt.—AS. weard ( f. ), ‘custodia.’ Comb. : warde-motes , meetings of a ward, P.

records.label: Warden
records.text: Warden , v. to guard, S; warded , pp. , S2.—AS. weardian .

records.label: Wardeyne
records.text: Wardeyne , sb. warden, Prompt.; wardeyn , CM, Voc.; wardane , B; wardeynes , pl. , umpires, G.—AF. wardein .

records.label: Wardone
records.text: Wardone , sb. a kind of pear, volemum , Prompt.

records.text: Wardrobe , sb. a house of office, CM.

records.label: Ware
records.text: Ware , sb. merchandise, S2, C3, G, SkD.—Icel. vara ; cp. AS. waru , care, custody, (Grein).

records.text: Ware , sb. host, collection, S2. Comb. : helleware , the host of hell, SD; watres ware , waters, S2; windes ware , winds, S2.—AS. -waru (Grein), see Fick, 7. 291. Cf. Were .

records.text: Ware , v. to lay out, to spend, S2, HD, JD, Palsg. (p. 452); wayr , commutare , Cath., JD; war , JD.—Icel. verja , to clothe, to invest money, to spend. See Werien .

records.label: Wareyne
records.text: Wareyne , sb. a warren, Prompt.; warrayne , HD. Der. : warnere , warrener, Prompt.; warner , P, HD, Bardsley.—AF. warenne ( garenne , garreyne ); Low Lat. warenna ; from OHG. war- in warjan . See Warant .

records.label: Warh
records.text: Warh ( in compounds ), an outlawed felon. Comb. : warh-treo , the felon’s tree, the gallows (used of the cross of Christ), S.—AS. wearh , an outlawed felon, a wolf; cp. Icel. vargr , a wolf, an outlaw. With warh-tréo cp. OS. warag-treo , Icel. varg-tré , also AS. wearh-ród (Voc.).

records.label: Wari-angel
records.text: Wari-angel , sb. a butcher-bird, a small woodpecker, WA (p. 469); wary-angle , Cotg. (s.v. pie ).

records.label: Warice
records.text: Warice , v. to heal, cure, to be cured, C3; warschyn , convalesco , Prompt.; warisch , WA; warysshe , Palsg.; warisshed , pp. , Prompt. ( n ).—OF. wariss- , pr. p. stem of warir , garir (F. guérir ), of Teut. origin; OHG. warjan , to protect. Cf. Warant .

records.label: Warien
records.text: Warien , v. to curse, S, S2, S3, W, H (Ps. 108. 27), C3; werien , H; varyit , pt. s. , S2; wereged , pp. , S.—AS. wergian ; cp. OHG. ( fur ) wergen (Tatian). AS. wergian , from wearh , an accursed person, an outlawed felon. See Warh .

records.label: Warien
records.text: Warien , v. to be on the watch, S (9. 132); waren , S; ware þe , imp. s. , PP; war yow , pl. , C2.—AS. warian , to take heed.

records.label: Warke
records.text: Warke , sb. work, S2; see Werk .

records.label: Warlaȝe
records.text: Warlaȝe , sb. a warlock, sorcerer, deceiver, WA.—AS. wǽrloga , covenant-breaker, often used of the devil (Grein).

records.label: Warnin
records.text: Warnin , v. to warn, moneo , S, C2; warnon , Prompt.; warnyt , pt. s. , B; warnede , PP.—AS. wearnian , from wearn , a denial, refusal. Cf. Wernen .

records.label: Warnishen
records.text: Warnishen , v. to fortify, protect, SkD (s.v. garnish ); warenyss , H; warnist , warnyst , warnyscht , pp. , H; warnised , HD. Der. : warnysynge , protection, defence, H; warnyshynge , H.—AF. warniss- , pr. p. stem of warnir ; of Teut. origin. See Warnin .

records.label: Warpen

records.label: Warrok

(pl. wǽron ), subj. wǽre (pl. wǽren ). See Wæs .

records.label: Waste
records.text: Waste , sb. waist, a man’s middle, Prompt.; wast , Prompt.; waast , C2.—Probably a deriv. from Wexen (to grow); see SkD.

records.text: Wastel , sb. a cake made of the finest flour, P, Prompt.; wastell , libum , Voc.; wastelle , Voc., Cath. Comb. : wastel breed , cake-bread, CM, C.—AF. wastel , gastel (F. gâteau ).

records.text: Wastme , sb. growth, form, personal appearance, S, SkD (s.v. waist ); westm , fruit, S.—AS. wæstm . See Wexen .

records.label: Wastoure
records.text: Wastoure , sb. a destroyer, WA; a wasteful person, P.

records.label: Wat
records.text: Wat , pron. what, S, S2; see What .

records.label: Wat

records.text: Wate , sb. chance, luck, S; see Whate .

records.label: Watelen
records.text: Watelen , v. to wattle, to strengthen with hurdles, SkD; watelide , pt. s. , PP.

records.label: Water
records.text: Water , sb. water, S2; weater , S; vattir , S2; walter , S3; watres , pl. , S2. Comb. : watirbank , shore, W; waterles , without water, C. Der. : watrand , watering, S2.—AS. wæter : OS. watar ; cp. OHG. wazzar (Tatian).

records.label: Watloker
records.text: Watloker , adv. comp. sooner, S2; see What .

records.label: Wattri
records.text: Wattri , adj. venomous, S2; see Attrie .

records.text: Wawen , v. to move from side to side, P; wawid , pp. , shaken, SkD (s.v. wag ).—AS. wagian (Grein).

records.label: Waxen
records.text: Waxen , v. to grow, S, S2; see Wexen .

records.label: Way
records.text: Way , interj. wo!, S; see Wo .

records.label: Wayke
records.text: Wayke , adj. weak, Cath., S2, C, C3, PP; wayk , S2, C2; waik , PP, B; waiker , comp. , S3.—Icel. veikr ; cp. AS. wác . Cf. Woc .

records.label: Waykely
records.text: Waykely , adv. watchfully, carefully, S3.—AS. wacollice , adv. from wacol (Voc.). See Waken .

records.label: Waymenten
records.text: Waymenten , v. to lament, Prompt., Spenser (2).—AF. weimenter , guaimenter .

records.label: Waymentynge
records.text: Waymentynge , sb. lamentation, C, CM, H; weymentynge , C.

records.label: Wayne
records.text: Wayne , sb. wain, cart, Prompt., G; waines , pl. , S.—AS. wægn : OHG. wagan (Otfrid).

records.label: Wayowre
records.text: Wayowre , sb. a wager, Prompt.; waiour , S2.—OF. wageure (F. gageure ), from wage ( gage ). See Wage .

records.label: Wayryngle
records.text: Wayryngle , sb. a little villain, WA.

records.label: Wayte
records.text: Wayte , sb. watchman, waker, spy, Prompt.; waites , pl. , S2. See below.

records.label: Wayten
records.text: Wayten , v. to watch, expect, C2, S2, PP; waiten , S, S2, S3, C2, PP; i-wayted , pp. , S2.—AF. wayter , OF. guaiter (Roland): OHG. wahten , to watch (Otfrid).

records.label: Wayue
records.text: Wayue , v. to send, put away, WA; wayfe , WA.—Cp. Low Lat. wayviare ; see Ducange (s.v. wayf ). Cf. Weyuen .

records.label: We
records.text: We , sb. way, S2; see Wey .

records.label: Weaden
records.text: Weaden , sb. pl. garments, S; see Wade .

records.label: Wealden
records.text: Wealden , v. to govern, S; see Welden .

records.label: Wealdent
records.text: Wealdent , sb. ruler, S; walden , S.—AS. wealdend .

records.label: Wealden
records.text: Wealden , v. to govern, rule, control, possess, S; see Welden .

records.label: Weallen
records.text: Weallen , v. to boil, S; see Wallen .

records.label: Wear
records.text: Wear , adj. wary, cautious, S; see War .

records.label: Weater
records.text: Weater , sb. water, S; see Water .

records.label: Web
records.text: Web , sb. that which is woven, S2, W2 (Job 7. 6); webbe , P; wobbys , pl. , S3.—AS. webb .

records.label: Webbare
records.text: Webbare , sb. maker of woollen or linen cloth, Prompt.

records.label: Webbe
records.text: Webbe , sb. a weaver, Bardsley, CM, C; a female weaver, P.

records.label: Webster
records.text: Webster , sb. a female weaver, Voc.; textor , Voc.; webstere , textor , Voc., W2 (Job 7. 6); websteris , pl. , S2.—AS. webbestre .

records.label: Wecche
records.text: Wecche , sb. vigil, watch, S; see Wacche .

records.label: Wed
records.text: Wed , sb. a pledge, W2; wedde , P; dat. , S, S3, C. Comb. : wed-lac , wedlock, S; wedlak , S; wedlock , C2; wedlackes , gen. , S; wedlakes , S.—AS. wedd : Goth. wadi . Cf. Wage .

records.text: Wedden , v. to engage by a pledge, to marry, S, C; i-weddet , pp. , S; y-wedde , S; y-wedded , C2.—AS. weddian , to pledge.

records.text: Weden , v. to be mad, to go mad, S2, WA; weide , S3 (6. 438); wedde , pt. s. , S.—AS. wédan , from wód . See Wode .

records.label: Weder
records.text: Weder , sb. wether, Voc.; wedyr , Prompt.; weddir , S2; veddir , S2; wether , S2.—AS. weðer : cp. Goth. withrus , lamb.

records.label: Weder
records.text: Weder , sb. weather, S, S2, C2; wedirs , pl. , S2, WA; vedirs , S2; wedereȝ , storms, S2; wederes , P.—AS. weder ; cp. G. wetter .

records.text: Wederen , v. to expose to the weather; wederyn , auro , Prompt.; widren , to wither, SkD; wydder , S3. Der. : wethering , weathering, seasoning from exposure to the weather, S3.

records.label: Wedous
records.text: Wedous , sb. pl. widows, S3; see Widewe .

records.label: Wee
records.text: Wee , sb. a man, WA; we , WA. See Wye .

records.label: Weed
records.text: Weed , sb. weed, wild herb, Prompt.; wed , S; weode , dat. , S.—AS. wéod , wíod : cp. OS. wiod .

records.label: Weep
records.text: Weep , pt. s. wept, C1 , C3; see Wepen .

records.label: Weet
records.text: Weet , adj. wet, PP; wete , C.—AS. wǽt .

records.label: Weete
records.text: Weete , sb. wet, perspiration, S2, PP; wete , S2, C3; weet , C2, PP.—AS. wǽta .

records.label: Weeten
records.text: Weeten , v. to wet, W2; wette , pt. s. , C.—AS. wǽtan .

records.label: Wei
records.text: Wei , interj. wo! S; see Wo .

records.label: Weilen
records.text: Weilen , v. to lament, W, W2, S2; weylen , C; waille , C2. Der. : weilyng , lamentation, W.—Cp. Icel. væla .

records.label: Weir
records.text: Weir , sb. war, S3; see Werre .

records.label: Weird
records.text: Weird , sb. fate, S3; see Werd .

records.label: Weiȝh

Comb. : wel-bigoon , joyous, CM; welcomen , welcome, PP; welcume , S; welcome , to welcome, PP; wolcumen , S; wilcweme , content, S; wel dede , good deed, PP; pl. , S; welfaring , prosperous, C2.—AS. wel ; cp.
